model.name: Apparel Fashion
model.description: Apparel and Fashion is a creative and commercial industry designing, manufacturing, and marketing athletic, lifestyle, and luxury clothing, footwear, and accessories through retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale partnerships.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Single source of truth for all apparel and fashion product definitions including SKUs, UPCs, styles, colorways, sizes, BOMs, tech packs, material compositions, and MSRP. Owns the master product catalog from concept through commercialization across athletic, lifestyle, and luxury clothing, footwear, and accessories. Integrates with PLM systems (Infor PLM, Centric PLM) for design-to-production lifecycle.
domains.references: ISO 9001, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Infor PLM / Centric PLM

products.name: style
products.description: Core master entity representing a unique apparel or footwear style — the foundational design unit in PLM (Infor PLM, Centric PLM). Captures style number, name, gender, silhouette, product type (athletic, lifestyle, luxury), category, subcategory, division, season, collection, lifecycle stage (concept, development, commercialized, discontinued), target channel (DTC, wholesale, retail), MSRP, and design ownership. This is the top-level product identity before colorway and size differentiation. Parent entity in the style→colorway→SKU hierarchy.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the style. Primary key representing the foundational design unit in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems before colorway and size differentiation.

attributes.name: brand_id

attributes.name: category_id

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.collection. Business justification: Style should have a direct FK to its primary collection. Currently style has collection_name (STRING) which should be normalized. While colorway.collection_id exists, style is the master entity and sh

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Styles are designed and managed by specific departments (merchandising, design) tracked as cost centers. Essential for allocating product development overhead, budget tracking, and departmental perfor

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Styles are planned for specific profit centers (brand/channel/region combinations). Critical for P&L reporting, margin analysis by segment, and strategic assortment planning decisions in multi-brand o

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Merchandising teams design styles for specific customer segments (e.g., Gen-Z athleisure, luxury high-net-worth). Product development briefs explicitly identify target segments. This link enables segm

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved the style for commercialization. Used for accountability, governance, and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the style was approved for commercialization and moved from development to active status. Key milestone in PLM workflow and governance.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Product Lifecycle Management, Centric PLM

attributes.name: care_instructions
attributes.description: Garment care and washing instructions. Required for consumer product labeling and compliance with FTC Care Labeling Rule.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Care Labeling Rule 16 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Standard Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for the style including materials, labor, and manufacturing overhead. Foundation for margin analysis, Initial Markup (IMU), and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the style is manufactured. Required for customs, duty calculation, and country-of-origin labeling compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Country of Origin Labeling, Harmonized System (HS) Code Standards, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the style record was first created in the PLM or master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the MSRP (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency pricing and international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

attributes.name: design_owner

attributes.references: Centric PLM Product Design, Workday HCM

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the style is discontinued and removed from active assortment. Used for lifecycle management, markdown planning, and inventory liquidation strategies.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Business division or brand line to which the style belongs. Used for P&L reporting, brand portfolio management, and organizational accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Structure

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Target gender demographic for the style. Critical for merchandising, assortment planning, and store allocation.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: is_core_style
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a core, never-out-of-stock (NOS) style that is continuously replenished. Core styles receive priority in inventory allocation and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Assortment Planning

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the style is exclusive to specific channels, retailers, or markets. Used for channel conflict management and partnership agreements.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the style is launched to market and becomes available for sale. Key milestone for merchandising, marketing campaigns, and inventory planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System, Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time in days from Purchase Order (PO) placement to delivery. Used for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance tracking.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar, Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow. Governs visibility, ordering, and operational processes across design, sourcing, production, and sales channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|sample|commercialized|active|phasing_out|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor PLM Product Lifecycle Management, Centric PLM

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary fabric or material composition of the style (e.g., 100% Cotton, 80% Polyester 20% Elastane). Required for compliance labeling per FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Textile Labeling Requirements, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the manufacturer or supplier for production of this style. Critical for buy planning and Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgeting.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Sourcing, SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the style record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data synchronization across systems.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price for the style at launch. Baseline for pricing strategy, markdown planning, and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Price Management, SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the style by market positioning and intended use case. Aligns with brand portfolio segmentation strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Assortment Planning

attributes.name: safety_certification
attributes.description: Product safety certifications and compliance standards met by the style. Required for consumer product safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Standards, ISO 9001

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Season identifier for the style (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Critical for collection planning, Open-to-Buy (OTB) management, and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Planning, Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: silhouette
attributes.description: Design silhouette or fit profile of the style (e.g., slim fit, relaxed fit, oversized, tailored). Key attribute for product differentiation and customer preference matching.

attributes.name: style_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the style including design features, aesthetic attributes, and intended use. Used for marketing copy and product catalogs.

attributes.name: style_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name or title of the style. Used in catalogs, e-commerce, and merchandising communications.

attributes.name: style_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the style. Used across PLM, merchandising, and supply chain systems. Typically alphanumeric code assigned during design phase.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Product Design Standards, Centric PLM Collection Management

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or ethical certifications held by the style (e.g., GOTS, OEKO-TEX, BCI, Fair Trade). Supports ESG reporting and consumer transparency initiatives.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Better Cotton Initiative (BCI), Fair Labor Association (FLA)

attributes.name: target_channel
attributes.description: Intended sales and distribution channel strategy for the style. Supports Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), wholesale, retail, and omnichannel planning. May include multiple channels separated by delimiter.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Allocation Planning

attributes.name: tech_pack_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document link to the technical specification package (tech pack) containing detailed construction, measurements, and manufacturing instructions.
attributes.references: Centric PLM Tech Packs, Infor PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: wholesale_price
attributes.description: Wholesale price offered to retail partners and distributors. Used for B2B pricing, margin analysis, and wholesale channel profitability.

products.name: colorway
products.description: Represents a specific color variant of a style, combining the style with a defined color palette. Tracks colorway code, colorway name, primary color, secondary color, color standard (Pantone, NCS), color story, season relevance, colorway status (active, discontinued, carry-over), and launch date. A style may have multiple colorways; each colorway is a distinct sellable variant managed in PLM and Oracle Retail.

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the colorway. Primary key for the colorway entity.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection that this colorway belongs to. Collections group related styles and colorways for merchandising and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Colorway development (color matching, dyeing trials, print development) incurs costs allocated to design or merchandising cost centers. Necessary for tracking color development expenses and department

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the season in which this colorway is launched or relevant. Links to the merchandising season master data.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent style that this colorway belongs to. A style may have multiple colorways.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Colorway assortment planning targets specific customer segments (e.g., teen-girl colorways vs. professional-women colorways). Merchandising teams make segment-specific colorway decisions for seasonal

attributes.name: age_group
attributes.description: The target age group for the colorway. Used for merchandising and assortment planning.

attributes.name: color_family
attributes.description: The broad color family or category that the colorway belongs to, used for filtering and search in e-commerce and merchandising systems. attributes.name: color_standard
attributes.description: The color standard system used to define the colorway (e.g., Pantone, Natural Color System (NCS), RAL, CMYK, RGB, HEX).
attributes.references: Pantone Matching System (PMS), Natural Color System (NCS)

attributes.name: color_story
attributes.description: The thematic narrative or inspiration behind the colorway, often tied to seasonal trends, brand campaigns, or design concepts (e.g., 'Ocean Breeze', 'Urban Jungle', 'Retro Revival').

attributes.name: colorway_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the colorway, typically a short alphanumeric code used in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, Oracle Retail, and across supply chain operations.

attributes.name: colorway_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the colorway, often descriptive and marketing-friendly (e.g., 'Midnight Navy', 'Sunset Orange', 'Forest Green').

attributes.name: colorway_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the colorway. Active colorways are available for sale; discontinued colorways are no longer produced; carry-over colorways continue from a previous season; pending colorways are in development.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the colorway record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date when the colorway was discontinued or removed from active production. Null if the colorway is still active.

attributes.name: exclusivity_description
attributes.description: Details about the exclusivity arrangement, such as the specific retailer, channel, or region where the colorway is exclusively available.

attributes.name: finish_type
attributes.description: The surface finish or texture applied to the colorway (e.g., matte, glossy, metallic, satin). Relevant for footwear, accessories, and certain apparel categories.

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: The target gender demographic for the colorway. Used for merchandising, assortment planning, and marketing segmentation.

attributes.name: hex_color_code
attributes.description: The hexadecimal color code for the primary color, used for digital representation in e-commerce and marketing materials.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the primary product image for this colorway, used in e-commerce, Point of Sale (POS), and marketing materials.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the colorway is exclusive to a specific channel, retailer, or region. True for exclusive colorways, False for general distribution.

attributes.name: is_limited_edition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the colorway is a limited edition release with restricted production quantities. True for limited editions, False for standard releases.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date when the colorway was officially launched or made available for sale. Used for Time and Action (TNA) calendar tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified the colorway record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the colorway record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The manufacturers suggested retail price for products in this colorway. Used as the baseline for pricing strategies and markdown calculations.

attributes.name: oracle_retail_item_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this colorway in Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Used for integration with merchandising, allocation, and pricing modules.

attributes.name: pantone_code
attributes.description: The Pantone Matching System (PMS) code for the primary color, used for precise color matching in manufacturing and printing.

attributes.name: plm_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this colorway in the source Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system (Infor PLM or Centric PLM). Used for system integration and traceability.

attributes.name: primary_color
attributes.description: The dominant color of the colorway. This is the main color that defines the visual appearance of the product.

attributes.name: print_pattern
attributes.description: Description of any print or pattern applied to the colorway (e.g., 'Floral', 'Geometric', 'Camouflage', 'Solid'). Null for solid colors without patterns.

attributes.name: swatch_image_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the color swatch image for this colorway, used for color selection in e-commerce and merchandising tools.

attributes.name: tertiary_color
attributes.description: The third accent color of the colorway, if applicable. Used for multi-color designs.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created the colorway record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: sku
products.description: The atomic sellable unit in apparel — a unique Stock Keeping Unit representing the intersection of style, colorway, and size. Stores SKU code, UPC/EAN barcode, RFID tag reference, size label, size run position, weight, dimensions, country of origin, HS code, GSP eligibility, MSRP, cost (COGS), IMU, ATS flag, NOS flag, and active/inactive status. SSOT for all downstream inventory, order, and e-commerce references. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM and PLM systems.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU. Primary key representing the atomic sellable unit at the intersection of style, colorway, and size.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand under which this SKU is marketed. Supports multi-brand portfolio management.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise hierarchy category. Classifies the SKU into the product taxonomy for reporting and planning.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the seasonal collection or product line that this SKU belongs to. Links to collection planning and merchandising.

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Reference to the colorway variant of the style. Defines the specific color combination applied to this SKU.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: SKU-to-GL account mapping drives inventory valuation, COGS posting, and revenue recognition in apparel ERP (SAP/Oracle Retail). Every apparel finance team expects SKUs to be mapped to GL accounts for

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent style that this SKU belongs to. Links to the style master which defines the base product design.

attributes.name: age_group
attributes.description: Target age demographic for the product. Complements gender classification for merchandising and safety compliance.

attributes.name: ats_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for sale across channels. Drives e-commerce availability and order promising.

attributes.name: care_instructions
attributes.description: Garment care and washing instructions as required on product labels. Includes washing, drying, ironing, and dry cleaning guidance.
attributes.references: FTC Care Labeling Rule, ISO 3758 Textile Care Symbols

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the color variant. Used in SKU construction and merchandising systems.

attributes.name: color_name
attributes.description: Marketing-friendly name of the color variant for customer-facing displays and e-commerce.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: The landed cost of the SKU including manufacturing, materials, labor, and freight. Used for margin and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured. Required for customs, labeling, and trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes, FTC Country of Origin Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SKU record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discontinuation_date

attributes.name: ean

attributes.name: gender

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date when the SKU was first made available for sale. Used for product lifecycle analysis and merchandising planning.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: The length dimension of the packaged SKU in centimeters. Used for carton planning and warehouse space optimization.

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Detailed description of fabric and material composition with percentages. Required for labeling compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act, OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SKU record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The recommended retail price set by the manufacturer. Used as baseline for pricing strategies and markdown calculations.

attributes.name: nos_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is designated as a never-out-of-stock item requiring continuous replenishment and high service levels.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the product into apparel, footwear, or accessories. Drives business rules and fulfillment logic.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_reference
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier for automated inventory tracking, anti-theft, and supply chain visibility. Enables real-time location tracking.

attributes.name: season_code

attributes.name: size_run_position

attributes.name: sku_code

attributes.name: upc

attributes.name: weight_kg

attributes.name: wholesale_price
attributes.description: The price at which the SKU is sold to wholesale partners and distributors. Used for B2B pricing and margin analysis.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: The width dimension of the packaged SKU in centimeters. Used for carton planning and warehouse space optimization.

products.name: size_scale
products.description: Defines the size run and size labeling system used for a product category or brand (e.g., XS-XXL, 28-40 waist, EU 36-46, US 6-14, One Size). Captures size scale code, size scale name, measurement system (US, EU, UK, JP), size labels ordered by run position, gender applicability, product category applicability, and regional market mapping. Enables consistent size normalization across channels and geographies.

attributes.name: size_scale_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the size scale. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Size scales are typically defined per product category in apparel (e.g., 'Mens Tops' uses XS-XXL, 'Footwear' uses numeric 6-13, 'Bottoms' uses waist measurements). Size_scale currently has product_cat

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of brand codes or names this size scale is applicable to. Allows for brand-specific sizing standards (e.g., luxury brands may use different scales than athletic brands).

attributes.name: conversion_table_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the size conversion table that maps this scale to other regional or brand scales. Enables cross-market size normalization.

products.name: category

Enables consistent product classification across OMS, WMS, and e-commerce.

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials and Product Costing master for a style or colorway — the single authoritative record of all raw materials, fabrics, trims, labels, and components required to manufacture the product, combined with complete product cost buildup. Captures BOM version, effective date, BOM status (draft, approved, production), and all cost components: total material cost, CMT cost breakdown (cut, make, trim), FOB cost, LDP (Landed Duty Paid) cost, duty rate, freight cost, target COGS, costing stage (initial estimate, final costing, actual), cost version, cost approval status, and IMU/MMU calculation inputs. Fabric content percentage supports FTC labeling compliance. Managed in Infor PLM and Centric PLM costing modules. SSOT for product costing, material composition, and cost buildup — no other product in this domain stores cost data. Critical for sourcing decisions, margin management, and regulatory labeling.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials record. Primary key for the BOM product.

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific colorway variant of the style. Links to the colorway master product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: BOM development and costing activities are performed by product development or technical design departments tracked as cost centers. Necessary for allocating pre-production costs and tracking departme

attributes.name: hs_code_id

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandising season for which this BOM is designed. Links to the season master product.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent style for which this BOM is defined. Links to the style master product.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: BOMs in apparel are factory-specific — construction methods, CMT costs, and material sourcing vary by factory. The same style may have different BOMs for different factories. The existing bom.vendor_i

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier or factory responsible for manufacturing this product. Links to the supplier master product.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, typically assigned by the PLM system. Used for external communication with suppliers and factories.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM indicating its approval state and readiness for production use.

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use case: engineering BOM for design, manufacturing BOM for production, costing BOM for financial analysis, or planning BOM for procurement.

attributes.name: cmt_cost
attributes.description: Total labor and manufacturing cost charged by the factory for cutting, making, and trimming the garment. Does not include material costs.

attributes.name: cost_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the cost buildup by finance or merchandising teams. Approved costs are used for margin analysis and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: cost_approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost buildup was approved. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: cost_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the cost buildup to track changes in costing assumptions, material prices, or factory quotes over time.

attributes.name: costing_stage
attributes.description: Stage of the costing process indicating the maturity and accuracy of cost data: initial estimate during design, preliminary costing after sampling, final costing before production, or actual costing post-production.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Country where the product is manufactured. Used for customs documentation, duty calculation, and trade compliance. Three-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the PLM system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all cost fields in this BOM record. Supports multi-currency costing for global sourcing.

attributes.name: cut_cost
attributes.description: Labor cost component for cutting fabric and materials. Part of the CMT cost breakdown.

attributes.name: duty_cost
attributes.description: Import duty cost per unit calculated by applying the duty rate to the FOB cost. Varies by destination country and trade agreements.

attributes.name: duty_rate
attributes.description: Import duty rate percentage applied to the product based on its HS Code and country of origin. Used to calculate duty cost.

attributes.name: fabric_content_percentage

attributes.name: fob_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the product at the port of origin, including materials, CMT, and factory overhead. Excludes freight, duty, and landed costs.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost per unit to ship the product from the factory to the destination warehouse or distribution center.

attributes.name: imu_percentage
attributes.description: Initial markup percentage calculated as (MSRP - LDP Cost) / MSRP. Key profitability metric for merchandising and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: ldp_cost
attributes.description: Total landed cost per unit including FOB, freight, duty, and all other costs to deliver the product to the destination warehouse. Represents the true COGS.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required from purchase order placement to product delivery at the destination warehouse. Used for supply chain planning and TNA calendar.

attributes.name: make_cost
attributes.description: Labor cost component for sewing and assembling the garment. Part of the CMT cost breakdown.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier or factory to manufacture this product at the quoted cost. Critical for buy planning and allocation.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Suggested retail price for the product. Used to calculate Initial Markup (IMU) and Maintained Markup (MMU) metrics.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or comments related to the BOM, costing assumptions, or material sourcing.

attributes.name: primary_fabric_type

attributes.name: sustainability_certification

attributes.name: target_cogs

attributes.name: total_material_cost

attributes.name: trim_cost
attributes.description: Labor cost component for finishing, trimming, and quality inspection. Part of the CMT cost breakdown.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the BOM to track revisions and changes throughout the product lifecycle. Supports version control for design iterations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this BOM record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

Managed in Centric PLM. Links to BOM and T&A calendar. SSOT for ALL dimensional, construction, grading, and fit specifications — no other product in this domain stores measurement or grading data.

products.name: msrp_price

Supports multi-currency and multi-market pricing for DTC, wholesale, and retail channels. Managed in Oracle Retail Price Management and SAP S/4HANA SD. SSOT for product-level suggested pricing; actual selling prices and markdowns are owned by the merchandising domain.

attributes.name: msrp_price_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Price ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MSRP price record. Primary key for the MSRP price entity.

attributes.name: competitor_benchmark_price
attributes.description: Reference price from competitor analysis used to inform MSRP positioning. Supports competitive pricing strategy and market positioning.

attributes.name: cost_basis

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: imu_percentage
attributes.description: The initial markup percentage calculated as the difference between MSRP and cost, expressed as a percentage of MSRP. Key metric for profitability planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MSRP price record was last updated. Part of the record lifecycle audit trail.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the market or region where this MSRP applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: minimum_advertised_price
attributes.description: The minimum price at which retailers are allowed to advertise this product. Used to protect brand positioning and prevent price erosion in wholesale channels.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The suggested retail price amount set by the manufacturer for this SKU or style in the specified market and currency. This is the recommended selling price to consumers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this MSRP price record. Used for documenting special pricing considerations, exceptions, or business context.

attributes.name: price_change_reason

attributes.name: price_tier

attributes.name: price_zone
attributes.description: Geographic or market-based pricing zone code used for regional price differentiation within a country or market. Supports localized pricing strategies.

attributes.name: recommended_markdown_percentage
attributes.description: Suggested markdown percentage for promotional or clearance pricing. Used for planning maintained markup (MMU) and sell-through rate (STR) targets.

attributes.name: season_code

attributes.name: vat_inclusive_flag

attributes.name: wholesale_price
attributes.description: The price at which the product is sold to wholesale partners or distributors. Typically lower than MSRP to allow retailer margin. Business-confidential.

products.name: cost_sheet
products.description: Detailed product costing record capturing all cost components for a style or SKU including FOB cost, CMT cost (cut, make, trim), material cost, duty rate, freight cost, LDP (Landed Duty Paid) cost, and target COGS. Tracks cost version, costing stage (initial estimate, final costing, actual), season, and cost approval status. Enables IMU and MMU calculation. Managed in Infor PLM costing module and SAP S/4HANA CO.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.duty_calculation. Business justification: Cost sheets incorporate estimated landed duty costs during product development. Linking to actual duty calculations enables variance analysis between estimated and actual duty, improving costing accur

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Multi-GAAP apparel groups maintain parallel cost sheets per accounting ledger (IFRS vs local GAAP). Linking cost_sheet to ledger enables correct valuation method application and parallel accounting fo

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Cost sheets are prepared for specific profit center contexts (market/channel pricing strategies). Essential for calculating landed costs and target margins by segment, supporting pricing decisions in

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the season or collection for which this cost sheet applies.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) if cost sheet is SKU-level rather than style-level.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style or product design for which this cost sheet is prepared.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Cost sheets in apparel are negotiated at factory level — CMT and labor costs vary by factory. Sourcing teams compare factory-level cost sheets for vendor selection and margin analysis. The existing pr

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Cost sheets are negotiated with a vendor legal entity for payment terms, currency, and vendor performance reporting. Finance and sourcing teams need vendor-level cost sheet aggregation for spend analy

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Finance and sales ops teams gene

attributes.name: actual_cogs
attributes.description: Actual Cost of Goods Sold realized after production and delivery, used for financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost sheet was officially approved for use in production planning and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: cmt_cost
attributes.description: Cut, Make, and Trim cost representing the labor and manufacturing service charges for cutting fabric, assembling garment, and finishing operations.

attributes.name: cost_sheet_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or document number for the cost sheet, used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: cost_sheet_status
attributes.description: Current approval and workflow status of the cost sheet within the PLM and costing approval process.

attributes.name: costing_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the costing lifecycle indicating the maturity and accuracy of the cost data (e.g., initial estimate during design, final costing before production, actual costing post-production).

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the product is manufactured, used for customs and compliance.

attributes.name: ldp_cost
attributes.description: Landed Duty Paid cost representing the total delivered cost including FOB, freight, duties, and all logistics costs to the destination warehouse.

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: material_cost

attributes.description: Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price for the product, used to calculate Initial Markup (IMU) and margin targets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the cost sheet, including assumptions, special conditions, or variance explanations.

attributes.name: overhead_cost
attributes.description: Manufacturing overhead and indirect costs allocated to the product including factory utilities, supervision, and facility costs.

attributes.name: packaging_cost
attributes.description: Cost of packaging materials including polybags, hangtags, cartons, and shipping materials.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms negotiated with the factory or supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Letter of Credit).

attributes.name: target_cogs
attributes.description: Target Cost of Goods Sold established by merchandising and finance teams to achieve desired margin objectives.

attributes.name: target_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage established by merchandising and finance for this product or style.

attributes.name: trim_cost
attributes.description: Cost of trims and accessories such as buttons, zippers, labels, threads, and embellishments.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier for the cost sheet, allowing tracking of revisions and updates over time.

attributes.name: wholesale_price

domains.name: customer
domains.description: SSOT for all customer identities, profiles, preferences, segments, loyalty programs, and CLTV across DTC, wholesale, and retail channels. Manages B2C consumers, B2B wholesale accounts, household relationships, and enterprise partnerships. Supports NPS tracking, personalization strategies, and CRM data sourced from Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce.
domains.references: GDPR, CCPA, Adobe Experience Platform / Salesforce CRM

products.name: profile
products.description: SSOT master record and golden identity for every individual consumer (B2C) across DTC, retail, and e-commerce channels. Captures full identity attributes including name, date of birth, gender, preferred language, contact details, GDPR/CCPA consent flags, communication opt-ins, household membership, and CRM source system identifiers. Embeds the complete identity resolution graph linking multiple cross-channel identifiers (email, phone, cookie ID, device ID, loyalty card number, POS customer ID, Salesforce contact ID, Adobe ECID) with link type, link confidence scores, resolution methods (deterministic, probabilistic), source systems, and active status. Serves as the anchor entity for loyalty, preferences, interactions, CLTV, and all downstream personalization.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the consumer profile record. Serves as the primary key and golden identity anchor across all downstream systems including loyalty, preferences, interactions, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analytics.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.channel. Business justification: Preferred channel normalization: profile.acquisition_channel is a denormalized text field. A proper FK to merchandising.channel enables omnichannel personalization — assortment recommendations, pricin

attributes.name: crm_contact_id
attributes.description: Native contact identifier from Salesforce CRM (Salesforce Contact ID). Used to cross-reference the golden profile with the operational CRM record for campaign management, service interactions, and sales activity tracking.

attributes.name: merged_into_profile_id
attributes.description: When profile_status = 'merged', this field contains the profile_id of the surviving golden master profile into which this record was consolidated. Enables identity resolution audit trails and supports data subject access requests (DSAR) under GDPR Article 15 by tracing merged identities.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Profile Merge Rules; GDPR Article 15 - Right of Access

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.price_book. Business justification: Personalized pricing: VIP, employee, and loyalty-tier customers are assigned specific price books in DTC fashion retail. This FK enables the POS and e-commerce engine to apply the correct price book a

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.region. Business justification: Regional pricing and assortment targeting: customer profiles are assigned to merchandising regions to apply correct price books, tax jurisdictions, and regional promotions. Fashion retailers use regio

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the consumer's preferred or most frequently visited retail store location. Used for store-level clienteling, localized promotions, in-store event invitations, and store traffic attribution in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Operations

attributes.name: adobe_ecid
attributes.description: Adobe Experience Cloud Identity (ECID) assigned by Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) for cross-channel identity stitching, personalization, and real-time audience segmentation. Core identifier in the identity resolution graph.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Service; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Consumer's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for age verification, birthday loyalty reward triggers, demographic segmentation, and compliance with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) for consumers under 13.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the California consumer has exercised their right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information under CCPA. True = opted out of data sale/sharing; False = no opt-out exercised. Applicable to California residents. Must be honored within 15 business days per CCPA Section 1798.120.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120 - Right to Opt-Out; CPRA Amendment

attributes.name: country_of_residence
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the consumer's country of residence. Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR for EU residents, CCPA for California residents), tax jurisdiction, and eligible product catalog.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consumer profile record was first created in the Silver Layer data lakehouse. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and consumer tenure calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time; GDPR Article 5(1)(e) - Storage Limitation

attributes.name: customer_type

Distinguishes Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) retail shoppers, Business-to-Business (B2B) wholesale account contacts, VIP/high-value consumers, employee accounts, brand influencers, and anonymous guest profiles. Drives differential pricing, service levels, and personalization strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: b2c_consumer|b2b_wholesale|vip|employee|influencer|anonymous — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Account Type Classification

attributes.name: data_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to extended data retention beyond the minimum operational period. True = extended retention consented; False = standard minimum retention applies. Supports GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation principle and data governance policy enforcement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) - Storage Limitation; ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Consumer's primary email address used for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) communications, e-commerce account login, loyalty enrollment, and marketing campaign delivery. Serves as a key deterministic identity resolution signal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit consent to receive marketing emails. True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given. Mandatory compliance flag for CAN-SPAM, GDPR Article 6, and CCPA opt-out requirements. Must be honored in all email campaign execution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawful Basis for Processing; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Consumer's legal family name (last name or surname) as captured at registration or point of sale. Combined with given_name to form the full display name for communications and identity resolution.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided valid GDPR consent for personal data processing. True = consent granted; False = consent not granted or withdrawn. Applicable to EU/EEA residents. Mandatory for lawful data processing under GDPR Article 6(1)(a). Must be re-evaluated upon consent withdrawal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawful Basis; GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Consumer's self-reported gender identity. Used for personalized product recommendations, size guidance, targeted marketing, and assortment planning analytics. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR and CCPA requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 - Special Category Data; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: Consumer's legal given name (first name) as captured at registration or point of sale. Used for personalized communications, loyalty program enrollment, and CRM record matching.

attributes.name: identity_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) representing the certainty of the identity resolution linking multiple cross-channel identifiers to this golden profile. Higher scores indicate stronger deterministic signal overlap. Used to prioritize profile merge decisions and flag low-confidence profiles for manual review in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Graph; IAB Tech Lab - Identity Standards

attributes.name: identity_resolution_method
attributes.description: The method used to resolve and stitch cross-channel identifiers into this golden profile. 'deterministic' uses exact-match signals (email, loyalty card); 'probabilistic' uses statistical inference (device fingerprint, behavioral signals); 'hybrid' combines both; 'manual' indicates agent-assisted resolution. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Resolution; IAB Tech Lab - Identity Standards

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's identity has been verified through email confirmation, phone OTP, or document verification. True = identity verified; False = unverified or pending. Verified profiles receive higher identity confidence scores and are eligible for full loyalty benefits and personalization features.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(d) - Accuracy Principle; Adobe Experience Platform - Identity Verification

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Physical or digital loyalty program card number issued to the consumer. Used as a cross-channel identifier linking in-store POS transactions, e-commerce orders, and loyalty reward accruals to the golden profile.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loyalty Management

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer enrolled in the brand's loyalty program. Used to calculate loyalty tenure, anniversary reward triggers, and cohort-based loyalty program performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loyalty Management

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance for the consumer. Represents accrued reward currency from purchases, referrals, and engagement activities. Used for redemption eligibility checks, tier qualification calculations, and loyalty liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loyalty Management

attributes.name: nps_score

attributes.references: Bain & Company - NPS Methodology; Salesforce CRM - Survey Object

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response was recorded. Used to assess recency of sentiment data and determine eligibility for follow-up NPS surveys based on survey frequency rules.
attributes.references: Bain & Company - NPS Methodology; Salesforce CRM - Survey Object

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Consumer's primary contact phone number in E.164 international format. Used for SMS marketing opt-ins, order notifications, loyalty communications, and as a probabilistic identity resolution signal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: pos_customer_code
attributes.description: Customer identifier assigned within the SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) POS system for in-store transaction linkage. Enables reconciliation of retail store purchases to the golden consumer profile.

attributes.description: The originating channel or system through which this address was captured. Supports data lineage tracking and quality scoring. EDI-sourced addresses originate from wholesale partner Electronic Data Interchange transactions; POS addresses from SAP Customer Activity Repository in-store capture. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ecommerce|pos|crm|edi|manual|import|wholesale_portal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS); EDI X12 Standards

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the address indicating its business purpose. Billing addresses are used for invoicing and payment processing; shipping addresses for DTC order fulfillment and wholesale delivery routing; store_pickup for BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) orders; warehouse for distribution center addresses; return for RTV (Return to Vendor) and consumer return processing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: carrier_route_code
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code assigned to the address, identifying the specific mail carrier delivery route. Used for bulk mail rate optimization, direct mail marketing campaigns, and last-mile delivery planning.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City, town, or municipality name of the address. Used in order routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic sales analytics for retail store operations and DTC e-commerce.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code for the address (e.g., US, GB, DE, JP). Used for international shipping routing, customs documentation, HS Code determination, LDP (Landed Duty Paid) cost calculation, and GSP (Generalized System of Preferences) eligibility.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2; FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country corresponding to the country_code. Stored for display and reporting purposes to avoid repeated lookups against reference data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, GDPR data subject access requests, and audit trail requirements. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce CRM upon initial capture.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 - Records of Processing Activities; ISO 8601

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality score (0.00–100.00) assigned to the address record based on validation status, standardization, geocoding accuracy, and completeness. Used to prioritize address cleansing campaigns and filter high-confidence addresses for marketing and fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 - Data Quality; Adobe Experience Platform Data Governance

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for carriers and fulfillment teams regarding delivery at this address (e.g., 'Leave at reception', 'Dock 3 only', 'Requires appointment', 'Signature required'). Passed to Manhattan Associates WMS and 3PL partners during shipment creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: Administrative district, county, or sub-regional area of the address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination (county-level sales tax), regional sales territory assignment, and wholesale distribution zone mapping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; SAP S/4HANA SD Tax Jurisdiction

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation_code
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Validation (DPV) confirmation code indicating the deliverability of the address. Y = confirmed deliverable; S = confirmed with secondary number missing; D = confirmed primary but secondary not confirmed; N = not confirmed. Used to assess address quality and reduce undeliverable-as-addressed (UAA) mail.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is considered valid and active for business use. Supports bi-temporal data modeling for address history tracking, enabling accurate reconstruction of customer address state at any point in time for order dispute resolution and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA SD; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date until which this address record is valid. Null indicates the address is currently active with no planned expiry. Used for managing temporary addresses (e.g., seasonal warehouse locations, pop-up store addresses) and tracking address change history.

attributes.name: external_address_code
attributes.description: Address identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud address ID, SAP S/4HANA partner address number, Adobe Experience Platform profile address key). Enables cross-system reconciliation and deduplication during data integration.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent for the storage and processing of this address under GDPR Article 6 and CCPA requirements. Required for EU and California-resident customers. False triggers restricted processing workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoordinates assigned to this address. Rooftop indicates exact parcel-level accuracy; range_interpolated is street-level; geometric_center is centroid of a region; approximate is low-precision. Drives confidence scoring for proximity-based analytics and last-mile routing.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address record is currently active and eligible for use in order processing, wholesale delivery routing, and marketing communications. Inactive addresses are retained for historical order reference and audit purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Minimisation; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the customer's default billing address used for invoice generation and payment processing. Only one address per customer should have this flag set to true at any given time.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the customer's default shipping address for DTC order fulfillment. Pre-populated at checkout to streamline the purchase experience. Only one address per customer should have this flag set to true.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Customer-assigned friendly label for the address (e.g., 'Home', 'Office', 'NYC Warehouse', 'LA Showroom'). Displayed in the customer's address book in the DTC e-commerce storefront and CRM to facilitate address selection at checkout.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used for store proximity searches, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) routing, last-mile delivery optimization, and geographic clustering in customer analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location; WGS 84

attributes.name: line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and directional indicators. Required field for all address records used in order fulfillment, wholesale delivery routing, and store operations.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, unit, floor, building, or care-of information. Optional field used to capture additional location detail for B2C consumers and B2B wholesale accounts.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: line3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line used for international addresses requiring additional locality, district, or neighborhood detail. Primarily applicable for wholesale accounts in markets with complex addressing conventions.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used alongside latitude for geospatial analytics, delivery zone mapping, and proximity-based store operations reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location; WGS 84

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number associated with this address, formatted per E.164 international standard. Used by carriers for delivery notifications, failed delivery callbacks, and customs clearance contact for international wholesale shipments.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Telephone Numbering Plan; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: po_box_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a Post Office (PO) Box. PO Box addresses are ineligible for certain carrier services (e.g., UPS, FedEx ground) and require USPS routing. Used in carrier selection logic during order fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address. Used for carrier rate calculation, delivery zone assignment, tax jurisdiction mapping, and geographic segmentation in marketing analytics.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or business entity designated to receive deliveries at this address. May differ from the account holder name for gift shipments, B2B receiving departments, or wholesale distribution contacts.

attributes.name: residential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is classified as residential (True) or commercial/business (False). Carrier surcharges differ between residential and commercial deliveries; this flag drives accurate shipping cost calculation and carrier rate shopping.
attributes.references: UPS/FedEx Carrier Rate Guidelines; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: standardized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized to postal authority format (e.g., USPS CASS normalization, Canada Post, Royal Mail PAF). Standardized addresses improve carrier label accuracy and reduce failed delivery rates.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Canada Post; Royal Mail PAF

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code of the address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., CA, NY, ON, NSW). Used for tax calculation, shipping zone determination, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier assigned to this address for sales tax calculation purposes. Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and integrated tax engines (e.g., Vertex, Avalara) to determine applicable state, county, and municipal tax rates for DTC and wholesale transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Tax Jurisdiction; IFRS/GAAP; Vertex/Avalara Tax Standards

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the address location (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used for scheduling delivery windows, store pickup time slots, and localizing customer communications in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was last modified. Used to detect stale addresses requiring re-validation, support incremental data loads in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer, and comply with GDPR data accuracy obligations.

attributes.name: validation_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party address validation service used to verify this address (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate, Google Maps API). Supports audit trails for address quality management and vendor SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the address record as determined by address verification services (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate). Validated addresses reduce failed deliveries and carrier surcharges. Invalid addresses are flagged for customer outreach before order fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Address Quality Standards

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated by the address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is required based on data freshness policies and carrier compliance requirements.

products.name: loyalty_program

Captures program name, tier structure (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum), points earning rules, redemption thresholds, expiry policies, eligible channel flags (DTC, retail, e-commerce), program launch date, and program status. Serves as the reference template against which individual enrollments are tracked.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the loyalty program record. Serves as the primary key for all downstream enrollment, tier, and points tracking references.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id

attributes.name: partner_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Apparel loyalty programs frequently operate Partner Earn Programs where customers earn points through co-branded vendor partnerships (e.g., co-branded credit cards, partner retail earn). The loyalty_p

attributes.name: points_liability_gl_account_id
