Planners and account manag

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of inventory based on time in stock and seasonal relevance. Current season represents fresh merchandise, prior season is last season carryover, aged is multi-season old inventory, and clearance is marked for liquidation. Drives markdown strategies and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Merchandise Hierarchy

attributes.name: allocation_group
attributes.description: Classification code used to group inventory for allocation planning. Allocation groups define how inventory is distributed across channels and locations based on demand forecasts, store grades, and strategic priorities.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Strategy

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for future customer commitments, including current ATS plus expected inbound receipts minus planned outbound allocations. Used for forward order promising and pre-order management.

attributes.name: ats_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for new customer orders. Calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved quantity minus damaged/held quantity. This is the inventory pool visible to e-commerce and point-of-sale systems for order promising.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured. Required for customs compliance, trade agreement qualification, and consumer labeling per FTC textile labeling requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes, FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock position record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost. Supports multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: cycle_count_variance
attributes.description: Difference between system on-hand quantity and physical count quantity from the last cycle count. Positive values indicate physical surplus, negative values indicate shortage. Used to measure inventory accuracy and identify shrinkage.

attributes.name: damaged_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory identified as damaged, defective, or unsellable. This inventory is physically present but excluded from available-to-sell calculations pending disposition decisions (repair, return to vendor, or disposal).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the inventory should not be sold or used. Applicable to items with shelf life such as cosmetics, fragrances, or performance fabrics with time-sensitive treatments. Null for non-perishable apparel.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Dating

attributes.name: held_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity placed on administrative hold for quality inspection, regulatory compliance review, or investigation. Inventory is physically present but temporarily unavailable for sale or allocation.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International tariff classification code for the product. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and trade compliance. Essential for cross-border inventory movements and landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently being transported to this location from suppliers, manufacturing facilities, or other distribution points. Includes goods in-transit via ocean freight, air freight, and ground transportation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods in Transit

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory adjustment transaction at this location. Adjustments include cycle count corrections, damage write-offs, and system corrections. Used for audit trail and inventory accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Inventory Adjustment History

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count performed for this SKU at this location. Supports inventory accuracy monitoring and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Cycle Count Management

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory receipt at this location. Used to track inventory freshness and identify slow-moving stock.

attributes.name: last_sale_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sale or allocation of this SKU from this location. Used to identify dormant inventory and trigger markdown or transfer decisions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository - Transaction History

attributes.name: nos_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is designated as a never-out-of-stock item requiring continuous availability. NOS items receive priority replenishment and higher safety stock levels to prevent stockouts.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Replenishment Strategy

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical inventory quantity currently present at the location. Represents the actual count of units physically available in the facility, verified through cycle counts and RFID tracking.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the legal ownership of the inventory. Owned is company-owned stock, consignment is supplier-owned until sold, vendor-owned is VMI stock, and customer-owned is inventory held on behalf of wholesale customers.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers automatic replenishment. When on-hand quantity falls below the reorder point, a purchase order or transfer order is generated. Calculated as lead time demand plus safety stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Reorder Point Planning

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Strategy used to replenish inventory at this location. Automatic uses system-driven reorder points, manual requires planner intervention, VMI is supplier-managed, cross-dock bypasses storage, and drop-ship ships directly from supplier to customer.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory allocated to specific orders or commitments but not yet shipped. Includes customer orders, store allocations, and wholesale commitments that are pending fulfillment.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU at this location is tracked using RFID technology. RFID enables real-time inventory visibility, automated cycle counting, and improved inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory buffer maintained to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Safety stock levels are calculated based on demand volatility, lead time variability, and desired service level.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: Business date for which this stock position record represents the inventory state. Enables point-in-time inventory analysis and historical trend reporting. Updated daily through batch processing.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the inventory at this location. Available indicates sellable stock, reserved is allocated to orders, quarantine is under quality review, damaged is unsellable, in-transit is being received, and blocked is administratively restricted.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Inventory Status Management

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of inventory at this location. Represents the landed cost including product cost, freight, duties, and other acquisition costs. Used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock position record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any attribute in the record for change data capture and audit purposes.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Financial accounting classification for inventory valuation. Determines the general ledger accounts used for inventory asset and cost of goods sold postings. Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements.

attributes.name: vmi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is managed under a vendor-managed inventory program where the supplier monitors stock levels and triggers replenishment. VMI programs shift inventory management responsibility to suppliers.

attributes.name: wos
attributes.description: Number of weeks the current on-hand inventory will last based on forecasted demand. Calculated as on-hand quantity divided by average weekly sales rate. Key metric for inventory health and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Inventory Planning

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event including goods receipts, goods issues, inter-location transfers, stock adjustments, returns, write-offs, and corrections. Captures movement type, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination locations, reference document (PO, STO, RTV, delivery note, ASN), posting date, movement reason code, and adjustment approval reference. Serves as the single audit trail for all inventory quantity changes across all channels and locations.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Document / Goods Movement

attributes.description: Indicates whether the movement required managerial approval and the current approval state. Critical for adjustments, write-offs, and high-value movements.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the movement was approved. Part of the audit trail for compliance and internal controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the movement transaction. Required for audit trail on adjustments and write-offs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock movement record was first created in the database. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Business code for the destination location (e.g., warehouse code, store number, DC identifier). Human-readable identifier for reporting.

attributes.name: destination_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination location to enable location-type-specific analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document that triggered the movement (e.g., PO date, transfer order date, physical count date). May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock movement record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement transaction type for reporting and analytics. Groups detailed movement types into business-meaningful categories.

attributes.name: movement_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business document number for this inventory movement (e.g., goods receipt number, transfer order number, adjustment document number). Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: movement_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts and negative for issues. Expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock movement transaction. Indicates whether the movement has been finalized in inventory records or is still in process.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical inventory movement occurred or was recorded in the warehouse management system. Used for real-time inventory tracking and RFID event correlation.

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code classifying the nature of the inventory movement (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 311=Transfer Posting, 551=Scrapping, 601=Goods Issue for Delivery). Aligns with SAP movement type taxonomy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the movement. Used by warehouse staff and inventory analysts.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the inventory movement was posted to the ledger and inventory balances were updated. This is the official date of record for inventory valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the movement, especially for adjustments, returns, and write-offs (e.g., damaged, obsolete, cycle count correction, customer return, quality hold release).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the movement reason. Used when reason code alone is insufficient to explain the transaction.

attributes.name: reference_document_line_number
attributes.description: The line item number within the reference document that this movement relates to. Enables line-level traceability.

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: reference_document_type

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal of a previous transaction. True if this is a correcting entry that negates a prior movement.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The movement document number of the original transaction being reversed. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Enables audit trail of corrections.

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: source_location_code

attributes.name: source_location_type

attributes.name: stock_type

attributes.name: total_cost

attributes.name: accepted_quantity

attributes.name: carton_count
attributes.description: The total number of cartons or boxes received in this goods receipt transaction.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: The ISO standard container number for ocean freight shipments, if applicable.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The country where the goods were manufactured or produced, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for the cost values recorded in this goods receipt.

attributes.name: discrepancy_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the type of discrepancy found during goods receipt, if any.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the goods receipt document, which may differ from the posting date.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods are classified as hazardous materials requiring special handling.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The international customs classification code for the received goods, used for trade compliance and duty calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods that was originally ordered on the purchase order.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: The total number of pallets received in this goods receipt transaction.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory and financial ledgers. This is the official accounting date.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product being received, including style, color, and size details.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the goods receipt document. Used for tracking and reference across systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document Number

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction in the warehouse management workflow.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the physical receipt of goods occurred at the receiving location.

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the goods receipt transaction based on business purpose and origin.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of goods physically received and accepted at the facility.

attributes.name: receiving_location_code
attributes.description: Specific dock door, staging area, or receiving bay code where goods were physically received.

attributes.name: receiving_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the receiving personnel regarding condition, discrepancies, or special observations.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods that failed quality inspection and were rejected or placed on hold.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled after initial posting.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number that reversed this transaction, if applicable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Reversal Document Number

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods are tracked using RFID technology for enhanced visibility.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: The security seal number applied to the container or trailer to ensure tamper-proof delivery.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for individually tracked items, if applicable.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The unique product identifier for the item being received. Core business identifier for inventory tracking.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory stock status after receipt, determining availability for use or sale.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods require temperature-controlled storage and handling.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the goods receipt, calculated as received quantity multiplied by unit cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document Value

attributes.name: total_volume_cbm
attributes.description: The total volume of the received goods in cubic meters, used for warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total gross weight of the received goods in kilograms, including packaging.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The shipment tracking number provided by the carrier for tracing the delivery.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the received goods as recorded in the purchase order or invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Price

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the received quantity is measured (e.g., each, case, pallet, carton). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|CTN|KG|LB|YD|MT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The standard barcode identifier for the product, used for scanning and point-of-sale transactions.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The inventory valuation method applied to the received goods for financial accounting purposes.

attributes.name: parent_zone_id

attributes.name: active_from_date

attributes.name: active_to_date

attributes.name: aisle_range_end

attributes.name: aisle_range_start
attributes.description: Starting aisle identifier for the zone's physical location range within the warehouse.

attributes.name: available_capacity_units

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the zone capacity (e.g., pallets, bins, cubic meters).

attributes.name: capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the zone measured in units (pallets, bins, cubic meters, or square meters depending on zone type).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Frequency in days for conducting cycle counts within this zone to ensure inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Physical floor or level number within the facility where the zone is located.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is certified and equipped to handle hazardous materials according to regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent cycle count was performed in this zone.

attributes.name: next_cycle_count_date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special instructions, or comments related to the zone.

attributes.name: picking_method
attributes.description: Method used for order picking operations within the zone (e.g., manual, voice-directed, pick-to-light, automated).

attributes.name: replenishment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for inventory replenishment operations, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is equipped with RFID tracking technology for real-time inventory visibility.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification of the zone indicating access control requirements and monitoring level.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Physical storage method or infrastructure used within the zone.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone requires temperature control (refrigerated or frozen storage).

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature for the zone in degrees Celsius, applicable for temperature-controlled zones.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature for the zone in degrees Celsius, applicable for temperature-controlled zones.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Current utilization rate of the zone expressed as a percentage of total capacity.

attributes.name: zone_category
attributes.description: Storage environment or handling category for the zone, indicating special requirements or conditions.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the zone, used for operational reference and labeling (e.g., A1, RCV-01, PKG-ZONE).

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the zone including its purpose, special characteristics, and operational notes.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the zone (e.g., Receiving Zone, Picking Area A, Packing Station 1).

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the zone indicating availability for inventory operations.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the zone indicating its primary operational purpose within the warehouse or distribution center.

domains.name: merchandising
domains.description: Drives assortment planning, collection planning, OTB budgets, allocation strategies, pricing (MSRP, AUR, IMU, MMU, MU, MD), and GMROI optimization. Manages seasonal buy plans, pre-production planning, sell-through rate (STR) analysis, and merchandise financial planning via Oracle Retail Merchandising System and Anaplan.

products.name: assortment_plan
products.description: Master assortment planning entity capturing the seasonal merchandise assortment strategy by department, class, and subclass. Defines which styles, colorways, and sizes will be carried per channel and store cluster, aligned with OTB budgets and collection planning cycles. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System assortment planning module.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the assortment plan record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from Oracle Retail Merchandising System assortment planning module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Assortment plans are sized to support seasonal marketing campaigns. Merchandisers need campaign timing, expected lift, and channel mix to plan OTB budgets and style counts. This link enables campaign-

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster grouping used for assortment localization. Store clusters segment stores by volume tier, climate zone, or customer demographics to enable differentiated assortment depth and size curve optimization within Oracle Retail allocation module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent collection or line plan in Centric PLM or Oracle Retail. Links the assortment plan to the upstream collection planning and product design lifecycle managed in Centric PLM collection management module.
attributes.references: Centric PLM – Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: collection_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.collection_plan. Business justification: Assortment plans operationalize collection plans by defining the specific SKU-level assortments, store clusters, and channel strategies for a collection. The collection_plan defines the thematic visio

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.colorway. Business justification: Assortment plans track colorway_count_planned and drive color depth decisions per season. Planners select specific colorways for inclusion in an assortment. This FK enables colorway-level assortment a

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assortment plans are budgeted and tracked against cost centers for departmental P&L accountability. Merchandising teams must report plan performance (sales, margin, markdown) by cost center for financ

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Assortment plans target specific customer segments (Gen Z urban, affluent suburban, value-conscious families). Segment demographics and preferences drive category mix, price points, and style selectio

attributes.name: distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.distribution_center. Business justification: Receipt planning and DC allocation strategy: assortment plans must identify the receiving DC to enable inbound capacity planning and channel allocation. Apparel planners assign assortments to DCs to c

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Assortment plans contain markdown_budget_amount and IMU/MMU targets that map to GL accounts for markdown expense and inventory valuation. Finance uses GL account assignment on assortment plans for mar

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Assortment plans have department_id, class_id, subclass_id but no FK to merchandise_hierarchy master. Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant hie

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.otb_budget. Business justification: Assortment plans reference OTB budget amounts but have no FK to otb_budget master. Adding otb_budget_id FK normalizes budget reference and removes redundant otb_budget_amount. FK will reference mercha

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.factory. Business justification: Strategic assortment plans designate preferred factories based on capability, capacity, and cost structure. Drives sourcing strategy and factory capacity reservation for seasonal collections.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Assortment plans drive revenue and margin by channel/brand, tracked via profit centers. Financial reporting requires linking planned vs actual performance (sales, GMROI, STR) to profit centers for seg

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.rfq. Business justification: Assortment planning directly triggers RFQ issuance in apparel sourcing. Merchandisers finalize the assortment plan and sourcing issues RFQs against it. This link enables assortment-to-sourcing traceab

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Assortment plans are inherently seasonal; season_code exists but no FK to season master. Adding season_id FK normalizes season reference and removes redundant season_code. FK will reference merchandis

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.style. Business justification: Assortment planning is the core merchandising process of selecting which styles enter a season's range. Planners build style-level assortment decisions (range reviews, OTB by style, style count target

attributes.name: tna_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_tna_calendar. Business justification: Assortment plans drive TNA calendar creation — the TNA calendar tracks all milestones required to deliver the assortment on time. Buyers and planners monitor TNA calendars against assortment plan floo

attributes.name: vendor_cost_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.vendor_cost_quote. Business justification: Assortment planners validate IMU targets against vendor cost quotes during plan finalization. The assortment plan's imu_target_pct and aur_target are directly validated against vendor_cost_quote.fob_c

attributes.name: allocation_strategy
attributes.description: Inventory allocation methodology applied to this assortment plan. top_down = corporate-driven allocation to stores; bottom_up = store-requested replenishment; hybrid = combination approach; vmi = Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) where the supplier manages replenishment. Drives Oracle Retail allocation module configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan was formally approved and the OTB budget was committed. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status and triggers downstream PO generation and T&A calendar activation in SAP S/4HANA and Infor PLM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: aur_target
attributes.description: Planned Average Unit Retail (AUR) price for the assortment, representing the expected average selling price per unit across all styles and colorways in the plan. A key KPI in Anaplan merchandise financial planning used to project net sales and validate GMROI targets.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management

attributes.name: carry_forward_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of styles in this assortment plan that are carried forward from the prior season versus new introductions. A key collection planning metric used by merchants to balance newness investment against proven performers. Expressed as a percentage of total style count.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan – Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel for which this assortment plan is defined. Drives channel-specific assortment depth, pricing strategy, and OTB budget allocation. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) includes both retail stores and e-commerce. Values: retail (brick-and-mortar stores), ecommerce (Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital storefront), wholesale (partner accounts), dtc (combined direct channels), outlet (off-price stores).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: colorway_count_planned
attributes.description: Number of distinct colorways planned across all styles in the assortment. Colorway depth is a key assortment decision in apparel fashion, balancing color story cohesion against inventory fragmentation risk.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Centric PLM – Collection Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assortment plan record was first created in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this assortment plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency wholesale and DTC channels in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Anaplan.

attributes.name: imu_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Initial Markup (IMU) percentage for the assortment plan, expressed as a percentage of retail price. IMU = (Retail Price − Cost) / Retail Price × 100. Drives cost negotiation targets with suppliers and is a primary input to GMROI optimization in Anaplan merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: is_final_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the final approved version of the assortment plan (True) or a superseded draft/revision (False). Used to filter active plan versions in reporting and analytics without requiring version_number logic.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: labor_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers fulfilling this assortment plan must hold active FLA (Fair Labor Association) or WRAP (Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production) certification. Enforced during supplier onboarding in Infor PLM sourcing and SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA); Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP); ISO 45001

attributes.name: markdown_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total markdown (MD) budget allocated to this assortment plan for planned price reductions during the selling season. Markdown budget is a key input to MMU calculation and is managed in Anaplan merchandise financial planning and Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: mmu_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Maintained Markup (MMU) percentage after accounting for planned markdowns (MD), shrinkage, and employee discounts. MMU reflects the realized margin and is the primary profitability metric tracked in Anaplan merchandise financial planning alongside GMROI.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: msrp_max
attributes.description: Highest Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) point within the assortment plan's price architecture. Defines the ceiling price tier and is used alongside msrp_min to establish the price range strategy and IMU targets for the planned assortment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; FTC – Pricing Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: msrp_min
attributes.description: Lowest Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) point within the assortment plan's price architecture. Defines the entry price tier for the planned assortment and is used in IMU (Initial Markup) and AUR (Average Unit Retail) calculations in Oracle Retail Price Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Price Management; FTC – Pricing Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: otb_units_planned
attributes.description: Total number of units planned for procurement under this assortment plan's OTB budget. Used to calculate average unit cost, validate MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) compliance with suppliers, and drive purchase order (PO) generation in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the assortment plan, assigned by the Oracle Retail Merchandising System. Used by merchants and planners to reference the plan across systems (e.g., ORM-AP-2025-FALL-WMN-001). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan expires or the season closes. Marks the end of the active selling window and triggers end-of-season markdown (MD) and clearance processes. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this entity. Nullable for open-ended NOS assortments.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the assortment plan (e.g., 'Fall 2025 Women's Outerwear – North America DTC'). Used by merchants and planners to identify the plan in reporting dashboards and Anaplan merchandise financial planning views. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assortment plan becomes effective for in-season execution — i.e., the first floor-set or go-live date for the planned assortment. Used to align T&A (Time and Action) calendar milestones and pre-production (PP) sample review schedules. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT-role entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the assortment plan within the Oracle Retail Merchandising System workflow. Drives downstream OTB budget release, allocation activation, and collection planning milestones. Valid states: draft (initial creation), submitted (pending merchant approval), approved (OTB committed), active (in-season execution), closed (season ended), cancelled (plan voided). Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assortment plan by merchandise strategy. seasonal = time-bound seasonal collection; core = evergreen carry-forward styles; nos = Never Out of Stock (NOS) replenishment assortment; capsule = limited-edition capsule collection; collab = brand collaboration or licensed assortment. Drives OTB budget methodology and replenishment logic.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: replenishment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether styles within this assortment plan are eligible for automated replenishment (True) or are one-time buys with no replenishment (False). NOS (Never Out of Stock) assortments are always True. Drives replenishment trigger logic in Oracle Retail allocation and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year associated with the merchandise season (e.g., 2025). Used for year-over-year sell-through rate (STR) comparisons and GMROI trend analysis in Anaplan financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: size_range
attributes.description: Planned size range for the assortment (e.g., 'XS-3XL', '00-24', '5-13'). Defines the inclusive size offering for the plan and is used to validate size curve alignment with store cluster demographics and FTC textile labeling requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; FTC – Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this assortment plan record originated. ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; ANAPLAN = Anaplan Merchandise Planning; CENTRIC = Centric PLM; MANUAL = manually entered override. Used for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan; Centric PLM

attributes.name: sourcing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code of the primary manufacturing/sourcing country for this assortment plan (e.g., BGD=Bangladesh, VNM=Vietnam, CHN=China). Used for landed duty paid (LDP) cost modeling, HS Code tariff classification, and GSP eligibility assessment in SAP S/4HANA MM and Infor PLM sourcing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Infor PLM – Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM; FTC – Country of Origin Labeling

attributes.name: str_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Sell-Through Rate (STR) for the assortment plan, expressed as a percentage of units sold versus units received. STR = (Units Sold / Units Received) × 100. Used to set end-of-season inventory clearance expectations and validate OTB buy depth in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Anaplan – Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: style_count_planned
attributes.description: Number of distinct styles (parent product silhouettes) planned in the assortment, independent of colorway or size. Style count is a key assortment breadth metric used by merchants to balance newness versus carry-forward depth in collection planning.

attributes.name: sustainability_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assortment plan requires sustainability certification compliance (True) such as GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), OEKO-TEX Standard 100, or BCI (Better Cotton Initiative). Drives supplier qualification requirements in Infor PLM sourcing and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); OEKO-TEX Standard 100; Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); ISO 14001

attributes.name: total_sku_count_planned
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Count Planned
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) planned within this assortment, representing the breadth of the assortment. Includes all style-color-size combinations. Used to assess assortment productivity and compare planned vs. actual SKU rationalization outcomes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the assortment plan record in the source system or Silver Layer. Tracks plan revisions, OTB reforecasts, and status transitions. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; ISO 8601

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the assortment plan, starting at 1. Incremented each time the plan is revised (e.g., OTB reforecast, style additions/deletions). Enables version history tracking and comparison of plan iterations in Oracle Retail and Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Assortment Planning Module; Anaplan – Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: wos_target
attributes.description: Target Weeks of Supply (WOS) for the assortment plan, representing the planned number of weeks of inventory coverage at the expected rate of sale. WOS = On-Hand Units / Average Weekly Sales. Used to calibrate buy depth and replenishment triggers in Oracle Retail allocation module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System – Allocation Module; Anaplan – Demand Planning

products.name: collection_plan
products.description: Seasonal collection planning master record defining the thematic merchandise collection (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, Resort, Pre-Fall) including line architecture, style count targets, price tier distribution, and channel allocation strategy. Managed in Centric PLM and Anaplan, bridging creative direction with commercial planning.

attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

App

Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant department_id. FK will ref

attributes.name: production_factory_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Collection plans are seasonal by nature; season_code and season_year exist but no FK to season master. Adding season_id FK normalizes season reference and removes redundant attributes. FK will referen

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business stakeholder (e.g., VP Merchandising, Creative Director) who formally approved this collection plan. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collection plan received formal business approval. Marks the transition from planning to execution phase and triggers downstream T&A calendar activities.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: channel_allocation_strategy
attributes.description: Planned channel distribution strategy for this collection. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) First = prioritize own retail and e-commerce; Wholesale First = prioritize wholesale partners; Balanced = equal distribution. Drives allocation decisions in Oracle Retail and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: collection_theme
attributes.description: Descriptive thematic concept or creative narrative for the collection (e.g., 'Urban Nomad', 'Coastal Luxe', 'Performance Elevated'). Guides design direction, marketing storytelling, and visual merchandising.

attributes.name: collection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collection by commercial strategy. Mainline = full seasonal assortment; Capsule = focused limited assortment; Collaboration = co-branded with external partner; Limited_Edition = restricted volume; Carry_Over = NOS (Never Out of Stock) continuity styles; Core = foundational basics.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this collection plan record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary planning amounts in this collection plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: design_brief_url
attributes.description: URL or document path to the creative design brief for this collection plan stored in Centric PLM or a connected document management system. Provides access to mood boards, color palettes, and thematic direction.

attributes.name: dtc_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Planned percentage of total collection inventory allocated to Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels (own retail stores and e-commerce). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6000 = 60%). Used in channel allocation planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: first_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date of the first merchandise delivery to distribution centers or stores for this collection. Anchors the T&A (Time and Action) calendar and drives pre-production planning milestones.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; SAP S/4HANA PP; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Primary gender demographic target for this collection plan. Drives assortment architecture, sizing standards, and marketing segmentation. Aligns with Oracle Retail merchandise hierarchy gender classification.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: imu_target_pct
attributes.description: Target Initial Markup (IMU) percentage for the collection, representing the planned markup from cost to MSRP at the time of first receipt. A foundational pricing metric in merchandise financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date of the final merchandise delivery for this collection. Defines the end of the inbound supply window and informs markdown timing and end-of-season clearance planning.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; SAP S/4HANA PP; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this collection plan record. Supports change tracking, incremental data loading, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: line_architecture_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the line architecture document associated with this collection plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Tracks iterative changes to style count, category mix, and price tier targets during the planning process in Centric PLM.

attributes.name: otb_lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OTB (Open-to-Buy) budget for this collection plan is locked and committed. After this date, budget changes require formal approval. Managed in Anaplan Merchandise Planning.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collection plan record. Drives workflow routing in Centric PLM and Anaplan. Draft = initial creation; In_Review = pending creative/commercial sign-off; Approved = locked for production; Active = in-season execution; Closed = season ended; Cancelled = plan abandoned.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: planned_aur_amount
attributes.description: Planned Average Unit Retail (AUR) price for the collection in the planning currency. Represents the expected average selling price per unit across all styles and channels, used in revenue and unit planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: planned_cogs_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Amount
attributes.description: Total planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for this collection plan in the planning currency. Used to calculate planned gross margin and GMROI targets in Anaplan financial planning.

attributes.name: planned_gross_margin_pct
attributes.description: Planned gross margin percentage for the collection, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6200 = 62.00%). Derived from planned revenue and COGS targets; stored as a planning input in Anaplan to support IMU (Initial Markup) and MMU (Maintained Markup) targets.
attributes.references: Anaplan — Merchandise Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total planned net sales revenue target for this collection plan in the planning currency. Used as the top-line financial KPI for merchandise financial planning and GMROI optimization in Anaplan.

attributes.name: planned_str_pct
attributes.description: Target Sell-Through Rate (STR) for the collection, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Represents the planned percentage of received inventory expected to sell at full price or planned markdown cadence before end of season.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: price_tier_distribution
attributes.description: Planned percentage distribution of styles across price tiers (e.g., 'Entry:20%|Mid:50%|Premium:30%'). Guides assortment architecture to balance accessibility and margin. Stored as a structured string; detailed tier breakdowns managed in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: product_category_mix
attributes.description: Planned distribution of styles across product categories within the collection (e.g., 'Tops:35%|Bottoms:25%|Outerwear:20%|Footwear:15%|Accessories:5%'). Stored as a structured string; detailed breakdowns managed in Anaplan and Centric PLM.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: range_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the formal range review meeting where the collection plan is presented to commercial and creative stakeholders for approval. A key milestone in the T&A (Time and Action) calendar.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Classification of the retail season type for this collection plan. Drives line architecture, delivery cadence, and OTB budget allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Spring/Summer|Fall/Winter|Resort|Pre-Fall|Holiday|Cruise — promote to reference product if additional seasons are added]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Centric PLM — Collection Management

attributes.name: sell_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the collection is retired from active selling. Triggers end-of-season markdown strategy and clearance allocation. Effective-until date for the collection's commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: sell_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the collection becomes available for sale to consumers across channels. Aligns with marketing campaign launch and store floor set dates. Effective-from date for the collection's commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: sustainability_rating
attributes.description: Planned sustainability certification tier for the collection based on material sourcing and production standards. Reflects compliance with GOTS, BCI, OEKO-TEX, and FLA standards. Drives supplier selection and marketing claims.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); OEKO-TEX Standard 100; Fair Labor Association (FLA); WRAP

attributes.name: sustainable_material_pct
attributes.description: Planned percentage of styles in the collection using certified sustainable materials (organic cotton, recycled polyester, BCI cotton, etc.). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 = 40%). Supports ESG reporting and FTC textile labeling compliance.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); FTC — Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; ISO 14001

attributes.name: target_market_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic market region(s) for which this collection is planned (e.g., 'NAM', 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'GLOBAL'). Influences sizing standards, labeling requirements, and channel allocation strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAM|EMEA|APAC|LATAM|GLOBAL|DOMESTIC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; CPSC — Product Safety Standards; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: target_sku_count
attributes.description: Planned total number of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) across all styles, colors, and sizes in this collection. Drives warehouse capacity planning, OTB budget, and assortment depth decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Assortment Planning; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: target_style_count
attributes.description: Planned number of distinct styles (SKU families) to be included in this collection. A key line architecture metric used to manage assortment breadth and design resource allocation in Centric PLM.
attributes.references: Centric PLM — Collection Management; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

attributes.name: wholesale_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Planned percentage of total collection inventory allocated to wholesale and distribution partners. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 = 40%). Complements DTC allocation to sum to 100% of planned inventory.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Allocation; Anaplan — Merchandise Planning

products.name: otb_budget
products.description: Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget master record tracking the planned versus actual merchandise purchasing budget by department, class, season, and month. Captures beginning-of-month (BOM) inventory at retail and cost, planned sales, planned markdowns, planned receipts, actual receipts consumed by buy plans, ending inventory targets, and remaining open-to-buy dollars. Includes weekly OTB recalculation triggers and variance thresholds for merchant alerts. Core financial control mechanism preventing over-buying and ensuring inventory investment aligns with sales plans. Managed in Anaplan with Oracle Retail integration.

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the otb_budget data product.

The MFP sets top-down financial targets (planned sales, COGS, GM%, IMU%, markdown budget) for a season/depar

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: OTB budgets have department_id, class_id but no FK to merchandise_hierarchy master. Adding merchandise_hierarchy_id FK normalizes merchandise classification and removes redundant hierarchy attributes.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: OTB budgets drive planned receipts that directly impact divisional P&L. Finance requires profit center assignment on OTB budgets to reconcile planned inventory investment against divisional gross marg

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the channel or location (e.g., retail store, e-commerce, wholesale) for which this OTB budget is defined. Enables channel-level OTB tracking across DTC and wholesale.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise season (e.g., Spring/Summer 2025, Fall/Winter 2025) to which this OTB budget belongs. Drives seasonal buy plan alignment in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: actual_receipts_cost
attributes.description: The actual merchandise receipt value at cost consumed by confirmed purchase orders (POs) for the OTB budget month to date. Used for open-to-buy cost-basis tracking and cash flow management. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: actual_receipts_retail
attributes.description: The actual merchandise receipt value at retail price consumed by confirmed buy plans and purchase orders (POs) for the OTB budget month to date. Compared against planned receipts to compute remaining OTB. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP S/4HANA MM; Anaplan

attributes.name: alert_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The variance threshold percentage (e.g., 0.10 = 10%) at which a merchant alert is triggered for this OTB budget record. When actual receipts or sales deviate from plan by more than this threshold, an alert is raised for merchant review and OTB recalculation.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: alert_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merchant alert has been triggered for this OTB budget record due to variance exceeding the defined alert threshold. True = alert active and pending merchant review; False = within acceptable variance range.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: anaplan_model_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Anaplan model and workspace from which this OTB budget record was sourced. Enables traceability back to the originating Anaplan planning model for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the merchant or planning manager who approved this OTB budget record. Required for financial control governance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; FLA — Labor Standards Compliance; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this OTB budget record was formally approved by the merchant or planning manager. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status and authorizes buying activity.

attributes.name: bom_inventory_cost
attributes.description: The value of on-hand inventory at cost (landed duty paid) at the beginning of the OTB budget month. Used for COGS tracking and gross margin analysis. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: bom_inventory_retail
attributes.description: The value of on-hand inventory at retail (selling) price at the beginning of the OTB budget month. Used as the opening inventory position in the OTB formula: OTB = Planned EOM Inventory + Planned Sales + Planned Markdowns - BOM Inventory. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: budget_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1–12) to which this OTB budget record applies. OTB is recalculated monthly; this field identifies the specific planning month within the budget year.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the OTB budget record. Draft: under construction by planner. Submitted: pending merchant approval. Approved: authorized for buying. Locked: frozen for the period. Closed: period ended. Revised: re-opened for adjustment.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version number of the OTB budget record, incremented each time the budget is revised or re-submitted. Supports version control and audit trail for merchandise financial planning changes in Anaplan.

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year (e.g., 2025) to which this OTB budget record applies. Used for annual merchandise financial planning and year-over-year variance analysis.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The distribution channel for which this OTB budget is defined. Retail: physical stores. E-Commerce: digital storefront. Wholesale: B2B partners. DTC (Direct-to-Consumer): brand-owned channels. Outlet: off-price stores.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTB budget record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with IFRS/GAAP record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this OTB budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent currency denomination across retail and cost values.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The last date through which this OTB budget record is effective. Typically the last day of the budget month. After this date, the budget is closed and actuals are reconciled.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The first date from which this OTB budget record is effective and binding for merchandise purchasing decisions. Typically the first day of the budget month.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: eom_inventory_target_retail
attributes.description: The planned ending inventory value at retail price at the end of the OTB budget month. This is the target stock position that feeds into the next month's BOM inventory and is a key driver of the OTB formula. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: imu_percent
attributes.description: The Initial Markup (IMU) percentage applied to convert retail values to cost values for this OTB budget period. IMU = (Retail - Cost) / Retail. Used to derive OTB at cost from OTB at retail and to assess margin health.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: last_recalculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the OTB budget values were last recalculated in Anaplan. Supports audit trail and ensures merchants are working with the most current OTB position.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the merchant or planner to document assumptions, exceptions, or rationale for OTB budget decisions (e.g., promotional event impact, supply chain disruption, vendor delay). Supports audit trail and planning transparency.

attributes.name: otb_cost
attributes.description: The remaining open-to-buy dollars at cost available for the OTB budget month. Derived from OTB at retail adjusted by the Initial Markup (IMU) percentage. Used for purchase order (PO) commitment and cash flow management. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: otb_retail
attributes.description: The remaining open-to-buy dollars at retail price available for the OTB budget month. Calculated as: Planned EOM Inventory + Planned Sales + Planned Markdowns - BOM Inventory - Actual Receipts at Retail. A positive value indicates buying capacity; negative indicates over-bought. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: The planned Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) for the OTB budget period. GMROI = Gross Margin / Average Inventory at Cost. Measures the return generated per dollar of inventory investment. Used to prioritize department and class-level OTB allocations.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_markdown_retail
attributes.description: The planned markdown (MD) dollar amount at retail for the OTB budget month. Markdowns reduce the retail inventory value and are a key input to the OTB formula and Maintained Markup (MMU) calculation. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_receipts_cost
attributes.description: The total planned merchandise receipt value at cost (landed duty paid / LDP) for the OTB budget month. Used for cash flow planning, purchase order (PO) commitment tracking, and COGS forecasting. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_receipts_retail
attributes.description: The total planned merchandise receipt value at retail price for the OTB budget month. Represents the maximum retail value of goods the merchant plans to receive. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: planned_sales_retail
attributes.description: The planned net sales revenue at retail price for the OTB budget month, as defined in the merchandise financial plan. Drives the OTB calculation and sell-through rate (STR) targets. Expressed in the operating currency.
attributes.references: Anaplan Merchandise Financial Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: planned_sales_units
