attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record (shipping_cost_amount, retail_value_amount). Supports multi-currency operations across international retail markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Multi-Currency Reporting

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code capturing the type of exception encountered during the ship-from-store fulfillment process. Used for exception management workflows, store associate coaching, and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ITEM_NOT_FOUND|DAMAGED_ITEM|LABEL_FAILURE|CARRIER_PICKUP_MISSED|ADDRESS_INVALID|SYSTEM_TIMEOUT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fulfillment_request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ship-from-store fulfillment request, used for cross-system traceability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Manhattan Associates WMS, and SAP S/4HANA SD. Corresponds to the outbound delivery document number in WMS. [BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Document

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ship-from-store fulfillment request, tracking progression from assignment through pick, pack, ship, and delivery. EXCEPTION indicates a fulfillment problem requiring intervention. [LIFECYCLE_STATUS category] [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|ASSIGNED|PICKING|PACKED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED|EXCEPTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Order Status; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Status

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment channel that triggered this ship-from-store request. ECOM_DTC = Direct-to-Consumer e-commerce order; BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store; WHOLESALE = wholesale partner order; STORE_TRANSFER = inter-store inventory transfer; SHIP_TO_STORE = ship to alternate store for customer pickup. [CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped_quantity equals the ordered_quantity, confirming complete fulfillment. Enables decomposed OTIF analysis separating fullness from timeliness dimensions.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Fill Rate KPI

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for store associates or fulfillment managers to capture operational notes, exception details, or special handling instructions related to this ship-from-store request. Not used for structured analytics.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order was shipped on or before the promised_ship_date, independent of quantity completeness. Enables decomposed OTIF analysis separating timeliness from fullness dimensions.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — SLA Compliance; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The number of units of the SKU requested for fulfillment in this ship-from-store record. Represents the demand quantity as received from the originating sales order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Order Quantity; Manhattan Associates WMS — Requested Quantity

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ship-from-store fulfillment met the OTIF (On Time In Full) standard — shipped on or before the promised_ship_date with the full shipped_quantity equal to ordered_quantity. Core KPI for omnichannel fulfillment performance and store capacity management.
attributes.references: OTIF Industry Standard; Manhattan Associates WMS — Fulfillment KPI

attributes.name: pack_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the packing of the ship-from-store order was completed and the parcel was sealed and labeled. Used to measure pack cycle time and overall fulfillment throughput.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pack Completion Timestamp

attributes.name: package_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight of the packed parcel in kilograms as measured at the store packing station. Used for carrier rate calculation, dimensional weight billing reconciliation, and shipping cost allocation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Parcel Weight; ISO 80000-4 Mass Measurement

attributes.name: partial_fulfillment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that the shipped_quantity is less than the ordered_quantity, resulting in a partial shipment. Triggers downstream processes such as backorder creation, customer notification, or alternate store sourcing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Partial Delivery; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: pick_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the store associate completed the pick operation for this fulfillment request. Used to measure pick cycle time and store fulfillment throughput performance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pick Completion Timestamp

attributes.name: picked_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of units physically picked from store inventory during the pick operation. May differ from ordered_quantity due to inventory discrepancies, shrinkage, or partial fulfillment scenarios.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Pick Confirmation Quantity

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer-facing delivery date committed at the time of order placement. Distinct from promised_ship_date; used for customer experience SLA tracking and carrier service level selection.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management Delivery Promise

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: The committed date by which the store must ship the order to meet the customer-facing delivery promise. Used as the SLA (Service Level Agreement) target for OTIF measurement and store performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Delivery Promise; SAP S/4HANA SD Schedule Line

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ship-from-store fulfillment request was created and assigned to the store, representing the principal business event time. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) SLA measurement and store capacity planning. [BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Receipt Timestamp; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: retail_value_amount
attributes.description: The total retail selling value (AUR × shipped_quantity) of the merchandise shipped in this fulfillment request, at the current selling price. Used for store-level revenue attribution, omnichannel sales reporting, and shrinkage risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Net Value; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU was verified using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) scanning during the pick or pack operation. Supports inventory accuracy, shrinkage reduction, and omnichannel fulfillment quality assurance programs.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository — RFID Integration; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: ship_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the parcel was tendered to the carrier and the shipment was confirmed. Used as the primary timestamp for OTIF (On Time In Full) compliance measurement against the SLA target.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Ship Confirmation; SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue Posting

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of units packed and handed to the carrier for shipment. Used in OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation and sell-through rate (STR) reporting at the store level.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Ship Confirmation; SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue

attributes.name: shipping_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual carrier shipping cost incurred for this ship-from-store parcel in the transaction currency. Used for omnichannel fulfillment cost analysis, store P&L allocation, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Allocation; Manhattan Associates WMS — Freight Cost

attributes.name: shipping_label_reference
attributes.description: Internal identifier for the shipping label generated by the WMS for this parcel. Used to reconcile label costs, void labels on cancellations, and audit label generation events in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this ship-from-store fulfillment request. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across the omnichannel technology stack.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP S/4HANA WM; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: store_inventory_deducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped_quantity has been successfully deducted from the store's on-hand inventory in the WMS and ERP systems. Used to detect inventory reconciliation failures and ensure ATS (Available to Sell) accuracy.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Inventory Adjustment; SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Issue

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned parcel tracking number generated at the time of shipment label creation. Used for customer shipment visibility, carrier claim management, and post-ship exception resolution.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Parcel Tracking; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Tracking

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ship-from-store record was last modified in the data platform, capturing status transitions, carrier updates, or exception resolutions. [RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category]

products.name: return_transaction
products.description: Records customer merchandise returns processed at a retail store, including original POS transaction reference, return reason code (fit, quality defect, changed mind, wrong item), SKU, quantity, condition assessment, refund method (original tender, store credit, exchange), processing associate, and disposition routing (restock to floor, return to vendor/RTV, damage write-off, outlet transfer). Supports return rate analysis by reason, RTV processing workflows, loss prevention flagging of serial returners, and warranty claim tracking.

attributes.name: return_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for return_transaction

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Apparel retail returns generate credit memos or adjustments against the original AR invoice. Finance requires this link for revenue reversal, tax credit processing, and customer account reconciliation

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Return transactions require GL journal entries for revenue reversal, COGS reversal, and sales tax adjustments. Apparel retail financial close process mandates every return be posted to the general led

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.loyalty_program. Business justification: Return processing in apparel retail requires reversing loyalty points against the specific program. return_transaction.loyalty_points_reversed column exists but no FK to loyalty_program. Loyalty opera

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Point of Sale (POS) Transaction ID
attributes.description: Reference to the original POS transaction at which the merchandise being returned was purchased. Used to validate return eligibility, original tender, and purchase date. Maps to store.pos_transaction.store_pos_transaction_id.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: primary_return_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being returned. Enables return rate analysis by product, style, color, and size.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Master

attributes.name: processing_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales associate or cashier who processed the return transaction at the Point of Sale (POS). Used for associate performance tracking and loss prevention audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Employee Master

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer initiating the return. Used for loss prevention serial-returner flagging, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) history, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) analytics.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where the return was processed. Links to the store master record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Store Master

attributes.name: return_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: In apparel fashion, in-store returns that require RTV (Return to Vendor) or DC consolidation generate an outbound shipment. Linking return_transaction to the resulting shipment enables RTV logistics t

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.rma. Business justification: Store returns with disposition_code requiring vendor return (RTV) create RMA records for vendor credit and quality tracking. Business process: defective/damaged returns trigger RMA workflow for vendor

attributes.name: sales_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.sales_order_line. Business justification: In-store returns of online order items must trace to the specific sales_order_line for accurate refund calculation, inventory disposition, and return analytics by product. return_transaction has rma_i

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Quality-driven returns require traceability to originating sourcing PO for vendor chargebacks, quality claims, RTV authorization, and supplier performance scorecards. Essential for cost recovery and v

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Return-to-Vendor (RTV) processing requires knowing which vendor receives defective/excess merchandise. The existing rtv_authorization_number column confirms RTV operations occur; vendor_id enables ven

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Fiscal or retail business date on which the return is recorded for daily sales reconciliation and End of Month (EOM) reporting. May differ from return_timestamp date for late-night transactions.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the return transaction record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this return transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: days_since_purchase
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the original purchase date and the return transaction date. Used for return policy compliance validation and return window analytics. Stored as a business attribute to avoid repeated calculation in reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Internal Return Policy

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Routing decision for the physical merchandise after the return is processed. 'restock_floor' returns item to selling floor inventory; 'rtv' initiates Return to Vendor (RTV) workflow; 'damage_writeoff' records as shrinkage/loss; 'outlet_transfer' routes to outlet channel; 'quarantine' holds for quality inspection or loss prevention review.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Return Disposition; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: item_condition_code
attributes.description: Condition assessment of the returned merchandise as evaluated by the processing associate at Point of Sale (POS). Drives disposition routing decisions: new_with_tags and new_without_tags are eligible for floor restock; worn and damaged route to outlet transfer or damage write-off; defective routes to Return to Vendor (RTV).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Return Condition Codes; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: loss_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return transaction has been flagged by the loss prevention system as suspicious, such as for serial returner behavior, wardrobing, or return fraud patterns. Triggers loss prevention review workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Policy; FLA Labor Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_points_reversed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points deducted from the customer's account as a result of the return transaction. Reverses the points originally earned on the purchase.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Loyalty Management; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a store manager override was required to approve this return transaction, such as when the return falls outside standard policy (e.g., beyond return window, missing receipt, high-value item). Critical for loss prevention monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Override Management; Internal Loss Prevention Policy

attributes.name: original_order_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the original purchase was made. Enables cross-channel return analysis (e.g., online purchase returned in-store) and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) return rate reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: original_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date on which the merchandise was originally purchased. Used to calculate days since purchase for return policy eligibility validation and warranty period determination.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: original_tender_type
attributes.description: Payment method used in the original purchase transaction. Required to determine refund eligibility and routing when refund_method is 'original_tender'. Sourced from the original POS transaction record.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Management; PCI DSS

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units of the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being returned in this transaction. Used for inventory restock calculations and return rate analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Receipt number printed on the return transaction receipt provided to the customer. Used for customer service inquiries and return transaction lookup.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Receipt Management

attributes.name: receipt_presented_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer presented the original purchase receipt at the time of return. Affects return policy eligibility, refund method options, and loss prevention risk scoring.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management; Internal Loss Prevention Policy

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund is issued to the customer. 'original_tender' returns funds to the original payment instrument; 'store_credit' issues a store credit balance; 'exchange' swaps for another item; 'gift_card' issues a gift card; 'cash' provides cash refund regardless of original tender.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Tender Management; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: register_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) register or workstation at which the return was processed. Used for daily cash reconciliation and loss prevention audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Register Master

attributes.name: return_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the return was initiated or processed. Supports omnichannel return analytics including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) returns and ship-from-store returns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Order Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: return_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount that was applied to the original purchase and is being reversed or credited back as part of the return. Ensures accurate net refund calculation.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross merchandise value of the returned items before any adjustments, calculated as unit_retail_price multiplied by quantity_returned. Used for return rate and Sell-Through Rate (STR) impact analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount refunded to the customer after applying discounts and taxes. Equals return_gross_amount minus return_discount_amount plus return_tax_amount. Used for financial reconciliation and daily sales reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: return_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable return authorization number printed on the return receipt and used for customer-facing communication, warranty claims, and Return to Vendor (RTV) processing. Generated by SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR).
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific return policy applied to this transaction (e.g., standard 30-day, extended holiday, loyalty member extended window, final sale). Determines return eligibility and refund method options.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Policy Management; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code selected by the associate at Point of Sale (POS) explaining why the customer is returning the merchandise. Drives return rate analysis by reason, warranty claim routing, and Return to Vendor (RTV) eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fit|quality_defect|changed_mind|wrong_item|damaged_in_transit|warranty_claim|gift_return|size_exchange|color_exchange|duplicate_order — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Return Reason Codes; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: return_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the associate or customer elaborating on the return reason beyond the standardized return_reason_code. Supports qualitative analysis and warranty claim documentation.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return transaction workflow. 'pending' indicates awaiting manager approval; 'approved' indicates authorized but refund not yet issued; 'completed' indicates fully processed with refund issued; 'rejected' indicates denied by loss prevention or policy; 'voided' indicates cancelled after initial entry.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Return Management

attributes.name: return_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount being refunded to the customer as part of the return transaction. Calculated based on the applicable tax jurisdiction and original tax paid.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; Tax Jurisdiction Compliance

attributes.name: return_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the return transaction was processed at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal. Principal business event timestamp for the return. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - POS Transaction

attributes.name: rfid_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned item's Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag was scanned and verified during the return process. Supports inventory accuracy and loss prevention authentication.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - RFID Integration; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: rtv_authorization_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued Return to Vendor (RTV) authorization number assigned when disposition_code is 'rtv'. Required for vendor credit processing and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction matching with the supplier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Return Management; EDI Standards

attributes.name: serial_returner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer associated with this return has been identified as a serial returner based on return frequency thresholds. Distinct from loss_prevention_flag which covers broader fraud patterns. Used for targeted loss prevention intervention.
attributes.references: Internal Loss Prevention Policy; GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making)

attributes.name: store_credit_voucher_number
attributes.description: Voucher or store credit account number issued to the customer when refund_method is 'store_credit'. Used for store credit redemption tracking and liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) - Gift Card and Store Credit Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code applicable to the return transaction for tax reversal calculation. Ensures correct tax credit is applied based on the store's geographic tax authority.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Tax Management; FTC Textile Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Original selling price per unit at the time of the initial purchase transaction, used as the basis for refund calculation. Aligns with Average Unit Retail (AUR) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode of the returned item as scanned at Point of Sale (POS). Used for item verification, inventory reconciliation, and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) cross-validation.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC Standard; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the return transaction record was last modified in the data platform, such as when disposition is updated or loss prevention flag is set. Used for change data capture and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: warranty_claim_number
attributes.description: Warranty claim reference number assigned when the return is associated with a product defect or warranty issue. Links the return to the warranty claim tracking workflow in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Warranty Management; CPSC Product Safety Standards

products.name: visual_merchandising_plan
products.description: Captures visual merchandising directives, planogram assignments, and compliance audit results for a store or store cluster. Includes fixture layout, product placement by zone/wall/table/window, seasonal collection display guidelines, mannequin styling instructions, signage specifications, compliance deadline, audit scores, non-compliant zones, and corrective action tracking. After merge with vm_compliance_check, this entity is SSOT for both the plan and its execution verification. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System and Centric PLM collection management.

attributes.name: visual_merchandising_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the visual merchandising plan record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.brand. Business justification: VM plans in multi-brand apparel retail are brand-specific (brand shop-in-shop layouts, brand wall assignments). Brand-level VM planning governs brand identity compliance, co-op marketing obligations,

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: VM plans execute campaign creative in-store: window displays for seasonal launches, mannequin styling for brand campaigns. Direct operational link between marketing creative direction and store visual

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_cluster. Business justification: VM plans in apparel are created at store cluster level first (cluster VM standard), then applied to individual stores. Cluster-level VM planning is a named process — visual merchandising standards are

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product collection or capsule whose display guidelines are governed by this plan. Sourced from Centric PLM collection management.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Apparel VM plans are designed for specific customer segments (e.g., athleisure millennials, luxury VIPs). target_demographic is a denormalized plain-text field. FK to customer.segment enables VM compl

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.event. Business justification: In-store VM plans are directly driven by marketing events (product launches, seasonal trunk shows, VIP nights). VM directors plan fixture layouts and mannequin styling around specific events. Apparel

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: VM plans in apparel are scoped to merchandise hierarchy nodes (e.g., 'Women's Dresses floor set for Spring'). Hierarchy-based floor set planning is a named VM process — compliance audits and product p

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.planogram. Business justification: A visual merchandising plan is executed against a specific planogram — this is a core business relationship in apparel retail. The visual_merchandising_plan table currently stores planogram_document_u

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store or store cluster to which this visual merchandising plan applies. Links to the store master entity.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations)

attributes.name: sample_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sample_request. Business justification: VM teams in apparel request pre-production or salesman samples via sourcing's sample_request process to confirm display product for window and floor installations. VM planners must verify sample appro

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail season (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter) for which this visual merchandising plan is designed. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System season calendar.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.style. Business justification: VM plans in apparel retail specify which styles are featured on mannequins, fixtures, and walls. Style-level VM planning drives floor set execution, compliance audits, and seasonal resets — a core app

attributes.name: vm_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the visual merchandising associate or field representative responsible for executing and auditing this plan at the store level. References the workforce/associate master.
attributes.references: Workday HCM (Human Resources); Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who formally approved this visual merchandising plan for publication and distribution to stores.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the visual merchandising plan was formally approved and authorized for distribution to store teams.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Governance Policy

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the most recent visual merchandising compliance audit was conducted for this plan.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric compliance audit score (0.00–100.00) assigned during the most recent VM compliance audit. Reflects the degree to which the store has executed the plan per directive. Populated after merge with vm_compliance_check.
attributes.references: Internal VM Compliance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the compliance audit for this visual merchandising plan. Drives corrective action workflows and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: collection_display_guidelines
attributes.description: Narrative description of the seasonal collection display guidelines, including brand story, lifestyle theme, hero product callouts, and cross-category adjacency rules. Sourced from Centric PLM collection management.
attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: color_blocking_direction
attributes.description: Prescribed color sequencing strategy for merchandise presentation on fixtures and walls. Drives visual consistency across stores within the same cluster.

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: The hard deadline by which store teams must complete the floor set and submit photographic or audit evidence of compliance. May precede the effective_start_date to allow pre-opening setup.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA); Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the store team must resolve all non-compliant zones and resubmit evidence for re-audit. Drives escalation workflows in SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions prescribed by the VM field team or regional manager to remediate non-compliant zones identified during the audit.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action is required following the compliance audit. Set to True when audit_status is 'failed' or non_compliant_zone_count exceeds the acceptable threshold.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visual merchandising plan record was first created in the source system (Oracle Retail Merchandising System or Centric PLM). Audit trail field.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the visual merchandising plan expires and the floor set is expected to be transitioned to the next plan. Nullable for open-ended or permanent plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the visual merchandising plan becomes active and store teams are required to have the floor set completed. Drives compliance deadline tracking.

attributes.name: fixture_layout_code

attributes.name: mannequin_count

attributes.name: mannequin_styling_notes

attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: non_compliant_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of merchandising zones found to be non-compliant during the most recent audit. Used to prioritize corrective action and track improvement over audit cycles.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: non_compliant_zone_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific zones, fixtures, or product placements found to be non-compliant during the audit, including the nature of each deviation from the plan directive.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal VM Compliance Policy

attributes.name: omnichannel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visual merchandising plan includes omnichannel fulfillment zone directives such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) or ship-from-store staging area setup.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations); Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Order Management)

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the visual merchandising plan (e.g., 'SS25 Athleisure Front Window Launch'). Used in reporting dashboards and store communications.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the visual merchandising plan, used in communications with store teams, regional managers, and VM field representatives. Format: VM- followed by 4–20 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Price Management; Assortment Planning)

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the visual merchandising plan. Tracks progression from authoring through field execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|published|active|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visual merchandising plan by its business purpose. Seasonal plans govern full-floor resets; promotional plans support campaign activations; window plans govern storefront displays. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seasonal|promotional|event|permanent|window|capsule — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: planogram_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the planogram PDF or digital asset stored in the content management system. Provides store teams direct access to the fixture layout and product placement diagrams.
attributes.references: Centric PLM (Collection Management; Material Libraries; Tech Packs)

attributes.name: product_placement_zone_notes
attributes.description: Narrative instructions describing product placement by zone, wall, table, and window. Captures hero product positioning, color blocking direction, and adjacency rules for the floor set.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning); Centric PLM

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the visual merchandising plan was published and made available to store teams via the distribution channel (e.g., Oracle Retail portal, intranet).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Internal VM Governance Policy

attributes.name: signage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes detailing specific signage placement instructions, size requirements, and messaging guidelines for this visual merchandising plan.
attributes.references: FTC Textile and Apparel Labeling Requirements; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: signage_specification_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the signage package specification (e.g., price tickets, lifestyle imagery, campaign headers, promotional banners) prescribed for this plan. Links to the signage asset library.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Price Management); Centric PLM

attributes.name: size_run_display_standard
attributes.description: Standard governing how size runs are displayed on the sales floor (e.g., full size run on fixture, key sizes only on mannequin). Aligns with Oracle Retail size curve and assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Assortment Planning); Internal VM Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this visual merchandising plan was sourced. ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; CENTRIC_PLM = Centric PLM; MANUAL = manually entered.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Centric PLM

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visual merchandising plan materials (fixtures, signage, packaging) comply with the company's sustainability standards, including GOTS, BCI, and OEKO-TEX requirements for display materials.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS); Better Cotton Initiative (BCI); OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visual merchandising plan record was last modified. Tracks revisions to planogram versions, compliance scores, or corrective action updates.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: window_display_count
attributes.description: Number of storefront window displays included in this visual merchandising plan. Used to track window execution compliance separately from interior floor sets.

attributes.name: zone_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct merchandising zones (e.g., front-of-store, mid-floor, back wall, window) covered by this visual merchandising plan.

products.name: markdown_event
products.description: Records markdown pricing events executed at the store level, including SKU, original MSRP, markdown price, markdown percentage, effective date, end date, markdown reason (clearance, seasonal, competitive), and authorization reference. Supports MD tracking, GMROI analysis, and OTB reconciliation. Sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management.

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for markdown_event

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.brand. Business justification: Brand-level markdown events are common in apparel (end-of-season brand clearance, brand exit events). Brand-level markdown authorization requires brand owner approval and drives brand equity reporting

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Markdown events are coordinated with marketing campaigns (seasonal clearance, flash sales). Business tracks which campaigns justify markdowns and measures promotional markdown effectiveness vs. campai

attributes.name: cogs_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cogs_entry. Business justification: Markdown events in apparel retail require inventory write-down COGS adjustments under the retail inventory method. Finance links markdown events to COGS entries for inventory valuation adjustments, IM

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.collection. Business justification: Collection-level markdown events are standard in apparel (end-of-season collection clearance). Collection-level markdown tracking enables sell-through reporting by collection, OTB reconciliation, and

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.colorway. Business justification: Colorway-specific markdowns are standard in apparel (mark down only the red colorway of a style with poor sell-through). Colorway-level markdown events drive targeted clearance strategies and color pe

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Markdowns create inventory valuation adjustments requiring GL posting for accurate gross margin and inventory valuation. Critical for financial reporting compliance and margin analysis. Each markdown

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise hierarchy node (department, class, subclass) to which the SKU belongs at the time of the markdown event. Enables hierarchical MD analysis and category-level GMROI reporting.

attributes.name: otb_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget record impacted by this markdown event. Supports OTB reconciliation workflows in Anaplan by linking markdown-driven inventory reductions to planned buy budgets.
attributes.references: Anaplan (Merchandise Planning); Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: price_change_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent price change event in the merchandising domain from which this store-level markdown event originates. Supports traceability from store execution back to the central pricing decision.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing promotion or campaign associated with this markdown event, if applicable. Links promotional markdowns to campaign performance tracking in Adobe Experience Platform and SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store at which this markdown event is executed. Links to the store master record for store-level MD tracking and performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (POS; Store Operations)

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise season (e.g., Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter) associated with this markdown event. Supports seasonal MD analysis, OTB reconciliation, and collection lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Centric PLM

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) subject to the markdown event. Enables SKU-level MD tracking, sell-through rate (STR) analysis, and GMROI reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Infor PLM

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Markdown decisions require landed cost context from sourcing PO for accurate margin analysis, IMU/MMU calculations, and vendor cost reconciliation. Critical for pricing strategy and profitability repo

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.style. Business justification: Markdown events in apparel are initiated at the style level (all SKUs of a style marked down together). Style-level markdown authorization, financial reporting, and sell-through analysis are core appa

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Markdown events often require vendor negotiation for markdown allowances or return-to-vendor (RTV) authorization. Real business process: buyers negotiate vendor-funded markdowns or cost recovery on sl

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: Markdowns resulting from production quality issues, overruns, or late deliveries require work order linkage for factory chargeback calculations, vendor performance scorecards, and cost recovery negoti

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the markdown event was formally approved in Oracle Retail Price Management. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the markdown authorization lifecycle.

attributes.name: authorization_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or code from the authorization workflow that approved this markdown event. Typically sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management approval chain. Required for audit compliance and financial controls.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the retail channel(s) to which this markdown event applies. Supports omnichannel pricing consistency, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), and ship-from-store fulfillment scenarios.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: Unit cost of goods sold (COGS) for the SKU at the time of the markdown event. Used to calculate gross margin impact of the markdown and support GMROI analysis. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was first created in the source system (Oracle Retail Price Management). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this markdown event record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the markdown price becomes active and is applied at the store POS. Aligns with the Oracle Retail Price Management effective date field. Used for OTB reconciliation and fiscal period reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the markdown event expires and the price reverts (for temporary/promotional markdowns). Null for permanent markdowns. Used for event duration analysis and POS price management.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the markdown event within the Oracle Retail Price Management workflow. Controls whether the markdown is visible and applied at the POS.

attributes.name: initial_markup_pct
attributes.description: Initial Markup (IMU) percentage at the time the SKU was first priced for the season, expressed as a decimal. Provides the baseline for measuring markdown erosion of margin and maintained markup (MMU) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: maintained_markup_pct
attributes.description: Maintained Markup (MMU) percentage after applying the markdown, reflecting the actual margin retained post-markdown. Calculated as (markdown_price minus cost_price) / markdown_price. Critical for GMROI analysis and financial planning in Anaplan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Anaplan; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary reduction applied to the original retail price (original_retail_price minus markdown_price). Expressed in the store's operating currency. Used for financial impact reporting and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: markdown_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the markdown event as assigned by Oracle Retail Price Management. Used for cross-system reference, audit trails, and reconciliation with source system records.

attributes.name: markdown_level
attributes.description: Granularity at which the markdown event is defined and applied within the merchandise hierarchy. SKU-level markdowns are the most granular; department-level markdowns apply broadly across a category.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_pct
attributes.description: Percentage reduction from the original retail price to the markdown price, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Key metric for MD depth analysis, OTB reconciliation, and maintained markup (MMU) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_price
attributes.description: The new selling price for the SKU after the markdown event is applied. This is the price presented to customers at POS during the markdown event period. Core field for AUR and ASP reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: markdown_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason driving the markdown event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clearance|seasonal|competitive|slow_seller|overstock|damage|end_of_line — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown event by pricing permanence. Permanent markdowns reduce the ongoing retail price; temporary markdowns revert after the event period; promotional markdowns are tied to a campaign; clearance markdowns are end-of-lifecycle reductions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; NRF Retail Glossary

attributes.name: msrp_price
attributes.description: The original Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the SKU prior to any markdown. Serves as the baseline for markdown percentage calculation and IMU/MMU analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the merchandising team regarding the markdown event. May include competitive intelligence, vendor negotiation context, or store-specific execution instructions.

attributes.name: on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Store-level on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the time the markdown event is created. Captured to support sell-through rate (STR) analysis, weeks of supply (WOS) calculation, and OTB reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: original_retail_price
attributes.description: The store's current selling price for the SKU immediately before this markdown event is applied. May differ from MSRP due to prior price changes. Used as the direct basis for markdown amount and percentage calculations.

attributes.name: pos_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the markdown price has been successfully pushed to and activated at the store Point of Sale (POS) system (SAP Customer Activity Repository). True when the markdown is live at POS; False when pending or failed.

attributes.name: price_label_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether physical price label reprinting is required for store fixtures and merchandise as part of this markdown event. Drives visual merchandising and store operations task management.
attributes.references: FTC Pricing Regulations; Oracle Retail Price Management

attributes.name: price_zone_code
attributes.description: Oracle Retail Price Management price zone code identifying the geographic or store-cluster pricing zone to which this markdown event applies. Supports zone-based pricing strategy and regional MD analysis.

attributes.name: rfid_repriced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID-tagged units for this SKU have been repriced and relabeled in the store as part of the markdown event execution. Supports RFID-enabled inventory accuracy and shrinkage control.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; RFID Standards (GS1)

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of units sold during the markdown event to on-hand quantity at event start, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65% STR). Key KPI for markdown effectiveness and inventory liquidation performance. Sourced or calculated from SAP Customer Activity Repository data.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Glossary; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native primary key or record identifier of this markdown event in the originating source system (Oracle Retail Price Management). Enables exact record traceability and idempotent Silver Layer upserts.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this markdown event record was sourced (e.g., ORM = Oracle Retail Merchandising, SAP_CAR = SAP Customer Activity Repository). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP Customer Activity Repository

attributes.name: units_sold_during_event
attributes.description: Total number of units of the SKU sold at the markdown price during the event period. Populated at event close or via daily reconciliation from SAP Customer Activity Repository. Supports STR and markdown effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository; Oracle Retail Price Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was last modified in the source system. Tracks amendments to markdown pricing, status changes, or date adjustments post-creation.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master record for every inbound and outbound shipment movement in the apparel supply chain. Captures shipment type (FOB, LDP, DTC, wholesale, inter-facility transfer), origin and destination facilities, carrier assignment, transport mode (ocean FCL/LCL, air, ground, courier, rail), booking reference, ETD/ETA and actual departure/arrival timestamps, carton count, gross weight, cubic volume, freight cost estimate, insurance value, current milestone status, and priority flag. Serves as the SSOT for shipment identity across the logistics domain, linking to purchase orders, sales orders, 3PL partners, customs entries, and freight bookings. Supports both pre-retail (factory-to-DC) and post-retail (DC-to-store, DC-to-consumer) movements.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Freight bookings for inbound shipments are created based on sourcing PO ship windows, ex-factory dates, and delivery requirements to ensure on-time arrival for apparel seasonal launches.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the 3PL provider managing the freight booking and logistics coordination. Links to the 3PL partner master data.

attributes.name: work_order_id
