attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this promo code redemption.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Promo discount amounts (discount_amount) must be posted to specific GL accounts (markdown/discount expense accounts) for retail discount accounting. Apparel fashion finance requires GL-level promo red

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the influencer associated with this promo code redemption, if applicable.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.loyalty_enrollment. Business justification: Loyalty points attribution on promo redemptions: when a loyalty member redeems a promo code, the redemption must link to their enrollment record for points crediting, tier qualification spend calculat

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who redeemed the promotional code.

attributes.name: promo_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional code that was redeemed.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical retail store where the promo code was redeemed, if applicable.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order in which the promo code was applied.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_order. Business justification: For made-to-order promotions, personalized products, or limited-edition campaigns, promo redemptions trigger dedicated production work orders. Supports promotional product fulfillment tracking and cus

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The marketing source or touchpoint that led to this promo code redemption (e.g., email, social media, influencer, paid search).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this redemption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this redemption.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied to the order as a result of the promo code redemption.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied if the promo code is percentage-based.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: The type of discount applied (percentage, fixed amount, buy-one-get-one, free shipping, tiered).

attributes.name: first_time_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption was by a first-time customer (true) or a returning customer (false).

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption was flagged as potentially fraudulent or abusive (true) or legitimate (false).

attributes.name: fraud_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason why this redemption was flagged as fraudulent, if applicable.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this redemption record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about this promo code redemption event.

attributes.name: order_subtotal_after_discount
attributes.description: The order subtotal amount after the promotional discount was applied.

attributes.name: order_subtotal_before_discount
attributes.description: The order subtotal amount before the promotional discount was applied.

attributes.name: order_total_after_discount
attributes.description: The total order amount including tax and shipping after the promotional discount was applied.

attributes.name: order_total_before_discount
attributes.description: The total order amount including tax and shipping before the promotional discount was applied.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the promo code was redeemed (DTC, e-commerce, retail POS, mobile app, wholesale, call center).

attributes.name: redemption_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the redemption occurred.

attributes.name: redemption_device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used to redeem the promo code (desktop, mobile, tablet, POS terminal, kiosk, unknown).

attributes.name: redemption_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the promo code redemption was initiated, used for fraud detection and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer attempted to redeem the promo code beyond the allowed usage limit (true) or within limits (false).

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current status of the promo code redemption (applied, pending, failed, reversed, expired).

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the promotional code was redeemed by the customer.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the promo code redemption was reversed (e.g., order cancelled, return processed, fraud detected).

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the promo code redemption was reversed, if applicable (e.g., due to order cancellation or return).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this promo redemption record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Customer Activity Repository, Adobe Experience Platform).

attributes.name: stacking_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promo code was allowed to be stacked with other promotions (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: The UTM campaign parameter captured at the time of redemption for marketing attribution.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: The UTM medium parameter captured at the time of redemption for marketing attribution.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: The UTM source parameter captured at the time of redemption for marketing attribution.

products.name: event
products.description: Master record for physical and virtual marketing events including runway shows, pop-up activations, trade shows, press days, brand experiences, and wholesale previews. Captures event name, event type, venue, city/market, event date(s), target audience (press, buyers, consumers, VIPs), expected attendance, actual attendance, budget, associated season/collection, sponsorship details, and event status. Coordinates brand experience activations across markets.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.audience_segment. Business justification: event already has target_customer_segment_id -> customer.segment (cross-domain) and target_audience as a STRING field. Adding an in-domain audience_segment_id FK links events to the marketing audience

attributes.name: brand_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand_asset. Business justification: Marketing events (runway shows, pop-up activations, brand launches) are associated with specific brand assets — lookbooks, banners, campaign imagery, and promotional materials. Linking event to brand_

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand hosting or featured in the event. Links to brand master data for multi-brand portfolio companies.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent marketing campaign this event supports. Links event performance to broader campaign objectives and budget.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.collection. Business justification: Events showcase collections (fashion shows, trunk shows, pop-ups). Essential for event planning, inventory allocation, and experiential marketing attribution. Replaces denormalized collection_name wit

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Events incur costs (venue, production, sponsorship) tracked to cost centers for expense management, budget variance analysis, and ROI calculation. Standard practice for managing event marketing spend

attributes.name: featured_style_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.style. Business justification: Fashion events (runway shows, trunk shows, pop-ups) feature hero styles. event has collection_id and brand_id but no style_id; style-level event attribution is required for post-event demand analysis,

attributes.name: fulfillment_distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.distribution_center. Business justification: Marketing events (pop-ups, trade shows, runway shows) in apparel-fashion are fulfilled from a specific DC. Event planners and logistics teams must know the sourcing DC for inventory allocation, pick-a

attributes.name: logistics_third_party_logistics_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logistics Third Party Logistics Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.third_party_logistics. Business justification: Large apparel-fashion marketing events (runway shows, brand activations, trade shows) contract a specific 3PL for event logistics — transport, setup, and returns. Event managers must record which 3PL

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.loyalty_program. Business justification: Loyalty-exclusive event management: VIP previews, trunk shows, and member-only events in fashion are gated by loyalty program tier. This FK enables loyalty-gated event access control, invitation list

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Fashion events (runway shows, pop-ups, trade shows) are attributed to profit centers for brand P&L reporting. Apparel fashion finance allocates event costs (budget_actual_amount) to the responsible pr

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.retail_store. Business justification: Marketing events in apparel (trunk shows, VIP shopping nights, store openings) are held at specific retail stores. A direct FK enables store-level event ROI reporting, associate scheduling, and invent

attributes.name: sample_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sample_request. Business justification: Fashion events (trunk shows, buyer meetings, runway shows) require physical samples. Event planning depends on sample request status, delivery dates, and approval timelines to ensure product availabil

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Collection launch events and trade shows are scheduled around confirmed PO delivery dates. Apparel fashion event planners require direct PO linkage to validate product availability before finalizing e

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Apparel brands host factory open-day, sustainability showcase, and trade compliance events at specific supplier factories. Linking event to supplier_factory enables factory-level event reporting, ESG

attributes.name: target_customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Events target specific customer segments (VIP events, loyalty member exclusives, new customer welcomes). Enables segment-based invitation lists, attendance tracking by segment, and segment-specific ev

attributes.name: tna_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_tna_calendar. Business justification: Collection launch events are directly gated on TNA calendar milestones (in-DC date, bulk production completion). Apparel fashion event planners link events to the TNA calendar to validate event dates

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Brand events (factory tours, sustainability showcases, craftsmanship demonstrations) feature specific vendors. Business need: event planning for transparency initiatives, supplier summits, factory sho

attributes.name: actual_attendance
attributes.description: Confirmed number of attendees who participated in the event. Captured post-event for performance analysis and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the event proposal. Events must be approved before budget allocation and execution.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or manager who approved the event proposal and budget.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the event proposal was formally approved. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: attributed_order_count
attributes.description: Number of customer or wholesale orders directly attributed to the event through tracking mechanisms.

attributes.name: attributed_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue directly attributed to the event through tracked conversions, promo codes, or wholesale orders placed during/after the event.

attributes.name: budget_actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure for the event after completion. Used for variance analysis and future event budget calibration.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all budget amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: budget_planned_amount
attributes.description: Total planned budget allocated for the event during initial planning phase. Includes venue, production, staffing, marketing, and contingency costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the event concludes. For single-day events, matches start_date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the event officially concludes, including time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the event, used for external reference and tracking across systems. Typically alphanumeric code assigned during event planning.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the marketing event (e.g., Spring 2024 Runway Show, NYC Pop-Up Launch, Paris Fashion Week Press Day).

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the event. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marketing event format and purpose. Determines audience, venue requirements, and success metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: runway_show|pop_up_activation|trade_show|press_day|brand_experience|wholesale_preview|influencer_event|product_launch|store_opening|virtual_event|fashion_week|trunk_show — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expected_attendance
attributes.description: Projected number of attendees based on invitations sent and historical response rates. Used for capacity planning and budget forecasting.

attributes.name: is_virtual_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event is conducted entirely online/virtually (True) or has a physical venue component (False).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the event record was last modified. Tracks data freshness and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: media_impressions
attributes.description: Total estimated media impressions generated by the event across press coverage, social media, and digital channels. Captured post-event.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional event details, special requirements, lessons learned, or post-event observations.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score collected from event attendees post-event. Measures attendee satisfaction and likelihood to recommend. Scale: -100 to +100.

attributes.name: press_coverage_count
attributes.description: Number of press articles, blog posts, or media mentions generated by the event. Indicates earned media success.

attributes.name: registration_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals who registered or RSVP'd for the event. Used to calculate attendance conversion rate.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Fashion season or collection code associated with the event (e.g., SS24 for Spring/Summer 2024, FW24 for Fall/Winter 2024). Links event to merchandising calendar.

attributes.name: social_engagement_count
attributes.description: Total social media engagements (likes, shares, comments, mentions) attributed to the event across all platforms. Measured during and post-event.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this event record originated (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, custom event management system).

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary external sponsor or partner co-hosting the event. Null if no external sponsorship.

attributes.name: sponsorship_tier
attributes.description: Level of external sponsorship secured for the event. Impacts budget offset and co-branding requirements.

attributes.name: sponsorship_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of sponsorship contribution or in-kind services provided by external sponsor. Reduces net event cost.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the event begins. For multi-day events, this is the first day. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the event officially begins, including time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Primary audience segment the event is designed to engage. Determines invitation strategy, content, and success metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: press|buyers|consumers|vips|influencers|trade|internal|mixed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: virtual_platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the digital platform used for virtual events (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, custom branded platform). Null for physical-only events.

domains.name: supplier
domains.description: SSOT for all vendor and supplier master data including manufacturer profiles, CMT factories, OEM/ODM partners, fabric mills, trim suppliers, and 3PL providers. Manages factory certifications, compliance audits (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX), capacity profiles, payment terms, LC terms, and supplier risk scorecards.
domains.references: WRAP, FLA, ISO 9001, SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all supplier and vendor entities in the apparel-fashion supply chain, including CMT factories, OEM/ODM partners, fabric mills, trim suppliers, 3PL providers, and raw material vendors. Captures legal entity name, registration number, country of origin, vendor type (CMT/OEM/ODM/Mill/Trim/3PL), tier classification (Tier 1/2/3), business status, primary contact, headquarters address, currency, payment terms, incoterms, FOB port, lead time, MOQ thresholds, EDI capability flag, VMI eligibility, onboarding stage, onboarding checklist completion percentage, onboarding manager, target go-live date, onboarding completion date, go-live date, and final approval date. SSOT for all vendor identity, commercial terms, and lifecycle status (including onboarding workflow state) across sourcing, production, and supply chain domains.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor entity. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: In multi-entity apparel companies, vendors are assigned to specific company codes governing AP processing, tax jurisdiction, payment terms, and intercompany transactions. This is a foundational ERP re

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number used for electronic payment transfers and settlements.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their primary business banking account.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued business registration or tax identification number for the vendor entity.

attributes.name: business_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor relationship indicating whether the vendor is actively engaged, suspended, or terminated.

attributes.name: compliance_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of compliance certifications held by the vendor, such as WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BCI, or other industry-recognized standards.
attributes.references: Global Compliance Standards (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO)

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary country where the vendor is legally registered and operates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the primary currency used for transactions and payments with this vendor.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor has the technical capability to exchange business documents electronically using EDI standards.

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor received final executive or procurement approval to be added to the approved vendor list.

attributes.name: fob_port
attributes.description: Name of the port or location where goods are loaded for shipment and where ownership and risk transfer from vendor to buyer under FOB terms.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the vendor became operational and began fulfilling orders or providing services to the business.

attributes.name: headquarters_address
attributes.description: Full physical address of the vendor's primary headquarters or registered office location.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks associated with the transportation and delivery of goods between buyer and seller. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance, quality, or social responsibility audit conducted at the vendor's facilities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: lc_terms_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Letter of Credit (LC) Terms Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor requires payment to be secured through a letter of credit for international transactions.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days required from purchase order placement to delivery of goods or completion of services by the vendor.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the vendor as it appears on official business registration documents and contracts.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered from the vendor in a single purchase order to meet their production or business requirements.

attributes.name: moq_value
attributes.description: Minimum monetary value required for a purchase order to be accepted by the vendor, expressed in the vendor's currency.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or quality audit to be conducted at the vendor's facilities.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all onboarding activities and checklist items were completed and the vendor was approved for activation.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of onboarding checklist items completed, calculated as completed tasks divided by total required tasks, expressed as a decimal (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: onboarding_manager
attributes.description: Name of the internal employee or team responsible for managing the vendor onboarding process and ensuring completion of all required steps.

attributes.name: onboarding_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the vendor onboarding workflow process, tracking progress from initial documentation through final approval and system setup. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Not Started|Documentation|Compliance Review|Factory Audit|Contract Negotiation|System Setup|Approved|Completed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms defining the timeline and conditions for payment, such as Net 30, Net 60, or advance payment requirements.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce Payment Terms

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor has been designated as a preferred or strategic supplier with priority consideration for new business.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for vendor communications and correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the vendor organization for operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for reaching the vendor's main business contact.

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Capacity in Units Per Month
attributes.description: Maximum number of units the vendor can produce or supply per month based on their current production capacity and resources.

attributes.name: quality_rating_score
attributes.description: Vendor quality performance score based on defect rates, compliance with specifications, and quality audit results, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk assessment score evaluating the vendor across financial stability, geopolitical risk, compliance history, and operational reliability, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 10.00.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: International bank identifier code used for cross-border wire transfers and international payments to the vendor.

attributes.name: target_go_live_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the vendor is expected to be fully operational and ready to begin fulfilling orders or providing services.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number used for tax reporting and compliance purposes in the vendor's country of operation.

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: Supply chain tier level indicating the vendor's position in the supply chain hierarchy. Tier 1 represents direct suppliers, Tier 2 represents suppliers to Tier 1, and so on.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier or short code used to reference the vendor in operational systems, purchase orders, and transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. CMT (Cut Make Trim) for contract manufacturers, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), Fabric Mill for textile suppliers, Trim Supplier for accessories, 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) for logistics providers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMT|OEM|ODM|Fabric Mill|Trim Supplier|3PL|Raw Material|Packaging|Logistics|Other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor is eligible and approved to participate in vendor-managed inventory programs where they manage stock levels at buyer locations.

products.name: supplier_factory
products.description: Detailed operational profile of a manufacturing facility associated with a vendor, capturing factory name, physical address, country, region, factory type (Cut-Make-Trim, Full Package, Knitting, Weaving, Dyeing, Finishing, Embroidery), production capacity (units/month), number of production lines, workforce headcount, floor area (sqm), machinery types, product categories manufactured, gender specialization (menswear/womenswear/kidswear), minimum order quantity (MOQ), lead time (days), shift structure, and operational status. Distinct from the vendor legal entity — one vendor may operate multiple factories.
products.reference: Infor PLM Factory Profile / Centric PLM Supplier Factory

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing facility. Primary key for the supplier factory entity.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor or supplier legal entity that owns or operates this factory. One supplier may operate multiple factories.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the factory facility including building number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or industrial zone designation.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Most recent audit score or rating (typically 0-100 scale) reflecting compliance with labor standards, workplace safety, environmental practices, and quality systems. Used for supplier risk assessment and scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of current valid certifications held by the factory (e.g., WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BCI, BSCI). Required for compliance verification and ethical sourcing.
attributes.references: WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the factory is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the factory is located. Critical for trade compliance, duty calculation, and country-of-origin labeling per FTC requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for transactions with this factory. Used for pricing, purchase orders, and financial settlement.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for factory operations, production coordination, and quality communications.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was originally established or began operations. Indicates factory maturity and operational experience.

attributes.name: factory_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to uniquely identify the factory within the enterprise sourcing system. Used in purchase orders and production planning.

attributes.name: factory_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the manufacturing facility as registered with local authorities.

attributes.name: factory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing facility based on its primary production capability. Cut-Make-Trim (CMT) factories perform assembly only; Full Package factories handle design through production; specialized factories focus on fabric production or finishing processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Cut-Make-Trim|Full Package|Knitting|Weaving|Dyeing|Finishing|Embroidery — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total manufacturing floor space in square meters. Used to assess factory scale, capacity utilization, and compliance with workplace safety standards.

attributes.name: gender_specialization
attributes.description: Primary gender category focus of the factory production capability. Some factories specialize in specific gender categories due to sizing, fit, and construction expertise.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for shipments from this factory. FOB (Free on Board) is most common in apparel sourcing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FOB|CIF|DDP|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance or quality audit conducted at the factory. Used to track audit frequency and identify factories due for re-audit per WRAP and FLA requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order placed with this factory. Used to identify inactive suppliers and manage supplier lifecycle.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time from purchase order confirmation to ex-factory shipment readiness, measured in calendar days. Used for Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance tracking.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: machinery_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key machinery and equipment types available at the factory (e.g., single-needle machines, overlock machines, flatlock machines, buttonhole machines, pressing equipment, cutting tables). Determines production capabilities and product suitability.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the factory per style or purchase order, measured in units. Critical for order planning and vendor negotiation.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or certification audit. Factories must maintain current audit status to remain active in the approved supplier network.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, quality observations, or compliance remarks related to the factory.

attributes.name: number_of_production_lines
attributes.description: Total count of active production lines or assembly lines operating within the factory. Indicates scale and parallel production capability.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was approved and onboarded into the enterprise supplier network. Marks the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the factory in the supplier network. Active factories are approved for production; Suspended factories are temporarily blocked due to compliance or quality issues; Under Audit factories are undergoing certification review.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the factory (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 30% deposit + 70% on shipment, Letter of Credit at sight). Impacts cash flow planning and supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the factory including country and area codes.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the factory location.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary factory contact person responsible for production coordination and communication with the buying organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary factory contact (e.g., Factory Manager, Production Director, Merchandising Manager).

attributes.name: product_categories_manufactured
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories the factory is equipped to manufacture (e.g., T-shirts, Dresses, Outerwear, Denim, Activewear, Footwear, Accessories). Used for supplier selection and product allocation.

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_month
attributes.description: Maximum monthly production capacity of the factory measured in units (garments, pieces, or pairs). Used for capacity planning, order allocation, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) calculations.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broader geographic region classification for sourcing strategy and logistics planning (e.g., South Asia, Southeast Asia, East Asia, Europe, Americas).

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall supplier risk classification based on audit results, compliance history, financial stability, geopolitical factors, and operational performance. High or Critical risk factories require enhanced monitoring and corrective action plans.

attributes.name: shift_structure
attributes.description: Daily shift operation model of the factory. Indicates production hours and capacity flexibility. Triple shift operations provide maximum throughput but require strong labor compliance oversight.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the factory operates.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees working at the factory including production workers, supervisors, quality control staff, and administrative personnel. Required for labor compliance audits.

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a vendor or factory, capturing full name, job title, department, email, phone, WhatsApp/WeChat handle, preferred communication channel, language, role type (Account Manager, QC Liaison, Compliance Officer, Logistics Coordinator, Finance Contact), primary contact flag, and active status. Supports multi-contact management per vendor for sourcing, production, compliance, and logistics workflows.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contact person. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Vendor contacts can be factory-specific (factory manager, production planner, QC supervisor) or vendor-level (corporate procurement, finance). Currently vendor_contact only has vendor_id. Adding facto

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier organization this contact is associated with. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Level of decision-making authority the contact has within the vendor organization (e.g., Operational, Managerial, Executive). Used to determine appropriate escalation paths and approval workflows.

attributes.name: certification_credentials
attributes.description: Professional certifications or credentials held by the contact relevant to their role (e.g., WRAP Auditor, GOTS Certified, Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor). Supports compliance verification and quality assurance.

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: First name or given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: contact_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor contact person, including first name, middle name, and last name.

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Last name or family name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact record. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged, temporarily unavailable, or no longer with the vendor organization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or functional area within the vendor organization where the contact works (e.g., Sales, Quality Assurance, Compliance, Logistics, Finance, Production).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact person's role ended or they ceased to be the designated contact. Null if the contact is currently active. Used for contact history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact person began their role with the vendor or became the designated contact for this business relationship. Used for contact history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the vendor contact person. Used for official communications, purchase orders, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_number
attributes.description: Emergency contact phone number for urgent situations requiring immediate vendor response, such as production issues, quality failures, or compliance incidents.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is currently active and should be used for communications. True if active, False if inactive or no longer with the vendor organization.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor. True if primary, False otherwise. Only one primary contact should exist per vendor per role type.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within the vendor organization (e.g., Account Manager, Quality Control Manager, Compliance Officer, Production Coordinator).

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Primary language(s) spoken by the contact for business communications. Supports multilingual vendor management and reduces miscommunication risk. Use ISO 639-1 two-letter codes (e.g., EN, ZH, ES, FR, IT, PT, DE, JA, KO, VI, BN, HI).

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent communication or interaction with this vendor contact. Used for relationship management and engagement tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contact record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number of the vendor contact person for urgent communications and field coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the vendor contact. May include communication preferences, special instructions, relationship history, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Physical office location or site where the contact is based within the vendor organization (e.g., factory name, office branch, city). Used for site visit planning and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the vendor contact person, including country code and extension if applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, CCPA Section 1798.140, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for routine business interactions. Used to optimize communication effectiveness and response times.

attributes.name: reporting_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the contact's direct manager or supervisor within the vendor organization. Used for escalation paths and organizational context.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Standardized role classification indicating the primary function of the contact in the vendor relationship. Used for routing communications and workflow assignments.
attributes.value_regex: Account Manager|QC Liaison|Compliance Officer|Logistics Coordinator|Finance Contact|Production Manager

attributes.name: specialization_area
attributes.description: Specific area of expertise or specialization of the contact within their role (e.g., Fabric Sourcing, Garment Construction, Chemical Compliance, Export Documentation, Quality Testing). Used for routing specialized inquiries.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone of the vendor contact's primary work location. Used for scheduling meetings and coordinating communications across global supply chains. Use IANA time zone database format (e.g., Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York, Europe/London).

attributes.name: wechat_handle
attributes.description: WeChat contact identifier or username used for instant messaging communication with the vendor contact, commonly used for China-based suppliers.

attributes.name: whatsapp_handle
attributes.description: WhatsApp contact identifier (typically phone number) used for instant messaging communication with the vendor contact, commonly used in international sourcing operations.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Number of years of professional experience the contact has in their field or role. Used for assessing vendor capability and relationship strength.

products.name: vendor_bank_account
products.description: Banking and payment settlement details for vendors, including bank name, bank country, account holder name, IBAN/account number, SWIFT/BIC code, routing number, currency, payment method (Wire/ACH/LC/TT), Letter of Credit (LC) terms, LC issuing bank, LC expiry date, preferred payment terms (Net 30/60/90, FOB, LDP), and account verification status. Critical for AP processing, LC issuance, and cross-border payment compliance. Owned by the supplier domain as part of vendor master.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier that owns this bank account. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: account_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the bank account. Determines the settlement currency for payments and impacts foreign exchange requirements.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match vendor legal name for payment processing and compliance verification.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for the vendor. Format varies by country and banking system. Used for domestic and international payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor bank account. Active accounts are eligible for payment processing; inactive/suspended/closed accounts are blocked from new payments.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account (checking, savings, current, business, escrow). Determines payment processing rules and settlement timing.

attributes.name: bank_address
attributes.description: Full address of the bank branch or headquarters. Required for international payment routing and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: bank_branch_code
attributes.description: Branch identifier or sort code used for domestic payment routing. Format varies by country (e.g., UK sort code, Indian IFSC code).

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is held. Used for domestic payment routing and vendor communication.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the bank's domicile. Critical for cross-border payment routing, foreign exchange, and compliance with international sanctions and trade regulations.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full name of the financial institution holding the account. Used for payment routing and vendor master data management.

attributes.name: beneficiary_address
attributes.description: Full address of the account beneficiary. Required for international wire transfers and compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this bank account is no longer valid for payment processing. Null indicates an open-ended account. Used for account lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this bank account becomes effective for payment processing. Supports time-based account activation and vendor onboarding workflows.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this bank account in the source system or vendor portal. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data integration.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for cross-border payments within SEPA and other regions. Standardized format for international payment routing.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the intermediary or correspondent bank used for routing international payments when direct settlement is not available. Common in cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intermediary Bank Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the intermediary bank. Required for routing payments through correspondent banking networks in international transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment processed to this bank account in the account currency. Used for payment pattern analysis and fraud detection.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment processed to this bank account. Used for account activity monitoring and dormant account identification.

attributes.name: lc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current Letter of Credit arrangement for this vendor account. After this date, a new LC must be issued for continued payment processing.
attributes.references: UCP 600 - Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: lc_issuing_bank
attributes.description: Name of the bank that issues Letters of Credit on behalf of the buyer (Apparel Fashion) for payments to this vendor. Required when LC payment method is used.
attributes.references: UCP 600 - Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: lc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Letter of Credit is required for payments to this vendor account. True if LC is mandatory for trade finance compliance or vendor risk mitigation.
attributes.references: UCP 600 - Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: lc_terms
attributes.description: Specific terms and conditions governing Letter of Credit issuance for this vendor, including sight/usance terms, document requirements, and negotiation conditions.
attributes.references: UCP 600 - Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this bank account record. Used for audit trails and accountability in vendor master data management.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for this account: Wire Transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area), TT (Telegraphic Transfer), LC (Letter of Credit), Check, or EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer). Determines payment processing workflow and timing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire|ach|sepa|tt|lc|check|eft — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this bank account when multiple accounts exist for a vendor. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by AP automation to select payment account.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms for this vendor account (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Net 90, FOB, LDP, 2/10 Net 30). Defines when payment is due relative to invoice date or shipment.

attributes.name: primary_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary/default bank account for the vendor. True if this account should be used by default for payment processing when multiple accounts exist.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing number for US domestic payments (ACH and wire transfers). Nine-digit code identifying the financial institution.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this bank account record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle Financials, vendor portal). Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special payment instructions, reference requirements, or handling notes specific to this bank account. Used by AP processors for payment execution.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code identifying the bank for international wire transfers. 8 or 11 character code used for cross-border payment routing.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number associated with this bank account (e.g., EIN, VAT number, TIN). Required for tax reporting (1099, withholding) and compliance with international tax regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9, OECD Common Reporting Standard

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank account was successfully verified. Used for audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling per compliance policies.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the bank account: micro-deposit test transactions, document review (bank statement/voided check), third-party verification service, manual verification, or bank letter confirmation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of bank account verification process. Verified accounts have passed validation checks (micro-deposits, document review, third-party verification). Required for payment processing compliance.

products.name: factory_certification
products.description: Tracks all compliance certifications and ethical manufacturing accreditations held by a factory, including certification type (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, BCI, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SA8000, BSCI, Sedex/SMETA), certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, scope of certification, audit grade (A/B/C/D), corrective action required flag, certificate document URL, and renewal status. Enables compliance tracking against FTC, CPSC, and ESG reporting obligations.
products.reference: WRAP / FLA / GOTS / OEKO-TEX Certification Registry

attributes.name: factory_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the factory certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Factory certifications in apparel are product-category-scoped (GOTS for organic cotton products, OEKO-TEX for specific categories). Linking to merchandise_hierarchy enables assortment planning validat

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Certification costs are tracked by brand profit center in apparel fashion for sustainability reporting and brand-level compliance cost allocation. Linking to profit_center enables brand P&L to reflect

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: supplier_factory_certification tracks compliance certifications held by a manufacturing facility. The product currently references production.production_factory (cross-domain) but has NO in-domain FK

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the national or international accreditation body that accredits the certifying body (e.g., ANAB, UKAS, DAkkS, CNAS). Provides additional assurance of the certifying body's competence.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent certification audit was conducted at the factory. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: audit_grade
attributes.description: Grade or rating assigned during the certification audit. A indicates excellent compliance with no major findings. B indicates good compliance with minor findings. C indicates acceptable compliance with moderate findings requiring corrective action. D indicates poor compliance with major findings. Not Graded indicates the certification does not use a grading system.

attributes.name: audit_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed audit report document. Contains findings, observations, and recommendations from the certification audit.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate document stored in the document management system or cloud storage. Used for verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: certification_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for obtaining or renewing the certification, including audit fees, consulting fees, and administrative costs. Expressed in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: certification_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Level or tier of certification achieved, if the certification standard has multiple levels (e.g., 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze', 'Level 1', 'Level 2'). Null if the certification does not have levels.

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Numerical compliance score assigned during the audit, typically expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Higher scores indicate better compliance with certification standards. Null if the certification does not use numerical scoring.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which corrective actions must be completed and verified. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if no corrective actions are required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective actions are required to address audit findings. True if corrective action plan (CAP) is required. False if no corrective actions are needed.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action plan. Not required indicates no corrective actions are needed. Pending indicates corrective actions have been identified but not yet started. In progress indicates corrective actions are being implemented. Completed indicates corrective actions have been implemented and are awaiting verification. Verified indicates corrective actions have been verified by the certifying body. Overdue indicates corrective actions have not been completed by the due date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity), ISO 8601 Timestamp Format

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is included in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting and sustainability disclosures. True if included in ESG reporting. False otherwise.
attributes.references: IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, GRI Standards, SASB Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage of the certification, indicating which factory locations or sites are covered (e.g., 'Main facility only', 'All production sites', 'Facility A and Facility B'). Relevant for multi-site certifications.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformities or critical findings identified during the certification audit. Major findings typically require immediate corrective action and may impact certification status.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformities or observations identified during the certification audit. Minor findings require corrective action but do not immediately threaten certification status.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next surveillance or recertification audit. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if not yet scheduled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the certification, audit findings, or corrective actions. Used for internal documentation and knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: product_category_scope
attributes.description: Specific product categories or types covered by the certification (e.g., 'Woven apparel', 'Knit garments', 'Footwear', 'Accessories'). Indicates which product lines are certified.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is publicly disclosed on the company's website or in sustainability reports. True if publicly disclosed. False if confidential.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing), FTC Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification renewal process was formally initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if renewal has not been initiated.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Status of the certification renewal process. Not due indicates renewal is not yet required. Renewal initiated indicates renewal process has been started. Renewal in progress indicates renewal audit or documentation review is underway. Renewal completed indicates certification has been successfully renewed. Renewal failed indicates renewal was not successful and certification may expire or be revoked.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating assigned to the factory based on certification status and audit findings. Low indicates minimal compliance risk. Medium indicates moderate risk requiring monitoring. High indicates significant risk requiring immediate attention. Critical indicates severe risk that may result in supplier disqualification.

attributes.name: scope_of_certification
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope and coverage of the certification, including specific product categories, processes, or facilities covered (e.g., 'Cut-Make-Trim operations for woven garments', 'Dyeing and finishing of cotton fabrics', 'Full manufacturing facility including warehousing').

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source operational system from which this certification record originated (e.g., 'Infor PLM', 'SAP S/4HANA MM', 'Centric PLM', 'Manual Entry'). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the source operational system. Used for data reconciliation and traceability back to the source system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last updated in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity), ISO 8601 Timestamp Format

products.name: compliance_audit
products.description: Records of factory compliance and social responsibility audits conducted by internal teams, third-party auditors, or certification bodies. Supports FLA, WRAP, BSCI, and Sedex audit workflows.

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: ledger_id

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_factory. attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: season_id

attributes.name: announced_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the audit was announced to the supplier in advance. True indicates the supplier was notified ahead of time; False indicates an unannounced surprise audit.

attributes.name: audit_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the audit, including auditor fees, travel expenses, and certification body charges. Expressed in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: audit_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the audit cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: audit_date

attributes.name: audit_duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of days spent conducting the on-site audit fieldwork. Includes partial days represented as decimals (e.g., 2.5 days).

attributes.name: audit_end_date

attributes.name: audit_framework

attributes.name: audit_grade
