attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique audit reference number assigned by the auditing organization or internal compliance team.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full audit report document stored in the document management system. Provides access to detailed findings, evidence, and recommendations.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit fieldwork began. For multi-day audits, this represents the first day of on-site inspection.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit. Scheduled indicates the audit is planned but not yet started; In Progress indicates the audit is currently being conducted; Completed indicates the audit has been finalized and report issued; Cancelled indicates the audit was cancelled before completion; Pending Review indicates the audit is complete but awaiting final approval.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on its focus area. Social Compliance covers labor practices and working conditions; Environmental covers sustainability and environmental impact; Quality covers product quality systems; Fire Safety covers fire prevention and emergency preparedness; Chemical REACH covers chemical safety and REACH compliance; Structural Safety covers building and facility structural integrity.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) Workplace Code of Conduct, WRAP Principles, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: auditing_firm
attributes.description: Name of the third-party auditing organization or certification body that conducted the audit. Examples include Bureau Veritas, SGS, Intertek, UL, TUV. Null if the audit was conducted by internal compliance team.
attributes.references: ISO 17021 Conformity Assessment Requirements for Bodies Providing Audit and Certification

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead auditor who conducted the compliance audit. May be an internal compliance officer or external third-party auditor.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: cap_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the submitted Corrective Action Plan has been reviewed and approved by the compliance team or auditing body. True indicates approval; False indicates rejection or pending review.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: cap_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the supplier must submit a formal Corrective Action Plan addressing all identified non-conformances. Null if no CAP is required.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: cap_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a formal Corrective Action Plan is required from the supplier to address identified non-conformances. True indicates CAP is mandatory; False indicates no CAP required (typically for audits with no significant findings).
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: cap_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date when the supplier submitted their Corrective Action Plan in response to audit findings. Null if CAP has not yet been submitted or is not required.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited certification body issuing the compliance certificate or audit credential. Relevant for WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, BSCI, and Sedex audits.
attributes.references: ISO 17065 Conformity Assessment Requirements for Bodies Certifying Products

attributes.name: certification_valid_from_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the compliance certification issued as a result of this audit. Applicable for certification audits (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX). Null for non-certification audits.
attributes.references: ISO 17065 Conformity Assessment Requirements for Bodies Certifying Products

attributes.name: certification_valid_until_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the compliance certification issued as a result of this audit. Applicable for certification audits (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX). Null for non-certification audits.
attributes.references: ISO 17065 Conformity Assessment Requirements for Bodies Certifying Products

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of critical non-conformances identified during the audit. Critical NCRs represent severe violations that pose immediate risk to worker safety, health, or fundamental rights (e.g., child labor, forced labor, unsafe structural conditions).
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) Workplace Code of Conduct, WRAP Principles

attributes.name: factory_score
attributes.description: Overall numerical score assigned to the factory based on audit findings. Scoring scale varies by audit framework (e.g., 0-100 for some frameworks, A-F letter grades converted to numeric for others). Higher scores indicate better compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: final_audit_status
attributes.description: The final outcome determination of the audit after all reviews and corrective actions. Pass indicates full compliance; Conditional Pass indicates compliance with minor issues requiring monitoring; Fail indicates non-compliance requiring immediate action; Pending Corrective Action indicates awaiting CAP implementation; Certification Granted/Denied applies to certification audits.
attributes.value_regex: Pass|Conditional Pass|Fail|Pending Corrective Action|Certification Granted|Certification Denied
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: High-level narrative summary of the key audit findings, including strengths, weaknesses, and areas of concern identified during the inspection. Provides context for the numerical scores and NCR counts.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: major_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major NCRs represent significant violations of compliance standards that require corrective action but do not pose immediate critical risk.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) Workplace Code of Conduct, WRAP Principles

attributes.name: management_interviews_count
attributes.description: Number of factory management personnel interviewed during the audit to assess management systems, policies, and commitment to compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: minor_ncr_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances identified during the audit. Minor NCRs represent less severe violations or areas for improvement that do not significantly impact compliance status.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) Workplace Code of Conduct, WRAP Principles

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic compliance audit of this supplier. Audit frequency is typically annual or biennial depending on risk profile and certification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or context related to the audit that do not fit into structured fields. May include special circumstances, follow-up actions, or stakeholder communications.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: reaudit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the follow-up re-audit to verify corrective action implementation. Null if no re-audit is required.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: reaudit_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a follow-up re-audit is required to verify that corrective actions have been implemented and non-conformances have been resolved. True indicates re-audit is mandatory; False indicates no re-audit needed.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification assigned to the supplier based on audit findings. Used to determine monitoring frequency and sourcing decisions. Low indicates minimal compliance risk; Critical indicates severe risk requiring immediate action or potential delisting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance audit record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: worker_interviews_count
attributes.description: Number of factory workers interviewed during the audit as part of the social compliance assessment. Worker interviews are a key component of FLA, WRAP, and BSCI audits.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA) Workplace Code of Conduct, WRAP Principles

products.name: audit_finding
products.description: Individual non-conformance findings (NCRs) identified during a compliance or quality audit, capturing finding reference number, audit reference, finding category (Labor, Health & Safety, Environmental, Chemical, Fire Safety, Wages, Working Hours), severity level (Critical/Major/Minor/Observation), finding description, root cause, corrective action required, responsible party at factory, target closure date, actual closure date, evidence document URL, and closure status. Enables granular CAP tracking and repeat-finding analysis.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier audit finding record. Primary key for the supplier audit finding entity.

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent compliance or quality audit during which this finding was identified.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed, verified, and the finding was formally closed. Null if the finding remains open.

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context provided by the auditor regarding the finding, including mitigating factors, supplier cooperation, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: Description of the potential or actual business impact of the finding, including production delays, quality issues, regulatory penalties, reputational risk, or supply chain disruption.

attributes.name: closure_status
attributes.description: Current status of the finding in the corrective action lifecycle. Open: newly identified, action not started. In Progress: corrective action underway. Pending Verification: action completed, awaiting verification. Closed: verified and accepted. Overdue: past target closure date without completion.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan (CAP) required to remediate the finding, including specific steps, process changes, training requirements, or infrastructure improvements needed.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, WRAP Principles

attributes.name: cost_to_remediate
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost incurred by the supplier to implement the corrective action and remediate the finding, including infrastructure upgrades, training, process changes, or equipment purchases.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier audit finding record was first created in the system, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost to remediate amount, such as USD, EUR, CNY, or INR.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the finding was escalated to higher management levels or external stakeholders for intervention or decision-making.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) identifying whether this finding has been escalated to senior management, legal, or executive leadership due to severity, regulatory risk, or failure to remediate within agreed timelines.

attributes.name: evidence_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting evidence documentation for the finding, including photographs, audit reports, corrective action plans, or verification records stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the non-conformance finding based on the compliance domain. Categories include Labor (working conditions, child labor, forced labor), Health & Safety (workplace safety, PPE, ergonomics), Environmental (waste management, emissions, water usage), Chemical (restricted substances, OEKO-TEX compliance), Fire Safety (exits, extinguishers, evacuation plans), and Wages (minimum wage, overtime pay, payroll records).
attributes.references: WRAP Principles, FLA Workplace Code of Conduct, OEKO-TEX Standard 100

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the non-conformance finding, including specific observations, conditions found, and evidence collected during the audit.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 - Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: finding_identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the non-conformance finding was first identified during the audit inspection or assessment.

attributes.name: finding_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique reference number assigned to this non-conformance finding for tracking and communication purposes.

attributes.name: finding_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory or specific compliance area within the primary finding category, providing granular classification for analysis and reporting.
attributes.references: WRAP Principles, FLA Workplace Code of Conduct

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier audit finding record was last updated or modified, following the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for tracking changes to corrective action status, closure dates, or verification results.

attributes.name: previous_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the previous finding if this is identified as a repeat finding, enabling linkage and trend analysis of recurring non-conformances.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement, standard clause, or compliance framework that was violated or not met, such as WRAP Principle 3, FLA Code Section 2.1, or OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Annex 6.
attributes.references: WRAP Principles, FLA Workplace Code of Conduct, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) identifying whether this finding is a repeat occurrence of a previously identified and closed non-conformance at the same supplier, indicating systemic compliance issues or ineffective corrective actions.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role at the supplier factory responsible for implementing the corrective action and ensuring closure of the finding.

attributes.name: responsible_party_title
attributes.description: Job title or position of the responsible party at the supplier factory, such as Factory Manager, Compliance Officer, or Health & Safety Coordinator.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned to the finding based on severity, likelihood of recurrence, and potential business impact, used for prioritization and supplier risk assessment.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Analysis of the underlying root cause of the non-conformance, identifying systemic issues, process gaps, or resource constraints that led to the finding.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the finding's severity based on risk and impact. Critical: immediate threat to worker safety or legal compliance, requires immediate action. Major: significant non-compliance requiring corrective action. Minor: low-risk non-compliance requiring improvement. Observation: opportunity for improvement without formal non-compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 - Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action must be completed and the finding closed, based on severity level and agreed-upon remediation timeline.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was verified as complete and effective by the auditor or compliance team.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 - Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify completion and effectiveness of the corrective action, such as document review, on-site re-inspection, remote verification via photos/videos, or third-party audit.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 - Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name of the auditor, compliance officer, or third-party inspector who verified the corrective action completion and effectiveness.

products.name: capacity_profile
products.description: Seasonal and rolling production capacity commitments at the factory level, capturing season (SS25, FW25), product category, allocated/reserved/available capacity (units/month), utilization percentage, peak season flags, lead time by product type, minimum and maximum run sizes, and capacity confirmation date. Drives OTB (Open-to-Buy) planning, production scheduling, and factory loading decisions. One factory may have multiple capacity profiles across seasons and product categories.

attributes.name: capacity_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capacity profile record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Capacity reservations in apparel fashion are allocated against cost centers for production budgeting and capacity cost planning. Finance teams track reserved vs. available capacity costs by cost cente

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Factory capacity in apparel is product-category-specific (denim capacity differs from knit capacity). Linking capacity_profile to merchandise_hierarchy enables category-level capacity planning during

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_factory. Business justification: Integrated capacity planning requires reconciling supplier-side capacity profiles against internal production factory records. When a supplier factory is also registered as a production_factory, plann

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Factories commit capacity by season; merchandising requires seasonal capacity visibility for buy plan feasibility assessment, vendor allocation strategy, and OTB budget validation in apparel productio

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or factory for which this capacity profile is defined.

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Number of units already allocated to confirmed purchase orders (PO) or production orders.

attributes.name: available_capacity_units
attributes.description: Number of units still available for booking or allocation within the planning period.

attributes.name: capacity_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory formally confirmed or committed to this capacity allocation.

attributes.name: capacity_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk assessment level for capacity availability based on factory performance, compliance, and external factors (low, medium, high, critical).

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity profile (active, inactive, suspended, expired, pending confirmation).

attributes.name: capacity_type
attributes.description: Classification of capacity status: allocated (assigned to orders), reserved (held for future orders), available (open for booking), committed (contractually bound), or planned (forecasted).

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to express capacity quantities (units, pieces, pairs, dozens, cases).

attributes.name: capacity_units_per_month
attributes.description: Total production capacity expressed in units per month for the specified product category and season.

attributes.name: capacity_valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period for which this capacity profile is valid and applicable.

attributes.name: capacity_valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the period for which this capacity profile is valid and applicable.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of factory compliance certifications (WRAP, FLA, GOTS, OEKO-TEX) relevant to this capacity profile.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for pricing and payment transactions related to this capacity profile (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining delivery and risk transfer responsibilities (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity profile record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time in days from order placement to shipment readiness for this product category at this factory.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units that can be produced in a single production run or order cycle for this product category.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units required per production run or purchase order (PO) for this product category at this factory.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special conditions, constraints, or considerations for this capacity profile.

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time and in-full delivery performance expected from this factory for this capacity profile.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to orders placed under this capacity profile (e.g., NET30, NET60, LC90).

attributes.name: peak_season_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this capacity profile represents a peak production season with higher demand and tighter lead times.

attributes.name: planning_system_source
attributes.description: Name of the source planning system or module from which this capacity profile was created or synchronized (e.g., Anaplan, SAP PP, Oracle RMS).

attributes.name: production_line_count
attributes.description: Number of production lines or assembly lines dedicated to this product category during the capacity period.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Historical quality acceptance rate (percentage of units passing quality inspection) for this factory and product category.

attributes.name: reserved_capacity_units
attributes.description: Number of units reserved or held for anticipated orders but not yet formally allocated.

attributes.name: shift_count
attributes.description: Number of production shifts per day (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts) operating during this capacity period.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total capacity currently utilized, calculated as (allocated + reserved) / total capacity * 100.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of workers or operators allocated to production for this product category during the capacity period.

products.name: vendor_scorecard
products.description: Periodic performance evaluation of vendor and factory performance across operational KPIs, generated monthly/quarterly/seasonally. Captures OTIF (On-Time In-Full) rate, AQL defect rate, on-time sample submission, PP sample approval rate, compliance audit score, sustainability score, responsiveness rating, cost competitiveness index, overall weighted score, performance tier (Preferred/Approved/Conditional/Probation/Delisted), and evaluation period. Drives strategic sourcing decisions, vendor tiering, allocation preferences, and exit/remediation actions.
products.reference: Supplier Performance Management / SAP MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: vendor_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor scorecard evaluation record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Vendor management activities (evaluation, monitoring, remediation) are cost center responsibilities. Links scorecard ownership to departmental budgets for vendor management program costs.

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Apparel vendor scorecards are category-specific — a vendor may perform differently for denim vs. knitwear. Linking to merchandise_hierarchy enables category-level vendor performance KPI reporting, whi

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_factory. Business justification: Factory performance reporting in apparel requires combining supplier scorecard metrics with internal production factory data. Linking vendor_scorecard to production_factory enables integrated factory

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Vendor performance is evaluated by season for tier classification, future buy plan vendor selection, and seasonal OTIF/quality trending; critical for merchandising vendor strategy and sourcing decisio

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier being evaluated in this scorecard.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the scorecard evaluation was formally approved by management and published for use in sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: aql_defect_rate_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) Defect Rate Percent
attributes.description: Percentage of defective units found during quality inspections based on AQL sampling standards. Lower values indicate better quality performance.
attributes.references: ISO 2859-1 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor production capacity allocated to this business during the evaluation period. Indicates strategic partnership depth and allocation priority.

attributes.name: claim_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of orders resulting in quality claims, chargebacks, or Return to Vendor (RTV) actions during the evaluation period. Lower is better.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for evaluator notes, qualitative observations, context on performance issues, or strategic commentary on vendor relationship.

attributes.name: compliance_audit_score
attributes.description: Composite score from social compliance and labor standards audits (WRAP, FLA, BSCI, Sedex). Typically scored 0-100 or letter grade converted to numeric.
attributes.references: Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP), Fair Labor Association (FLA) Standards

attributes.name: cost_competitiveness_index
attributes.description: Index comparing vendor pricing against market benchmarks and peer vendors. Values above 100 indicate above-market pricing; below 100 indicates competitive pricing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this vendor scorecard evaluation is conducted (monthly, quarterly, seasonal, or annual).

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period for this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period for this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the scorecard evaluation. Published scorecards are finalized and used for strategic decisions.

attributes.name: evaluator_role
attributes.description: Job role or title of the evaluator (e.g., Senior Sourcing Manager, Quality Assurance Director, Procurement Lead).

attributes.name: innovation_score
attributes.description: Subjective score evaluating vendor contributions to product innovation, material development, process improvements, and value engineering initiatives.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_performance_days
attributes.description: Average lead time in days from purchase order issuance to delivery during the evaluation period. Shorter lead times improve supply chain agility.

attributes.name: on_time_sample_submission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of product samples (SMS, PP samples) submitted on or before the scheduled deadline per the Time and Action (TNA) calendar.

attributes.name: order_fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity successfully fulfilled without shortages or cancellations. Measures vendor reliability and inventory management.

attributes.name: otif_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on time and in full during the evaluation period. Key operational KPI for supply chain reliability.

attributes.name: overall_weighted_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted score aggregating all KPI dimensions (OTIF, quality, compliance, cost, responsiveness, sustainability) per the scorecard weighting methodology. Primary ranking metric.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Vendor classification tier based on overall weighted score. Preferred vendors receive priority allocation; Probation/Delisted vendors face restrictions or exit.
attributes.references: Internal Vendor Tiering and Allocation Policy

attributes.name: pp_sample_approval_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pre-production samples approved on first submission without requiring rework or resubmission. Indicates design and technical capability.

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: Vendor performance tier from the prior evaluation period. Enables trend analysis and tier movement tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Vendor Tiering and Allocation Policy

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Strategic sourcing recommendation based on scorecard results. Drives allocation decisions, remediation plans, or vendor exit strategies.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the vendor must complete remediation actions and demonstrate improvement. Null if no remediation is required.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal corrective action or remediation plan is required due to performance deficiencies (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: responsiveness_rating
attributes.description: Subjective rating (typically 1-5 or 1-10 scale) assessing vendor communication quality, issue resolution speed, and collaboration effectiveness.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite score evaluating environmental and sustainability practices including certifications (GOTS, OEKO-TEX, BCI), energy efficiency, waste management, and chemical compliance.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Better Cotton Initiative (BCI)

attributes.name: tier_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor tier changed from the previous evaluation period (True) or remained the same (False).

attributes.name: total_po_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to this vendor during the evaluation period. Indicates transaction volume and relationship scale.

attributes.name: total_po_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Purchase Order (PO) Value United States Dollar (USD)
attributes.description: Total value in USD of all purchase orders issued to this vendor during the evaluation period. Provides spend context for performance assessment.

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: Structured risk assessment records for vendors and factories, capturing risk assessment date, risk category (Geopolitical, Financial, Compliance, Capacity, Quality, Environmental, Labor, Logistics, Currency), risk description, likelihood score (1-5), impact score (1-5), inherent risk rating (Low/Medium/High/Critical), mitigation strategy, residual risk rating, risk owner, next review date, and assessment status. Supports supply chain resilience planning and ESG risk reporting.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier risk assessment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Risk assessment activities incur costs (consultant fees, mitigation expenses) allocated to responsible cost centers. Essential for risk management program cost tracking and budget accountability.

attributes.name: merchandise_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merchandise_hierarchy. Business justification: Supplier risk assessments in apparel are scoped to product categories (e.g., chemical compliance risk for childrenswear, restricted substances for footwear). Linking to merchandise_hierarchy enables c

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: risk_assessment currently has vendor_id → vendor and production_factory_id → production.production_factory (cross-domain), but no in-domain FK to supplier.supplier_factory. In apparel supply chain ris

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor being assessed. Links to the supplier master data entity.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk assessment was conducted or recorded.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: The methodology or approach used to conduct the risk assessment. Self-Assessment relies on supplier-provided information. Third-Party Audit uses independent auditors. Site Visit involves on-site inspection. Document Review analyzes certifications and records. Questionnaire uses structured surveys. Scorecard applies a standardized rating framework. attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, WRAP Audit Protocols

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: The current workflow status of the risk assessment record. Draft indicates the assessment is being prepared. Under Review indicates it is awaiting approval. Approved indicates it has been validated and accepted. Closed indicates the risk has been resolved or is no longer relevant. Escalated indicates the risk requires senior management attention.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: The type or trigger of the risk assessment. Initial assessments occur during supplier onboarding, periodic assessments follow a schedule, triggered assessments respond to specific events or incidents.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or organization that conducted the risk assessment or audit, if applicable. Supports traceability and accountability.
attributes.references: WRAP Certification Principles, FLA Labor Standards

attributes.name: business_impact_area
attributes.description: The primary business function or area that would be affected if the risk materializes. Supports prioritization and cross-functional risk management.

attributes.name: certification_reference

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments, notes, or observations related to the risk assessment. Provides context and qualitative insights not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this risk assessment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk was escalated to senior management or a risk committee, if applicable. Tracks critical risk visibility and governance.

attributes.name: esg_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment is related to Environmental, Social, or Governance (ESG) criteria. True if the risk has ESG implications, False otherwise. Supports ESG reporting and sustainability initiatives.

attributes.name: geographic_risk_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or country associated with this risk, if the risk is location-specific. Supports geopolitical and regional risk analysis.

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: A numeric score representing the severity of consequences if the risk materializes. Typically scored on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is Negligible and 5 is Catastrophic. Considers financial, operational, reputational, and compliance impacts.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_rating
attributes.description: The overall risk level before any mitigation measures are applied. Typically derived from the combination of likelihood and impact scores. Low indicates minimal concern, Medium requires monitoring, High requires active management, and Critical demands immediate action and escalation.

attributes.name: likelihood_score
attributes.description: A numeric score representing the probability that the risk will materialize. Typically scored on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is Very Unlikely and 5 is Very Likely. Used in conjunction with impact score to calculate inherent risk rating.

attributes.name: mitigation_cost
attributes.description: The estimated or actual cost of implementing the mitigation strategy, in the company's reporting currency. Supports cost-benefit analysis and risk management budgeting.

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: The current implementation status of the mitigation strategy. Tracks progress from planning through execution.

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: A detailed description of the actions, controls, or measures implemented or planned to reduce the likelihood or impact of the risk. May include supplier development programs, contract clauses, diversification strategies, audits, or contingency plans.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review or reassessment of this risk. Ensures periodic monitoring and updates to risk status and mitigation effectiveness.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to any specific regulation, law, or compliance framework that this risk assessment addresses, such as FTC labeling requirements, CPSC safety standards, or GDPR data protection.
attributes.references: FTC Regulations, CPSC Standards, GDPR, CCPA

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk level remaining after mitigation measures have been applied. Represents the accepted or tolerated risk level. Used to determine if additional mitigation is required or if the risk is within acceptable tolerance.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the risk was resolved, closed, or deemed no longer relevant. Supports risk lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The standard interval at which this risk should be reviewed. High and Critical risks typically require more frequent review than Low risks.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: The primary category of risk being assessed. Geopolitical includes trade restrictions and political instability. Financial covers supplier solvency and payment risk. Compliance includes labor standards, environmental regulations, and certifications. Capacity addresses production volume and lead time risk. Quality covers defect rates and product safety. Environmental includes sustainability and carbon footprint. Labor covers working conditions and fair labor practices. Logistics includes transportation and delivery risk. Currency covers foreign exchange volatility. Reputational includes brand and ethical risk. Cybersecurity covers data protection and IT security. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Geopolitical|Financial|Compliance|Capacity|Quality|Environmental|Labor|Logistics|Currency|Reputational|Cybersecurity — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, FLA Labor Standards, GOTS Environmental Standards

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: A more granular classification of the risk within the primary category. For example, under Compliance, subcategories might include Child Labor, Forced Labor, Wage Violations, or Chemical Safety. Allows for detailed risk taxonomy.
attributes.references: FLA Labor Standards, WRAP Certification Principles

attributes.description: The timestamp when this risk assessment record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
