attributes.description: Grade (1-5 scale) measuring resistance to color change from washing. Grade 5 is excellent, grade 1 is poor.

domains.name: production
domains.description: Captures manufacturing processes, cut-make-trim (CMT) execution, work orders, production scheduling, factory capacity planning, and production milestone tracking. Manages PP samples, bulk production runs, and manufacturing partner coordination across SAP S/4HANA PP.

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core manufacturing work order authorizing production of a specific quantity of a style/SKU at a designated factory. Captures work order number, style reference, factory assignment, ordered and confirmed quantities, production start/end dates, CMT type (Cut/Make/Trim), status lifecycle (draft → released → in-progress → completed → closed), SAP PP order number, season, collection, priority, customer PO reference, and target ex-factory date. SSOT for all bulk production execution instructions. Links downstream to operations, confirmations, cut orders, T&A milestones, and production lots.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work order. Primary key for the work order entity.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: FK to product.bom.bom_id — MUST-HAVE: Links production work orders to the authoritative BOM in the product domain, enabling material requirements planning and cost tracking. Critical after production.bom removal.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product collection this work order belongs to. Links production to merchandising assortment strategy.

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.colorway. Business justification: Work orders are issued per colorway — fabric sourcing, dyeing, and quality inspection are colorway-specific. Existing style_id covers style level only; colorway_id is required for colorway-level produ

attributes.name: production_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Production orders must allocate manufacturing costs to cost centers for standard costing, variance analysis, and factory overhead allocation—core requirement in apparel manufacturing accounting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Work orders require profit center assignment for margin analysis by brand/channel/region, enabling P&L reporting at collection and season level—standard apparel financial reporting requirement.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.routing. Business justification: Every work order executes a specific manufacturing routing that defines the sequence of operations, work centers, and standard times. This is core SAP PP functionality. The routing defines HOW to manu

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandising season this work order supports. Links production to collection planning and retail calendar.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Work orders in apparel are placed at SKU level (style+color+size) for size-ratio production planning, costing, and finished goods receipt. The plain 'sku' column is a denormalized reference; replacing

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style being manufactured in this work order. Links to the product master style definition.

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: FK to supplier.factory.factory_id — MUST-HAVE: Links production work orders to the factory master for capacity planning, compliance verification, and production allocation decisions.

attributes.name: tech_pack_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.tech_pack. Business justification: Work orders must reference the specific tech pack version issued to the factory to ensure production conforms to approved specifications. Apparel compliance and quality audits require traceability fro

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Work orders must track the executing vendor for vendor performance scorecards, payment processing, compliance audits, and OTIF reporting. Essential for vendor management and production accountability

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or warehouse where finished goods will be received. Links production to supply chain fulfillment.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.wholesale_account. Business justification: B2B wholesale accounts commission production runs for their orders. Work orders track which account the production is for, enabling account-level production tracking, capacity allocation, and fulfillm

attributes.name: actual_ex_factory_date
attributes.description: Actual date when finished goods departed the factory. Used to measure OTIF performance and update logistics schedules.

attributes.name: aql_level
attributes.description: Acceptable Quality Limit standard applied for inspection (e.g., 2.5, 4.0). Defines the maximum acceptable defect rate per ISO 2859 sampling standards.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: cmt_type
attributes.description: Manufacturing service model defining the scope of work performed by the factory. Cut-Make-Trim includes all production steps; Make-Trim excludes cutting; Full Package includes material sourcing.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work order requires compliance certifications (e.g., OEKO-TEX, GOTS, WRAP, FLA). True if certifications must be provided before shipment.
attributes.references: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed by the factory as feasible for production. May differ from ordered quantity based on capacity constraints or material availability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this work order. Typically USD for international apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the final destination of finished goods. Used for customs, compliance, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the division of costs and risks between buyer and seller. FOB (Free on Board) is common in apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special instructions, production requirements, or coordination details for this work order.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of units authorized for production in this work order. Represents the target production volume.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms agreed with the factory for this work order (e.g., 30% deposit, 70% on shipment). Defines cash flow and financial settlement.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for production scheduling. Critical orders receive expedited processing and resource allocation.

attributes.name: produced_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity completed and confirmed through production execution. Updated as production progresses and goods are received.

attributes.name: production_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when production execution is completed. Marks readiness for final inspection and shipment preparation.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: production_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when production execution begins at the factory. Key milestone in Time and Action (TNA) calendar.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of quality inspection for this work order. Passed status is required before goods can be shipped.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity rejected during quality inspection. Represents units that failed quality standards and cannot be shipped.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the customer or distribution center requires delivery of finished goods. Drives production scheduling and logistics planning.

attributes.name: sap_pp_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA PP module production order number. System of record identifier linking this work order to the ERP production planning system.

attributes.name: shipping_mode
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode for delivering finished goods from factory to destination. Impacts lead time and logistics cost.

attributes.name: target_ex_factory_date
attributes.description: Target date for goods to leave the factory. Critical milestone for logistics planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance measurement.
attributes.references: Infor PLM Time and Action Calendar

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total manufacturing cost for this work order (unit cost × ordered quantity). Represents the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for this production run.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit for manufacturing this work order. Includes CMT charges, materials (if applicable), and factory overhead. Used for COGS calculation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this work order. Typically pieces for apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this work order. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work order record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the work order. Human-readable unique reference used across manufacturing systems and communications with factory partners.

attributes.name: work_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work order. Tracks progression from initial creation through production execution to final closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|released|confirmed|in_progress|completed|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order Status

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this work order. Audit trail for accountability.

products.name: work_order_operation
products.description: Individual manufacturing operation or routing step within a work order, representing each discrete production activity (cutting, sewing, finishing, pressing, packing). Captures operation sequence number, operation code, work center, standard time (SAM — Standard Allowed Minutes), actual time, planned quantity, confirmed quantity, operation status, and yield percentage. Derived from SAP PP routing operations.

attributes.name: work_order_operation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work order operation. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: operation_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual operations require cost center assignment for activity-based costing, labor cost allocation by department, and detailed production cost variance analysis—standard in apparel manufacturing c

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (production resource or machine) where this operation is performed. Links to factory floor resources.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order that contains this operation. Links this operation to the overall production order.

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time taken to complete this operation, measured in minutes. Used to calculate efficiency variance against SAM.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the operation execution was completed on the factory floor, captured from production confirmation.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the operation execution began on the factory floor, captured from production confirmation.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation document number generated when the operation is confirmed in the system, linking to goods movement and time confirmation.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operation was confirmed in the system, marking the official completion record.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of units successfully processed and confirmed for this operation. Used to track production progress and yield.

attributes.name: control_key
attributes.description: SAP control key that determines how the operation is processed, including scheduling, costing, and confirmation requirements (e.g., PP01, PP02, PP03).

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the operation cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY, INR, BDT).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this operation record was first created in the system, typically when the work order was released.

attributes.name: efficiency_percentage
attributes.description: Operation efficiency calculated as (standard_allowed_minutes / actual_duration_minutes) * 100. Measures operator and work center performance against standard.

attributes.name: factory_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code identifying the manufacturing facility or factory where this operation is performed (e.g., BDH for Bangladesh Dhaka, CNS for China Shenzhen).

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Quality inspection lot number assigned to this operation for tracking quality control results and defects.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality inspection is required after completing this operation. True if inspection is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours consumed for this operation, including direct production time, setup, and teardown. Used for labor costing and capacity analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this operation record was last updated in the system, tracking the most recent change to any field.

attributes.name: machine_hours
attributes.description: Total machine or equipment hours utilized for this operation. Used for machine costing and utilization tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this operation, including special instructions, issues encountered, or deviations from standard process.

attributes.name: operation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of manufacturing operation (e.g., CUT, SEW, FINISH, PRESS, PACK, INSPECT, EMBROIDER, PRINT).

attributes.name: operation_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this operation, including labor, machine, overhead, and material costs. Used for production costing and variance analysis.

attributes.name: operation_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the manufacturing operation, including specific instructions, techniques, or requirements for execution.

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The unique operation number within the routing sequence, typically a 4-digit code (e.g., 0010, 0020, 0030) that defines the order of manufacturing steps.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of this operation within the work order routing. Determines the execution order of manufacturing steps.

attributes.name: operation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manufacturing operation indicating its execution state in the production workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|released|in_progress|completed|confirmed|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when this operation is planned to be completed based on standard times and production scheduling.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Target quantity of units planned to be processed in this operation based on the work order requirements.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when this operation is planned to begin execution based on production scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Identifier for the production line or assembly line where this operation is executed. Used for line balancing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: Quality inspection result status for this operation indicating whether output meets quality standards.

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units requiring rework or reprocessing due to quality issues identified during or after this operation.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units rejected or scrapped during this operation due to quality defects or production errors.

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time required to prepare the work center, tools, and materials before starting production for this operation, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift during which this operation was executed. Used for shift performance analysis and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: standard_allowed_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time allocated for completing this operation per unit, measured in minutes. Used for capacity planning, costing, and efficiency measurement in apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time required to clean up, reset, or prepare the work center for the next operation after completing this operation, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantities in this operation (EA=Each, PC=Piece, DZ=Dozen, PR=Pair, SET=Set, KG=Kilogram, M=Meter, YD=Yard). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|DZ|PR|SET|KG|M|YD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of good output relative to input for this operation, calculated as (confirmed_quantity / planned_quantity) * 100. Key metric for production efficiency.

products.name: order_confirmation
products.description: Goods confirmation event recording actual output quantities, scrap, rework, and labor hours against a work order operation. Captures confirmation date, confirmed yield quantity, scrap quantity, rework quantity, actual machine time, actual labor time, shift, operator ID, and confirmation type (partial, final). Represents the SAP PP goods confirmation transaction (CO11N/CO15).

attributes.name: order_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production order confirmation record. Primary key for the goods confirmation transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which labor and overhead costs from this confirmation are allocated. Used for management accounting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Order confirmations (goods receipt postings, activity confirmations) directly trigger FI journal entries in SAP PP/CO integration — 'Production Order Settlement' and 'Goods Receipt Posting' processes.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.lot. Business justification: An order_confirmation records actual goods output (yield_quantity, scrap_quantity, rework_quantity) against a work_order_operation. In CMT apparel manufacturing, confirmations are posted at the lot/ba

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or semi-finished material being produced in this operation. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility or plant where this production confirmation occurred. Used for multi-site production tracking.

attributes.name: reversed_confirmation_order_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original confirmation record that this reversal transaction is cancelling. Creates audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing work center or production line where this operation was executed. Represents the physical production resource.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production work order against which this confirmation is recorded. Links to the manufacturing order being executed.

attributes.name: work_order_operation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific operation within the work order routing that this confirmation applies to. Represents a discrete manufacturing step.

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the production activity performed during this operation. Used for activity-based costing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total number of labor hours consumed to complete this operation. Used for labor cost calculation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: actual_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total number of machine or equipment hours utilized during this operation. Used for equipment utilization analysis and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether component materials were automatically consumed via backflushing when this confirmation was posted. Used for automated material consumption.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch or lot number assigned to the output from this confirmation. Used for traceability and quality control.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the production activity was completed and confirmed. Represents the actual manufacturing event date.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing confirmation document number generated by the production system. Used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the confirmation record indicating whether it is in draft, submitted for approval, posted to inventory, cancelled, or reversed.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the confirmation transaction was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and real-time production tracking.

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation transaction indicating whether this is a partial completion, final completion, milestone achievement, rework confirmation, or scrap reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: final_confirmation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final confirmation for the operation, signaling that no further output is expected and the operation can be closed.

attributes.name: goods_movement_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the confirmed quantities have been posted to inventory through a goods receipt transaction. Links confirmation to inventory update.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The material document number generated when confirmed output was posted to inventory. Used for inventory reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the confirmation was posted to inventory and financial ledgers. May differ from confirmation date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation triggers a mandatory quality inspection before the output can be moved to finished goods inventory.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the quality inspection associated with this confirmation. Determines whether output can be released to inventory.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation has been reversed or cancelled. Used to track corrections and adjustments to previously posted confirmations.

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units that require rework or reprocessing to meet quality standards. Represents non-conforming output that can be salvaged.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or units that were scrapped or rejected during this production operation due to defects or quality failures.

attributes.name: setup_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent preparing equipment, tooling, and materials before production could begin. Separate from actual production time.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The production shift during which this confirmation was recorded. Used for shift-based performance analysis and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: teardown_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent cleaning, resetting, or breaking down equipment after the production operation was completed.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit in which quantities are measured and reported for this confirmation. Common values include EA (each), PC (piece), KG (kilogram), M (meter).

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context about production variances, quality issues, or operational challenges encountered during this confirmation.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any variance between planned and actual quantities or times. Used for root cause analysis of production inefficiencies.

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of good output produced and confirmed for this operation. Represents conforming units that passed quality inspection.

products.name: production_factory
products.description: Master record for each manufacturing facility (CMT factory, OEM, ODM) engaged in production. Captures factory code, factory name, legal entity name, country, city, address, factory type (CMT/OEM/ODM/internal), production capabilities (woven, knit, denim, footwear, accessories), certified capacity (units/week), compliance certifications (WRAP, BSCI, FLA, OEKO-TEX, SA8000), audit status, lead time profile, minimum order quantity, and active flag. SSOT for factory identity within the production domain; supplier domain owns the broader vendor relationship and commercial terms.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing facility. Primary key for the factory entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Factories operate as cost centers for overhead allocation, factory performance analysis, and manufacturing cost tracking—fundamental to apparel manufacturing accounting and factory profitability analy

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Factories map to profit centers for regional/brand P&L segmentation in multi-brand apparel operations, enabling factory-level margin analysis and strategic sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the factory is currently active and available for new production orders. Inactive factories are retained for historical reference but excluded from sourcing and planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the factory facility. Used for shipping, audits, and official correspondence.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building name, floor, or suite number.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score from the most recent audit, typically on a 0-100 scale. Used for factory performance benchmarking and risk assessment.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: certified_capacity_units_per_week
attributes.description: Maximum production capacity in units per week as certified by the factory and validated through capacity audits. Used for production planning and allocation decisions.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the factory is located. Used for logistics planning and regional risk assessment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the factory is located. Used for duty calculation, trade compliance, and origin marking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, Harmonized System (HS) Code Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factory record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for pricing and invoicing with this factory (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY, BDT, VND).

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for factory communications, Purchase Order (PO) transmission, and Time and Action (TNA) updates.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees working at the factory. Used for capacity assessment, social compliance monitoring, and risk evaluation.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: facility_size_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area of the factory in square meters. Used for capacity planning and facility assessment.

attributes.name: factory_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the factory, used across systems and documentation. Typically alphanumeric code assigned during factory onboarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Master Data Standards

attributes.name: factory_name
attributes.description: Common business name of the manufacturing facility as used in operational communications and planning.

attributes.name: factory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing relationship model. CMT (Cut Make Trim) = factory provides labor only; OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) = factory manufactures to buyer specs; ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) = factory provides design and manufacturing; INTERNAL = company-owned facility; HYBRID = mixed model; SUBCONTRACTOR = secondary tier supplier.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Standard International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) used for shipments from this factory. Defines responsibility for shipping costs, insurance, and risk transfer. FOB (Free on Board) is most common in apparel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FOB|FCA|CIF|DDP|DAP|CPT|CIP — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance or quality audit conducted at the factory. Used to track audit recency and schedule follow-up audits.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production lead time in days from Purchase Order (PO) confirmation to ex-factory shipment readiness. Used in Time and Action (TNA) calendar planning.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Official registered legal name of the factory entity as it appears on contracts, licenses, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity in units that the factory requires per style or per order to accept production. Critical for buy plan feasibility and allocation planning.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or quality audit. Used for audit planning and vendor compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Association (FLA), WRAP Certification Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional factory information, special handling instructions, strategic notes, or historical context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the factory was approved and onboarded into the company's vendor network. Used for relationship tenure analysis and vendor lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: otif_performance_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Performance Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered On Time In Full over the trailing 12 months. Key performance indicator for factory reliability and used in allocation decisions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the factory (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Letter of Credit (LC), 30% deposit + 70% on shipment). Used for cash flow planning and Purchase Order (PO) processing.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Payment Terms

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the factory. Used for operational coordination and emergency communication.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the factory location. Used for logistics and regional analysis.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factory has preferred vendor status based on performance, quality, compliance, and strategic relationship. Preferred vendors receive priority allocation and longer-term commitments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: production_capabilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories and manufacturing techniques the factory is equipped to produce (e.g., woven, knit, denim, footwear, accessories, leather goods, outerwear, activewear, swimwear, intimate apparel).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Capabilities

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Letter grade quality rating based on defect rates, inspection results, and customer returns. A = excellent (defect rate <1%), B = good (1-2%), C = acceptable (2-4%), D = needs improvement (4-6%), F = unacceptable (>6%).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) Standards

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification for the factory based on compliance history, audit findings, geographic risk, and operational stability. Used for sourcing decisions and monitoring frequency.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, Supply Chain Risk Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the factory is located. Used for regional compliance and logistics routing.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite sustainability score (0-100) based on environmental practices, energy efficiency, waste management, water usage, and chemical compliance. Used for ESG reporting and sustainable sourcing initiatives.
attributes.references: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with the factory was terminated or the factory was deactivated. Null for active factories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master Data

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the factory location (e.g., Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Dhaka, Europe/Istanbul). Used for scheduling meetings, coordinating shipments, and Time and Action (TNA) planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bulk fabric receipt record at the CMT factory. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Fabric receipts must link to AP invoices for three-way matching (PO-GR-IR), accrual accuracy, and fabric cost verification—fundamental procurement accounting control in apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.material. Business justification: Fabric receipts track specific material articles for shade lot traceability, quality inspection, and BOM reconciliation. Removes denormalized fabric attributes (article_code, description, composition,

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order. Business justification: Bulk fabric receipts are goods receipts against sourcing POs. Direct FK enables AP invoice matching and PO receipt reconciliation — a mandatory apparel procurement process where fabric received at fac

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sourcing Purchase Order Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order_line. Business justification: Bulk fabric receipts fulfill specific sourcing PO lines for material procurement. Direct FK enables three-way AP matching (PO line → goods receipt → invoice) — a standard apparel finance process for f

attributes.name: supplier_factory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier_factory. Business justification: Fabric traceability and compliance audits require identifying the specific supplier factory that produced or shipped bulk fabric, not just the vendor entity. This supports material traceability report

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or mill that manufactured and supplied the fabric. Critical for supplier performance tracking and quality management.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production work order or bulk production run that this fabric receipt is intended to support. Enables production scheduling and material availability tracking.

attributes.name: approved_for_production_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fabric was officially approved and released for use in production cutting. Gates the start of cutting operations.

attributes.name: aql_inspection_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the AQL-based statistical sampling inspection. Indicates whether the fabric lot meets the agreed quality standards.

attributes.name: aql_level
attributes.description: The AQL level applied during inspection (e.g., 1.0, 2.5, 4.0). Defines the maximum acceptable defect rate for the fabric lot.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch number assigned by the fabric mill. Enables traceability back to the manufacturing process and raw material sources.

attributes.name: color_fastness_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the color fastness test, indicating whether the fabric color is resistant to fading or bleeding during washing, rubbing, or light exposure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fabric receipt record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: The total number of defects identified during the fabric inspection. Used to calculate defect rate and determine acceptance or rejection.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Description of the primary types of defects found during inspection (e.g., holes, stains, weaving flaws, color inconsistency). Supports root cause analysis and supplier feedback.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled delivery date from the purchase order or supplier commitment. Used to calculate delivery performance and OTIF metrics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order Delivery Schedule

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fabric quality inspection was completed. Used to track inspection cycle time and compliance with receiving procedures.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: The current status of the quality inspection process for the received fabric. Determines whether the fabric can be released for cutting.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: The name of the quality inspector who performed the fabric inspection. Supports accountability and quality audit trails.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fabric receipt record was most recently modified. Tracks the currency of the data and supports change auditing.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of fabric originally ordered on the purchase order. Used for variance analysis against received quantity.

attributes.name: packing_list_number
attributes.description: The packing list or delivery note number accompanying the fabric shipment. Used for cross-verification during receiving and inspection.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fabric was physically received at the CMT factory. Gates the earliest possible cut-start date for production scheduling.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fabric receipt transaction, typically generated by the warehouse management system or factory receiving system. Used for tracking and reference in communications with suppliers and production planning.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: The overall status of the fabric receipt in the factory workflow. Tracks progression from physical receipt through inspection to production release.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fabric receipt was recorded in the warehouse management system. Supports detailed logistics and lead time analysis.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of fabric received at the factory. Compared against ordered quantity to identify shortages or overages.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, observations, or special handling instructions related to the fabric receipt. Supports communication between receiving, quality, and production teams.

attributes.name: roll_count
attributes.description: The number of fabric rolls received in this shipment. Used for physical inventory verification and warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: shade_lot_number
attributes.description: The dye lot or shade lot number assigned by the mill. Ensures color consistency within a production run, as different lots may have slight color variations.

attributes.name: shrinkage_percentage_length
attributes.description: The measured shrinkage percentage in the length (warp) direction after washing. Used to verify compliance with technical specifications.

attributes.name: shrinkage_percentage_width
attributes.description: The measured shrinkage percentage in the width (weft) direction after washing. Used to verify compliance with technical specifications.

attributes.name: shrinkage_test_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the fabric shrinkage test, indicating whether the fabric meets the specified shrinkage tolerance after washing. Critical for garment fit and quality.
attributes.references: AATCC 135 Dimensional Changes in Automatic Home Laundering

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The warehouse location or bin where the received fabric is stored. Supports efficient material retrieval for cutting operations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which fabric quantity is measured (meters, yards, kilograms, pounds, or rolls). Must align with purchase order and production planning units.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between ordered and received quantity (received minus ordered). Positive values indicate overage, negative values indicate shortage.

products.name: cut_order
products.description: Cutting order record authorizing the cutting of fabric panels for a specific style, colorway, and size ratio within a work order. Captures cut order number, cut date, marker reference (CAD marker ID), fabric consumption per unit, total fabric allocated (meters/yards), planned vs actual panels cut, size ratio breakdown, ply count, cut efficiency percentage (vs marker plan), cut room supervisor, and cut status (planned, in-progress, completed). Represents the first physical production step in CMT manufacturing and gates downstream sewing operations.

attributes.name: cut_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cut order record. Primary key.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bom. Business justification: Cut orders consume fabric per BOM specifications for marker efficiency calculation, fabric variance tracking, and costing reconciliation. No existing BOM reference on cut_order.

attributes.name: bulk_fabric_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.bulk_fabric_receipt. Business justification: A cut_order authorizes the cutting of fabric panels from a specific bulk fabric receipt. This FK establishes the direct traceability link between fabric consumption (cut_order) and fabric sourcing (bu

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific colorway variant of the style being cut.

attributes.name: cutting_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cutting operations track cost centers for fabric utilization efficiency, cutting department cost allocation, and marker efficiency variance analysis—standard in apparel production costing.

attributes.name: marker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAD marker layout used for this cut. The marker defines the pattern piece arrangement on fabric for optimal material utilization.

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility where the cutting operation is performed. Links to factory master data.

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sourcing Purchase Order Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order_line. Business justification: Cut orders fulfill specific sourcing PO lines by style/colorway/size. Direct FK enables cut-to-PO traceability — a standard apparel production control process where cut quantities are validated agains

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style being cut. Links to the product style master in PLM system.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order that this cut order is part of. Links to the manufacturing work order in SAP S/4HANA PP.

attributes.name: actual_panels_count
attributes.description: Actual number of fabric panels cut during execution. Used for yield tracking and quality control.

attributes.name: bundle_ticket_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether bundle tickets have been generated for the cut panels to track them through sewing operations. True when cut panels are bundled and tagged for downstream workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cut order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: cut_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cutting operation was executed. Primary business event timestamp for this cut order.

attributes.name: cut_efficiency_percentage
attributes.description: Actual cutting efficiency achieved versus the marker plan, expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (actual fabric consumed / planned fabric consumption) * 100. Key KPI for material utilization and waste reduction.

attributes.name: cut_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the cutting operation was completed. Used for cycle time calculation and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: cut_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cut order, externally visible and used for tracking and communication with cut room supervisors and production planners.

attributes.name: cut_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the cutting operation began. Used for cycle time analysis and labor productivity tracking.

attributes.name: cut_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cut order. Tracks progression through the cutting workflow and gates downstream sewing operations.

attributes.name: cutting_machine_code
attributes.description: Reference to the cutting equipment used (manual table, straight knife, die cutter, laser cutter, automated spreader). Links to equipment asset master.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defective panels identified during cutting or post-cut inspection. Used for quality tracking and scrap analysis.

attributes.name: defect_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of defects encountered during cutting (e.g., fabric flaws, miscuts, pattern misalignment). Used for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: fabric_consumption_per_unit
attributes.description: Planned fabric consumption per garment unit based on marker efficiency, measured in meters or yards. Used for material costing and yield analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Bill of Materials (BOM)

attributes.name: fabric_consumption_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for fabric consumption (meters, yards, or feet).

attributes.name: marker_efficiency_percentage
attributes.description: Theoretical marker efficiency from the CAD marker layout, representing the percentage of fabric utilized in the marker versus waste. Baseline for cut efficiency comparison.

attributes.name: marker_reference_code
attributes.description: External marker code from CAD system used for cross-reference and traceability to the digital marker file.

attributes.name: planned_panels_count
attributes.description: Number of fabric panels planned to be cut based on the marker layout and order quantity.

attributes.name: ply_count
attributes.description: Number of fabric layers (plies) stacked and cut simultaneously in this cut order. Higher ply counts improve efficiency but require precision equipment.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Production priority assigned to this cut order. Influences scheduling sequence and resource allocation in the cut room.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Quality control status for the cut panels. Indicates whether the cut pieces meet quality standards for pattern accuracy, edge finish, and fabric integrity before release to sewing.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: General notes or special instructions related to this cut order (e.g., special handling requirements, fabric characteristics, customer-specific requirements).

attributes.name: scheduled_cut_date
attributes.description: Originally planned date for the cutting operation based on production scheduling and TNA (Time and Action) calendar.

attributes.name: size_ratio_breakdown
attributes.description: Size distribution for this cut order, typically expressed as ratio notation (e.g., XS:2, S:4, M:6, L:4, XL:2). Defines the quantity of each size to be cut.

attributes.name: total_fabric_allocated
attributes.description: Total fabric quantity allocated to this cut order in the specified unit of measure. Represents the material reservation for this cutting operation.

attributes.name: total_fabric_consumed
attributes.description: Actual fabric quantity consumed during cutting execution. Captured post-cut for variance analysis and material accounting.

attributes.name: total_units_cut
attributes.description: Actual number of garment units cut and passed to downstream sewing operations. May differ from planned due to fabric defects or cutting errors.

attributes.name: total_units_planned
attributes.description: Total number of garment units planned to be produced from this cut order across all sizes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order Quantity

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cut order record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

products.name: routing
products.description: Manufacturing routing master defining the standard sequence of operations and work centers required to produce a style at a specific factory. Captures routing version, total SAM (Standard Allowed Minutes), number of operations, machine type requirements, skill level requirements, line balancing targets, routing status, and effective date range. Derived from SAP PP routing master (CA01). Used for capacity planning, CMT cost calculation, and as the template from which work_order_operations are generated.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing routing master record.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Routing templates are category-specific (footwear construction differs from apparel). Supports routing library management and category-level standard costing. No existing category reference on routing

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Routings define standard costs per operation (SAM × labor rate) assigned to cost centers — the 'Standard Cost Routing' process in SAP PP/CO. Apparel costing teams use routing-to-cost-center links for

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility or CMT (Cut Make Trim) partner where this routing is executed.

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style or product that this routing defines the manufacturing process for.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the industrial engineer or production manager who approved this routing for production use.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this routing was formally approved for production use.

attributes.name: cmt_cost_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cut Make Trim (CMT) Cost Per Unit
attributes.description: Calculated CMT (Cut Make Trim) cost per unit based on total SAM, labor rates, and overhead allocation. Used for product costing and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: complexity_rating
attributes.description: Overall complexity rating of this routing based on number of operations, skill requirements, and technical difficulty. Used for capacity planning and factory assignment.

attributes.name: critical_path_operations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operation sequence numbers that form the critical path for this routing. These operations determine the minimum production time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for CMT cost per unit (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this routing version is no longer valid for new production. Null indicates the routing is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this routing version becomes valid and can be used for production planning and work order generation.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this routing record was last modified. Used to track routing changes and improvements over time.

attributes.name: line_balancing_target
attributes.description: Target line balancing efficiency percentage for this routing. Represents the ideal distribution of work across operations to minimize bottlenecks.

attributes.name: machine_type_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of machine types required to execute this routing (e.g., single needle, overlock, flatlock, buttonhole, bartack, pressing).

attributes.name: maximum_batch_size
attributes.description: Maximum production batch size that this routing can handle without requiring line reconfiguration or additional resources.

attributes.name: minimum_batch_size
attributes.description: Minimum production batch size for which this routing is economically viable. Below this quantity, setup costs make production inefficient.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this routing. May include historical context, change reasons, or production tips.

attributes.name: operation_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete manufacturing operations defined in this routing sequence.

attributes.name: production_line_type
attributes.description: Type of production line configuration required for this routing. Modular lines use flexible workstations, progressive bundle systems move work in batches, unit production systems use overhead conveyors, and lean cells use cellular manufacturing.

attributes.name: quality_check_points
attributes.description: Number of quality inspection checkpoints defined within this routing sequence to ensure product quality standards.

attributes.name: routing_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing, typically a combination of style code and factory code.

attributes.name: routing_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the manufacturing routing including special instructions, quality requirements, and production notes.

attributes.name: routing_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the routing, typically including style name and factory name for easy identification.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Draft routings are under development, approved routings are ready for use, active routings are in production, inactive routings are temporarily suspended, and obsolete routings are retired.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing based on its purpose. Standard routings are the default process, alternative routings are backup options, prototype routings are for PP (Pre-Production) samples, sample routings are for SMS (Sample Management System), and bulk production routings are for high-volume manufacturing.

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes required to set up the production line before starting this routing. Includes machine setup, material preparation, and line configuration.

attributes.name: skill_level_requirements
attributes.description: Minimum operator skill level required to execute this routing. Used for workforce planning and training needs assessment.

attributes.name: special_equipment_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special equipment or tools required for this routing beyond standard sewing machines (e.g., heat press, ultrasonic welder, laser cutter, embroidery machine).

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Sustainability rating of this routing based on energy consumption, waste generation, and environmental impact. Scale of 0-100 with higher scores indicating more sustainable processes.

attributes.name: target_efficiency_percentage
attributes.description: Target production efficiency percentage for this routing. Used to calculate expected output and labor costs.

attributes.name: target_output_per_hour
attributes.description: Expected number of units that can be produced per hour when this routing is executed at standard efficiency.

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes required to tear down the production line after completing this routing. Includes cleanup, machine reset, and material removal.

attributes.name: total_sam
attributes.description: Total Standard Allowed Minutes for completing all operations in the routing. Used for capacity planning, CMT (Cut Make Trim) cost calculation, and labor costing. Sum of SAM values across all operations.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the routing to track changes and improvements over time. Incremented when routing is revised.

products.name: work_center
products.description: Work center master record representing a production unit (sewing line, cutting room, finishing department, pressing station, packing line) within a factory. Captures work center code, work center name, factory reference, department type, available capacity (hours/day), efficiency rate, number of machines, number of operators, work center category (machine, labor, mixed), and active status. Used for capacity planning and production routing in SAP PP.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work center. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility where this work center is located.

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: Capacity category code used for grouping work centers with similar capacity characteristics in capacity planning.

attributes.name: capacity_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Available production capacity of the work center measured in hours per day. Used for capacity planning and production scheduling.

attributes.name: control_key
attributes.description: SAP PP control key that determines which operations are relevant for scheduling, capacity planning, and costing at this work center.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code associated with this work center for cost allocation and tracking in SAP FI/CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Master

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this work center record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department_type
attributes.description: Type of production department this work center belongs to within the apparel manufacturing process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cutting|sewing|finishing|pressing|packing|embroidery|printing|quality_inspection — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: efficiency_rate_percent
attributes.description: Standard efficiency rate of the work center expressed as a percentage. Represents the ratio of standard time to actual time for production operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Efficiency

attributes.name: formula_key
attributes.description: Key identifying the formula used to calculate standard values (setup time, machine time, labor time) for operations at this work center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Standard Value Key

attributes.name: labor_time_per_unit_minutes
attributes.description: Standard labor time per production unit, measured in minutes. Used for workforce planning and costing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing Labor Time

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this work center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was last modified.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Physical location description within the factory (e.g., Building A Floor 2, Production Hall 3 Zone B).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: machine_time_per_unit_minutes
attributes.description: Standard machine processing time per production unit, measured in minutes. Used for capacity planning and costing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing Machine Time

attributes.name: move_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time required to move materials to the next work center after operation completion, measured in minutes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing Move Time

attributes.name: number_of_machines
attributes.description: Total count of machines or equipment units available in this work center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: number_of_operators
attributes.description: Total count of operators or workers assigned to this work center for production operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Planning group code used to organize work centers for capacity planning and production scheduling purposes.

attributes.name: quality_certification_code
attributes.description: Quality certification or compliance code applicable to this work center (e.g., ISO 9001, WRAP, OEKO-TEX).

attributes.name: queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard queue time (waiting time before operation starts) at this work center, measured in minutes. Used in production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing Queue Time

attributes.name: scheduling_type
attributes.description: Scheduling method used for operations at this work center: forward scheduling from start date, backward scheduling from due date, or midpoint scheduling.

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard setup time required to prepare the work center for a production operation, measured in minutes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing Setup Time

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Operating shift pattern for this work center (single shift, two shifts, three shifts, or continuous 24/7 operation).

attributes.name: standard_value_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for standard time values (minutes, hours, seconds, days) used in capacity and scheduling calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Standard Value Unit

attributes.name: utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Current utilization rate of the work center expressed as a percentage of available capacity. Calculated from actual production data.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this work center record becomes effective and available for production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this work center record remains effective. Null indicates no planned end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: work_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the work center based on resource type: machine-intensive, labor-intensive, or mixed operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Category

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the work center used in production planning and routing. Externally-known unique code used in SAP PP module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: work_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the work center (e.g., Sewing Line 3, Cutting Room A, Finishing Department B).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: work_center_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the work center in its lifecycle. Determines availability for production planning and scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Status

products.name: lot
products.description: Production lot or batch record representing a discrete manufacturing run of a style/SKU at a factory, enabling end-to-end traceability from raw materials through finished goods. Captures lot number, work order reference, factory, style/SKU, production date range, quantity produced, fabric shade lot references, cut order references, operator/line assignment, lot status (open, closed, on-hold), and traceability chain linking upstream material lots to downstream carton/shipment IDs. Supports recall scenarios, customer complaint investigation, regulatory compliance (CPSIA, EU textile regulation), and batch-level quality metrics. SSOT for production batch identity within the production domain.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production lot or batch. Primary key. [ROLE: MASTER_RESOURCE - canonical entity representing a discrete manufacturing run]

attributes.name: bulk_fabric_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.bulk_fabric_receipt. Business justification: A production lot (batch) is manufactured from fabric received in a specific bulk_fabric_receipt. This FK enables full material traceability from fabric receipt through cutting and sewing to finished l

attributes.name: buy_plan_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buy_plan_line. Business justification: Lots are the physical production output at SKU/size level; buy plan lines are the SKU-level purchase commitments. Apparel operations require lot-to-buy-plan-line traceability for receipt confirmation,

attributes.name: colorway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.colorway. Business justification: Production lots are colorway-specific for shade lot control and quality traceability. Reuses existing colorway_code(unlinked) pattern but needs proper FK. Removes denormalized colorway_code.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Production lots require cost center assignment for batch costing, production variance tracking by lot, and quality cost analysis—enables detailed cost control in apparel manufacturing.

attributes.name: cut_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cut order that generated the fabric panels for this lot.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing line or assembly line where this lot was produced.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center Assignment

attributes.name: production_factory_id
attributes.description: Manufacturing facility where this lot was produced.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Lots need profit center links for collection/season profitability analysis, enabling margin tracking at production batch level for apparel financial planning and performance analysis.

attributes.name: rework_source_lot_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on lot (rework_source_lot_id)

attributes.name: schedule_id

attributes.name: season_id

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Production lots track finished goods at SKU level for inventory reconciliation, quality traceability, and carton labeling. The plain 'sku' column is denormalized; sku_id FK enables lot-to-SKU traceabi

attributes.name: sourcing_purchase_order_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sourcing Purchase Order Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sourcing.sourcing_purchase_order_line. Business justification: Production lots fulfill specific sourcing PO lines (by SKU, size, color). This link enables PO line fulfillment tracking — a core apparel operations report showing ordered vs produced quantity by PO l

attributes.name: style_id
attributes.description: Reference to the style or design being manufactured in this lot.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order that authorized this production lot.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Order Management

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units that passed quality inspection and are approved for shipment.

attributes.name: aql_level

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Core financial ledger handling financial planning, budgeting, cost accounting (COGS), revenue recognition, AP/AR, general ledger, statutory reporting per IFRS/GAAP, and EBITDA analysis. Manages EOM close, financial consolidation, GMROI, margin analysis, landed cost (LDP) accounting, and profitability analysis by channel, product, and region via SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Unified organizational cost and profit object master in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, representing cost centers (overhead allocation receivers), profit centers (autonomous profitability segments), and the allocation cycles that distribute costs between them. Captures organizational attributes (number, name, hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, company code, validity period, activity type, segment classification by brand/channel/product line/region) and allocation transactions (cycle, sender, receiver, method, allocated amount, fiscal period). Supports overhead allocation, COGS buildup, budget control, channel-level profitability (DTC vs. wholesale vs. retail), EBITDA reporting, and internal cost distribution for apparel operations.
