products.name: profit_center
products.description: Master record for profit centers in SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA, representing autonomous business segments (e.g., brand, channel, product line, region) for which profitability is measured independently. Tracks revenue, COGS, gross margin, and EBITDA contribution by profit center. Essential for channel-level (DTC vs. wholesale vs. retail) and product-line profitability analysis in apparel fashion.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profit center in SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA. Primary key for the profit center master record.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Profit centers belong to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used for allocating shared costs and overhead to this profit center. Direct for directly traceable costs; step-down for sequential allocation; reciprocal for mutual service allocation; activity-based for ABC costing.

attributes.name: analysis_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period for which profit center performance is analyzed. Format YYYYMM (e.g., 202312 for December 2023). Used for period-over-period EBITDA and margin analysis.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier for brand-level profit centers in multi-brand apparel fashion companies. Used for brand profitability and EBITDA contribution analysis.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area code for cross-company code reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities for a specific business segment.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Sales channel classification for channel-level profitability analysis. DTC includes owned stores and brand.com; wholesale includes department stores and specialty retailers; retail includes franchise and licensed stores; ecommerce includes third-party digital platforms; marketplace includes Amazon, Zalando, etc.

attributes.name: consolidation_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the consolidation unit for group-level financial consolidation. Used for eliminating intercompany transactions and preparing consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area to which this profit center is assigned. Controlling area represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the group of cost centers that roll up into this profit center for cost allocation and overhead absorption in COGS calculation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the profit center master record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the profit center master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the profit centers local currency. Used for revenue recognition, COGS accounting, and margin analysis before consolidation.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department code for store-level or functional profit centers. Used for department-level profitability in multi-department retail stores.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region for regional profit centers. Used for regional profitability analysis and landed cost (LDP) accounting by market.

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the profit center hierarchy (standard hierarchy) to which this profit center belongs. Used for multi-level profitability reporting and roll-up analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the profit center master record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the profit center master record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the profit center is locked for transaction posting. True when locked (no new postings allowed); False when unlocked (normal operations). Used during EOM close and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the profit center configuration, special accounting treatments, or organizational changes. Used for audit trail and knowledge management.

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Planning granularity level for financial planning and budgeting. Strategic for division-level; tactical for brand/channel-level; operational for store/product-line level.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Primary product category for product-line profit centers. Used for GMROI and margin analysis by category.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the profit center used in SAP S/4HANA. Externally-known alphanumeric code representing the autonomous business segment (e.g., brand, channel, product line, region).

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the profit center. Human-readable label identifying the business segment (e.g., 'Mens Footwear DTC', 'Womens Apparel Wholesale', 'EMEA Retail Operations').

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center. Active profit centers are operational and accumulate financial transactions; planned profit centers are configured but not yet operational; inactive profit centers are temporarily suspended; closed profit centers are permanently retired.

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by organizational dimension. Indicates whether the profit center represents a brand, sales channel (DTC/wholesale/retail), product line, geographic region, individual store, or business division.

attributes.name: responsible_person_email
attributes.description: Email address of the profit center manager for financial reporting notifications and EBITDA analysis distribution.

attributes.name: responsible_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the business leader or manager accountable for the profit centers financial performance. Typically a brand director, channel head, regional VP, or product line manager.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: IFRS segment code for segment reporting under IFRS 8. Represents operating segments for external financial reporting and investor disclosures.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the profit center used in reports and dashboards for space-constrained displays.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code for statutory tax reporting and compliance. Used for VAT/GST reporting and transfer pricing documentation.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: Transfer pricing method for intercompany transactions between profit centers. Used for internal revenue recognition and OECD transfer pricing compliance.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the profit center becomes effective and begins accumulating financial transactions. Used for time-dependent profit center master data.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the profit center remains effective. Nullable for open-ended profit centers. Used for profit center lifecycle management and historical analysis.

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Chart of accounts master defining every general ledger account used in SAP S/4HANA FI for the apparel fashion enterprise. Includes account number, account type (P&L vs. balance sheet), account group, reconciliation account flag, currency, tax category, IFRS/GAAP classification, and controlling relevance. Underpins all journal entries, statutory reporting, and financial consolidation.
products.reference: SAP FI Chart of Accounts / IFRS General Ledger

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account record in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Account group classification code that controls field status, number range, and account behavior in SAP FI. Groups accounts with similar characteristics and posting rules.

attributes.name: account_long_text
attributes.description: Extended description providing detailed explanation of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and posting rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the general ledger account for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number used in SAP S/4HANA FI for posting transactions. Typically 4-10 digit numeric code per chart of accounts structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the account into balance sheet (asset, liability, equity) or profit and loss (revenue, expense) categories.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: Classification for balance sheet accounts distinguishing current vs non-current assets and liabilities. Not applicable for P&L accounts.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: blocked_for_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is currently blocked for all postings. Used to prevent transactions to obsolete or suspended accounts.

attributes.name: cash_flow_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the account for cash flow statement preparation per IFRS/GAAP. Categorizes cash movements into operating, investing, or financing activities.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: channel_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the account by sales channel (DTC, wholesale, e-commerce, retail store) for channel-specific profitability analysis in apparel fashion business.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the chart of accounts to which this account belongs. Supports multi-COA scenarios for global enterprises.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: cogs_relevant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Relevant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is included in COGS calculation. Essential for gross margin analysis and inventory valuation in apparel manufacturing and retail.

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: Account number in the group chart of accounts used for financial consolidation and elimination of intercompany transactions at corporate level.

attributes.name: cost_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. Enforces cost allocation discipline for expense accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classification of cost element as primary (posted from FI) or secondary (internal CO allocations). Not applicable for non-cost-element accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: cost_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is relevant for Controlling (CO) module and functions as a cost element for cost center accounting, internal orders, or profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general ledger account record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for chart of accounts governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for accounts denominated in a specific currency. Blank for accounts managed in company code currency.

attributes.name: ebitda_relevant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Relevant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are included in EBITDA calculation. Critical for apparel fashion profitability analysis and investor reporting.

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Four-character code defining which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this account. Controls data entry behavior in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Field Status Configuration

attributes.name: financial_statement_category
attributes.description: Detailed financial statement line item classification for statutory reporting. Maps account to specific line items in balance sheet, income statement, or cash flow statement per IFRS/GAAP requirements.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the account by business function (e.g., production, sales, administration, R&D) for functional cost-of-sales reporting per IFRS requirements.

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: US GAAP classification code for accounts used in US statutory reporting. Supports dual-reporting requirements for multinational apparel companies.

attributes.name: gl_account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the general ledger account indicating whether it is actively used, retired, or awaiting approval for use.

attributes.name: gmroi_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Category
attributes.description: Classification for GMROI analysis in apparel merchandising. Links account to inventory investment and margin performance metrics by product category or channel.

attributes.name: ifrs_classification
attributes.description: Detailed IFRS standard and paragraph reference for account classification. Ensures compliance with international accounting standards for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating whether and how interest is calculated on balances in this account. Used for customer/vendor interest calculation and treasury management.

attributes.name: landed_cost_component
attributes.description: Classification of the account as a component of landed cost calculation (freight, duty, insurance, customs). Critical for apparel import cost accounting and FOB to LDP reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the account master data. Supports change tracking and compliance audit requirements.

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayable for this account. Required for detailed transaction analysis and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Display

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is managed on an open item basis, requiring explicit clearing of line items. Essential for AP, AR, and clearing accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Defines the organizational level at which budget planning and control is performed for this account (e.g., company code, profit center, cost center).

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct manual or automated postings are permitted to this account. Some accounts may be restricted to system-only postings or blocked entirely.

attributes.name: profit_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. Used to enforce segment reporting and profitability analysis by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: profit_loss_classification
attributes.description: Detailed classification for income statement accounts including COGS, operating expenses, EBITDA components, and non-operating items. Used for margin analysis and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed postings from subsidiary ledgers such as Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), or asset accounting.

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Three-character code controlling the allocation and sorting of line items within the account. Used for automatic payment programs and dunning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Management

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification code indicating whether the account is subject to input tax, output tax, non-taxable, or tax-exempt treatment. Used for VAT/GST reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Four-character code defining posting and clearing tolerances for the account. Controls maximum amounts and variances permitted in transactions.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the account is valid and available for posting. Supports time-dependent chart of accounts changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Time-Dependent Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the account is valid. Null for accounts with indefinite validity. Used to phase out obsolete accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Time-Dependent Master Data

products.name: ledger
products.description: Represents parallel accounting ledgers in SAP S/4HANA FI for the apparel fashion group, supporting IFRS, local GAAP, and management accounting views simultaneously. Captures ledger type, accounting principle, currency, fiscal year variant, and posting period controls. Includes complete period-end close management: EOM close checklist steps, responsible owners, planned/actual completion dates, status (open, in-progress, complete, blocked), blocking reasons, sign-off approvals, and the structured close calendar including depreciation runs, accruals, intercompany reconciliation, and statutory reporting milestones for each fiscal period and company code. Enables statutory reporting, financial consolidation, and multi-GAAP compliance across global markets.
products.reference: SAP FI Ledger / IFRS Parallel Ledger

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounting ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI. Primary key for the ledger entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Ledgers belong to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: The accounting standard or framework applied in this ledger (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP, local country GAAP, management accounting, tax accounting). Determines valuation rules, recognition policies, and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: accrual_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of accrual and deferral postings for the current period. Accruals ensure expenses and revenues are recognized in the correct period per the applicable accounting principle (IFRS, GAAP). Pending indicates accruals not yet posted; complete indicates all accruals posted; partial indicates some accruals posted.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the primary currency for this ledger (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All financial amounts in this ledger are expressed or translated into this currency.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: The chart of accounts used in this ledger, defining the structure and numbering of general ledger (GL) accounts. Supports operational, group, and country-specific charts of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: close_blocking_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the issue preventing period close completion when close_checklist_status is blocked. Examples: unreconciled intercompany balances, missing accruals, pending depreciation run, outstanding approvals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Issue Tracking

attributes.name: close_calendar_template
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the close calendar template defining the structured sequence of close tasks, milestones, and deadlines for this ledger. Templates standardize close processes across periods and company codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Calendar Configuration

attributes.name: close_checklist_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the period-end close checklist for the current period. Not started indicates close has not begun; in progress indicates active close tasks; complete indicates all steps finished and approved; blocked indicates close is halted due to issues.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Task Management

attributes.name: close_responsible_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the finance team member or role responsible for managing the period-end close process for this ledger. Accountable for completing close checklist steps and obtaining sign-off approvals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Process Governance

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: Identifier of the consolidation group or reporting entity to which this ledger belongs. Used for group-level financial consolidation and statutory reporting across multiple company codes and legal entities.

attributes.name: consolidation_ledger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger is used for group consolidation and statutory reporting. True if the ledger feeds consolidation systems; false for local or management ledgers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ledger record was first created in SAP S/4HANA FI. Audit field for configuration change tracking.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Defines the currency perspective for this ledger. Company code currency is local operational currency; group currency is the consolidation currency; hard currency is a stable reference currency; index currency supports inflation-adjusted reporting.

attributes.name: current_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year currently active for posting and reporting in this ledger (e.g., 2024). Updated at fiscal year rollover.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Management

attributes.name: current_posting_period
attributes.description: The posting period currently open for transaction entry in this ledger (1-16, where 1-12 are regular periods and 13-16 are special periods for adjustments). Controlled by period-end close process.

attributes.name: depreciation_run_status
attributes.description: Status of the periodic depreciation calculation and posting run for fixed assets in this ledger. Depreciation run is a mandatory step in the End of Month (EOM) close process.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ledger was closed or deactivated. Null for active ledgers. Used for historical ledgers that have been archived or replaced.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ledger became active and began accepting financial postings. Represents the go-live date for the ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal calendar structure for this ledger (number of periods, period start/end dates, year-end date). Supports calendar year, non-calendar year, and special period configurations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: intercompany_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany balance reconciliation for the current period. Reconciled indicates all intercompany transactions match between trading partners; variance identified indicates discrepancies requiring resolution before close.

attributes.name: last_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent period close was completed and signed off. Represents the last successful End of Month (EOM) close milestone.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period Close Management

attributes.name: last_closed_period
attributes.description: The most recent posting period that has completed the End of Month (EOM) close process and is locked for further postings. Used to track close progress and enforce period controls.

attributes.name: leading_ledger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the leading ledger (primary book of record) for the organization. True for the leading ledger; false for extension or special purpose ledgers. Only one leading ledger is permitted per client.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New General Ledger Architecture

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the ledger in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 0L for leading ledger, 2L for IFRS ledger). Used as the business identifier for the ledger across financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: ledger_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the accounting ledger (e.g., Leading Ledger, IFRS Ledger, Management Accounting Ledger). Human-readable label for business users.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ledger. Active ledgers accept postings; inactive ledgers are configured but not yet in use; closed ledgers are archived and read-only; suspended ledgers are temporarily blocked.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ledger role in the accounting architecture. Leading ledger is the primary book of record; extension ledgers support parallel accounting views (IFRS, local GAAP); special purpose ledgers support management accounting or simulation scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New General Ledger

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this ledger configuration. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ledger record was last modified in SAP S/4HANA FI. Audit field for configuration change tracking.

attributes.name: multi_gaap_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger is part of a multi-GAAP parallel accounting setup, supporting simultaneous compliance with multiple accounting standards (e.g., IFRS and US GAAP). True if multi-GAAP; false if single standard.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Parallel Accounting for Multi-GAAP

attributes.name: next_close_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the next period close must be completed. Drives the close calendar and task scheduling for depreciation runs, accruals, intercompany reconciliation, and statutory reporting milestones.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, configuration notes, or special instructions related to this ledger. Used for documentation and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: parallel_accounting_scenario
attributes.description: Describes the specific parallel accounting use case this ledger supports (e.g., IFRS 16 Leases, US GAAP Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Reporting). Free-text field for business context.

attributes.name: period_lock_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current posting period is open for all users, locked to prevent further postings, or partially locked (open only for specific user groups or account ranges). Managed during End of Month (EOM) close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period Close Controls

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: SAP posting period variant controlling the number of posting periods and special periods (e.g., 12 regular periods plus 4 special periods for year-end adjustments). Governs period open/close controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Configuration

attributes.name: sign_off_approver
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior finance leader (e.g., CFO, Controller, Finance Director) responsible for final approval and sign-off of the period close for this ledger. Approval confirms financial statements are complete and accurate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Approval Workflow

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sign-off approver formally approved the period close and financial statements for this ledger. Marks the official completion of the close process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Close Approval Workflow

attributes.name: statutory_reporting_status
attributes.description: Status of statutory financial reporting deliverables for this ledger and period (e.g., balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement per IFRS or local GAAP). Not started indicates reports not yet generated; submitted indicates reports filed with authorities; approved indicates reports signed off by auditors or management.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), Local GAAP Requirements

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The valuation approach applied in this ledger. Legal valuation follows local statutory rules; group valuation applies corporate consolidation policies; profit center and segment valuations support internal management reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this ledger configuration in the system. Used for audit trail and configuration governance.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core accounting document in SAP S/4HANA FI capturing every financial posting at both header and line-item granularity. Header attributes include document number, posting date, fiscal period, ledger, company code, currency, reversal status, and IFRS/GAAP classification. Line items capture GL account, cost center, profit center, debit/credit amounts in transaction and local currency, tax code, assignment field, WBS element, and business area. Covers manual journal entries, automated postings from SD/MM/PP, period-end accruals, reclassifications, and intercompany eliminations. Provides the complete authoritative audit trail for all financial movements in the apparel fashion enterprise.
products.reference: SAP FI Accounting Document / IFRS Journal Entry

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry document in SAP S/4HANA FI. Primary key for the journal entry record.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to a legal entity (company code). Normalizing STRING company_code to FK company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id. Remove redundant company_code STRING column.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries can be allocated to cost centers for cost tracking. Normalizing STRING cost_center to FK cost_center_id → cost_center.cost_center_id. Remove redundant cost_center STRING column.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entries post to GL accounts for financial reporting. Normalizing STRING gl_account to FK gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id. Remove redundant gl_account STRING column.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to a ledger for parallel accounting. Normalizing STRING ledger_group to FK ledger_id → ledger.ledger_id. Remove redundant ledger_group STRING column.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries can be allocated to profit centers for profitability analysis. Normalizing STRING profit_center to FK profit_center_id → profit_center.profit_center_id. Remove redundant profit_center

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this journal entry is classified (IFRS, GAAP, LOCAL_GAAP, TAX). Supports parallel accounting and multi-GAAP reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS Framework, GAAP ASC Framework, SAP S/4HANA Parallel Accounting

attributes.name: amount_document_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry line item in the document currency (transaction currency). Used for multi-currency reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21, SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry line item in the company code's local currency. Used for statutory financial statements and local GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21, SAP S/4HANA Local Currency Accounting

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text field used for additional sorting and grouping of line items. Often contains purchase order numbers, project codes, or other business references for reconciliation.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Four-character code representing a business segment or division for internal management reporting. Enables profitability analysis by business unit across company codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS 8 - Operating Segments

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry record was first created in the SAP system. Used for audit trail and process performance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the document currency (transaction currency). All line items in the document are posted in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for debit (S=Soll/debit) or credit (H=Haben/credit) posting. Fundamental accounting classification for double-entry bookkeeping.
attributes.references: Double-Entry Bookkeeping Principles, SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Logic

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice, receipt, etc.) that originated this journal entry. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: document_header_text

attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected from the customer based on agreed payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting, dunning process triggers, and overdue analysis.

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: The date the most recent dunning notice was sent to the customer for this overdue invoice. Used to track collections activity and determine next dunning action timing.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections reminder) level for overdue invoices. Typically ranges from 0 (no dunning) to 3+ (final notice before legal action). Increments with each escalation cycle.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this invoice is assigned. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-13 for special closing periods. Critical for monthly financial close and period-based revenue recognition.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this invoice is assigned based on posting date. Used for period-based financial reporting, EOM close processes, and year-over-year revenue analysis.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Shipping, freight, and logistics charges billed to the customer. May be based on FOB (Free on Board) terms or LDP (Landed Duty Paid) pricing depending on Incoterms.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, including all line items at list price. Represents the initial billing value before tax, discounts, or rebates.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs and risks between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP, EXW). Critical for international wholesale transactions and landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional invoice-level comments, special instructions, or customer-specific billing notes. May include payment instructions, dispute details, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique invoice document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. Used for customer communication, payment reconciliation, and audit trails.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice. Tracks progression from draft through posting, payment collection, and final clearing or write-off. Critical for DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) tracking and AR aging analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|posted|partially_paid|fully_paid|overdue|written_off|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Standard invoices represent normal sales billing, credit memos represent returns or adjustments, debit memos represent additional charges, proforma invoices are preliminary, and intercompany invoices are for internal transfers.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that last modified the invoice record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for financial data integrity.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was last updated in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. Tracks changes for audit compliance and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice total after all discounts, rebates, taxes, and freight charges. This is the amount the customer is obligated to pay and the basis for revenue recognition per IFRS 15.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Equals net_amount minus any payments received. Used for AR aging reports, DSO calculation, and cash collection forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Open Item Management

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism the customer will use to settle the invoice. Letter of Credit (LC) is common for international wholesale orders. Wire transfer and ACH are standard for B2B. Credit card is typical for DTC.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code from SAP master data defining the number of days until payment is due and any early payment discount conditions (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI. May differ from billing date due to period-end processing or backdated entries. Critical for financial period assignment and EOM (End of Month) close.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The customer's purchase order number provided at time of order. Required for wholesale and B2B transactions for customer reconciliation and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) matching.

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: Customer rebates and retrospective discounts accrued or applied to this invoice. Common in wholesale channel for volume-based incentives. Tracked separately from standard discounts for rebate accrual accounting.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date revenue from this invoice is recognized in the general ledger per IFRS 15 criteria. May differ from billing date based on performance obligation fulfillment (e.g., shipment date, delivery date, or service completion date).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to recognize revenue from this invoice per IFRS 15. Point-in-time is standard for product sales at shipment or delivery. Over-time applies to service contracts. Deferred applies to advance payments. Milestone applies to custom manufacturing or ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) contracts.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the sale was made. Wholesale represents B2B sales to retailers, DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) online represents e-commerce sales, DTC store represents company-owned retail, retail represents third-party retail, and marketplace represents platform sales. Critical for channel profitability analysis and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, VAT (Value Added Tax), or GST (Goods and Services Tax) charged on the invoice. Calculated based on customer location, product tax classification, and applicable tax jurisdiction rules.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax authority and jurisdiction for this invoice (e.g., state, province, country). Used for tax calculation, remittance, and compliance reporting per local regulations.

products.name: finance_payment
products.description: Records outgoing vendor payments and incoming customer receipts processed through SAP S/4HANA FI, including wire transfers, Letters of Credit (LC), ACH/SEPA, checks, and intercompany netting settlements. Captures payment method, house bank and bank account, value date, clearing document reference, exchange rate at payment date, payment run ID, reconciliation status, and bank statement matching result. Supports AP/AR clearing, cash positioning, LC settlement for apparel import transactions, and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross payment amount in the transaction currency before any adjustments, fees, or exchange rate conversions.

attributes.name: bank_charges
attributes.description: Fees charged by the bank for processing the payment transaction, including wire transfer fees, LC handling fees, or foreign exchange fees.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment appeared on the bank statement, used for bank reconciliation and cash positioning.

attributes.name: beneficiary_bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the beneficiary's bank institution receiving or sending the payment.

attributes.name: beneficiary_bank_swift_code
attributes.description: The SWIFT/BIC code of the beneficiary's bank, used for international wire transfers and cross-border payments.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The name of the payment recipient (vendor, supplier, or customer). For outgoing payments, this is the payee; for incoming receipts, this is the payer.

attributes.name: block_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the payment is blocked for processing due to approval requirements, compliance holds, or dispute resolution. True if blocked, False if released.

attributes.name: block_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the payment is blocked, such as pending approval, invoice dispute, compliance review, or missing documentation.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division within the company responsible for the payment, enabling profitability analysis by channel, product line, or region.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI clearing document that links this payment to the original invoice or receivable, enabling Accounts Payable (AP) or Accounts Receivable (AR) clearing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY). Represents the currency in which the payment was executed.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount taken by the payer or granted to the payee, reducing the net payment amount. Common in vendor payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this payment in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for audit trails and reconciliation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at payment date to convert payment currency to local currency. Critical for multi-currency payment processing and landed cost (LDP) accounting.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the same corporate group. True for intercompany, False for external.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the company's local reporting currency for consolidation and statutory reporting per IFRS/GAAP requirements.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company's local reporting currency used in financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified or updated. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount transferred after applying discounts and deducting bank charges. Represents the actual cash movement.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The business date when the payment transaction was executed or processed. Distinct from value date and posting date.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment: wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area), check, Letter of Credit (LC), electronic funds transfer, or cash. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|sepa|check|lc|electronic_funds_transfer|cash — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment: pending approval, cleared through bank, reconciled with bank statement, failed processing, cancelled, or in transit.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment transaction: outgoing vendor payments, incoming customer receipts, intercompany netting settlements, Letter of Credit (LC) settlements, bank transfers, or refunds.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the payment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for period-end close (EOM) and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to the payment for processing sequence in payment runs: urgent, high, normal, or low.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when this payment was successfully reconciled with the bank statement, completing the cash management cycle.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank statement reconciliation: matched to bank statement, unmatched, partially matched, or under review by treasury team.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or remittance advice identifier provided by the payer or payee for payment tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the automated payment run batch in SAP S/4HANA FI that grouped multiple payments for processing. Used for batch reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (VAT, GST, withholding tax) associated with the payment transaction, if applicable. Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to the payment transaction in SAP S/4HANA FI, determining tax calculation rules and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms between buyer and seller (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, FOB, DDP). Influences discount eligibility and cash flow timing.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date when funds are available or debited for interest calculation and cash positioning purposes. Critical for treasury management and cash flow analysis.

Foundational for gross margin analysis, GMROI calculation, and IMU/MMU tracking by product and channel.

attributes.name: duty_cost

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: fob_cost
attributes.description: The FOB cost component representing the cost of goods at the point of shipment from the supplier or manufacturer.

attributes.name: freight_cost

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system process that last modified this COGS entry record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this COGS entry record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: ldp_cost
attributes.description: The total landed cost including FOB, freight, duty, and all other costs to deliver the product to the final destination.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COGS entry was posted to the general ledger, which may differ from recognition date due to period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: The merchandise category code for the product, enabling category-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: The quantity of units sold for this SKU in this transaction, triggering the COGS recognition.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the COGS was recognized, typically aligned with revenue recognition per IFRS 15 or GAAP ASC 606.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System tariff classification code for the imported goods. Determines the applicable customs duty rate and trade regulations.

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms 2020 code defining the terms of delivery and cost responsibility between buyer and seller. Common values: FOB, CIF, EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inland_freight_amount
attributes.description: The cost of domestic transportation from the port of discharge to the final warehouse or distribution center.

attributes.name: insurance_amount
attributes.description: The cost of cargo insurance covering the goods during international transit. Component of landed cost.

attributes.name: landed_cost_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the landed cost calculation. Human-readable reference number used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: landed_cost_status
attributes.description: The current status of the landed cost record in the financial workflow. Values: draft (initial calculation), calculated (computation complete), approved (reviewed and approved), posted (recorded to general ledger), reversed (corrected or cancelled).

attributes.name: letter_of_credit_number
attributes.description: The letter of credit number used to secure payment for this shipment. Links to trade finance instruments.
attributes.references: UCP 600 - Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this landed cost record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates and corrections.

attributes.name: ocean_freight_amount
attributes.description: The cost of ocean freight transportation from the port of loading to the port of discharge. Component of landed cost.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of manufacture or origin for the goods. Used for customs duty calculation and trade compliance.

attributes.name: port_handling_amount
attributes.description: The cost of port handling services including unloading, storage, and terminal fees at the port of discharge.

attributes.name: port_of_discharge
attributes.description: The seaport or airport where the goods were unloaded upon arrival. Used for customs clearance and port handling cost allocation.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: The seaport or airport from which the goods were shipped. Used for freight cost allocation and logistics tracking.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: The quantity of goods received in this shipment. Used to calculate unit landed cost and allocate costs across units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt Quantity

attributes.name: tariff_rate_percent
attributes.description: The customs duty rate percentage applied to the goods based on the HS code and origin country. Used to calculate the customs duty amount.

attributes.name: total_landed_cost_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Landed Duty Paid (LDP) Cost Amount
attributes.description: The total landed duty paid cost per unit or shipment. Sum of FOB price, freight, insurance, customs duty, and all other charges. Authoritative cost basis for inventory valuation and COGS.

attributes.name: unit_landed_cost_amount
attributes.description: The landed cost per individual unit of the SKU. Calculated by dividing total landed cost by quantity received. Used for per-unit inventory valuation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity received. Standard units include EA (each), PC (piece), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), M (meter), YD (yard), PAIR, SET, BOX, CASE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|LB|M|YD|PAIR|SET|BOX|CASE — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: company_code
products.description: Master record for each legal entity (company code) within the apparel fashion group as defined in SAP S/4HANA FI. Captures company code, company name, country, currency, chart of accounts, fiscal year variant, controlling area, tax jurisdiction, and IFRS/local GAAP accounting principle. Serves as the organizational anchor for statutory reporting, financial consolidation, and intercompany accounting.
products.reference: SAP FI Company Code / Legal Entity

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the company code record. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE (legal entity as a managed organizational resource).

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: Primary accounting standard applied for statutory financial reporting. Options include IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), US GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), local GAAP, or hybrid approaches for dual reporting.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company code was activated in the SAP S/4HANA FI system and began posting financial transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the registered legal address for the company code. Includes street number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the registered legal address for the company code. Includes building name, suite, or floor information.

attributes.name: business_segment
attributes.description: Primary business segment classification for this company code within the apparel fashion group. Used for segment reporting, profitability analysis, and strategic planning.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the chart of accounts assigned to this company code. The COA defines the structure of General Ledger (GL) accounts used for recording financial transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the registered legal address for the company code.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the legal entity within the SAP S/4HANA FI system. This is the business identifier used across all financial transactions and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the company as registered with statutory authorities. Used for financial statements, tax filings, and legal documentation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: company_name_short
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trading name of the company used for internal reporting and operational displays.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: company_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the company code. Active indicates the entity is operational and posting transactions. Inactive, dormant, liquidation, or merged indicate non-operational states.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Status

attributes.name: consolidation_entity_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this company code is included in group-level financial consolidation. True indicates the entity participates in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: consolidation_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the consolidation group or reporting entity to which this company code belongs. Used for multi-level consolidation hierarchies and segment reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the Controlling (CO) area to which this company code is assigned. The controlling area is the organizational unit for cost accounting, profitability analysis, and internal management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_of_sales_accounting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this company code uses cost-of-sales accounting (income statement by function) or period accounting (income statement by nature). True indicates cost-of-sales method.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of domicile for the legal entity. Determines tax jurisdiction, statutory reporting requirements, and local GAAP applicability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this company code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the credit control area responsible for managing customer credit limits and credit exposure for this company code.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency of the company code. All financial transactions for this entity are recorded in this currency before consolidation.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company code was deactivated or ceased operations. Null if the entity is still active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for official correspondence with the company code.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the company code, if applicable. Used for formal legal and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: field_status_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the field status variant that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during financial document posting for this company code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Field Status Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year structure for this company code, including the number of posting periods, special periods for year-end adjustments, and fiscal year start/end dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region classification for this company code. Used for regional performance analysis, geographic segment reporting, and market-based strategic decisions.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity was incorporated or registered with the statutory authority. Used for legal compliance and entity lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: intercompany_clearing_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this company code participates in automated intercompany clearing and reconciliation processes. True indicates intercompany transactions are tracked and cleared.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the primary language used for financial reporting and communication for this company code.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who last modified this company code record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this company code record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the company code headquarters or registered office.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered legal address for the company code.

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the posting period variant that controls which posting periods are open or closed for transaction posting in this company code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Control

attributes.name: profit_center_standard_hierarchy
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard profit center hierarchy used for profitability analysis and internal management reporting for this company code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the registered legal address for the company code.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction applicable to this company code. Determines tax calculation rules, tax reporting requirements, and compliance with local tax authorities.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the company code location. Used for timestamp normalization and cross-entity transaction reconciliation.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or sales tax registration number assigned by the local tax authority. Required for VAT reporting and cross-border transactions within VAT jurisdictions.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Records intercompany financial transactions between legal entities within the apparel fashion group, including intercompany sales of finished goods (e.g., sourcing entity to retail entity), royalty and license fee charges, shared service allocations, management fees, and intercompany loans. Captures sending and receiving company codes, transaction type, amount in transaction and group currency, elimination status, netting position, transfer pricing method, and IFRS 10 consolidation treatment. Essential for financial consolidation, transfer pricing documentation (OECD guidelines), and group statutory reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for the intercompany transaction entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be allocated to cost centers for cost tracking. Normalizing STRING cost_center_code to FK cost_center_id → cost_center.cost_center_id. Remove redundant cost_center_code S

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions post to GL accounts for financial reporting. Normalizing STRING gl_account_code to FK gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id. Remove redundant gl_account_code STRING column

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Intercompany transactions generate journal entries in SAP S/4HANA FI for both the sending and receiving entities. intercompany_transaction has reference_document_number as a STRING reference but no st

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Intercompany transactions are posted to specific accounting ledgers in SAP S/4HANA parallel accounting. intercompany_transaction has fiscal_period and fiscal_year but no ledger_id FK. Adding ledger_id

attributes.name: sending_company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Intercompany transactions track sending legal entity for intercompany reconciliation. Normalizing STRING sending_company_code to FK sending_company_code_id → company_code.company_code_id (first FK to

attributes.name: sending_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions track sending profit center for segment reporting. Normalizing STRING sending_profit_center_code to FK sending_profit_center_id → profit_center.profit_center_id (first FK to

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: The brand code associated with the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for royalty and license fee transactions. Used for brand-level financial analysis.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The sales or distribution channel associated with the intercompany transaction. Wholesale for B2B distribution; retail for owned stores; ecommerce for digital; franchise for licensed operations; outlet for clearance channels.

attributes.name: consolidation_unit_code
attributes.description: The consolidation unit or reporting entity code used in the financial consolidation system. Identifies the level at which this transaction is eliminated in the consolidation hierarchy.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created the intercompany transaction record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was eliminated during the financial consolidation process. Null if elimination is still pending.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: The current status of the intercompany transaction in the consolidation elimination process. Pending indicates awaiting elimination; eliminated means fully removed from consolidated statements; partially eliminated for complex multi-step transactions; exception for transactions requiring manual review.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the transaction amount from transaction currency to group currency. Typically the rate effective on the transaction date.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the intercompany transaction is recorded, typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-13 including adjustments.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded, used for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: The geographic region code associated with the intercompany transaction, used for regional segment reporting and transfer pricing documentation by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction translated into the group reporting currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the corporate group reporting currency. All intercompany transactions are translated to this currency for consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified the intercompany transaction record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: netting_position
attributes.description: Indicates the settlement position of the intercompany transaction from the group perspective. Payable means the sending entity owes the receiving entity; receivable means the opposite; settled indicates payment completed; offset means netted against other transactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the intercompany transaction, including special circumstances, adjustments, or audit findings.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in the financial system. May differ from transaction date due to period-end processing or adjustments.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: The product category or merchandise hierarchy code associated with the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for goods transfers. Used for category-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity that is the receiver or consumer in the intercompany transaction. Represents the entity being charged or receiving goods/services. Typically a 4-character alphanumeric code per SAP standard.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Company Code Structure

attributes.name: receiving_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code within the receiving company that is charged for the intercompany transaction. Used for internal profitability analysis and segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was reconciled and confirmed between the sending and receiving entities. Null if reconciliation is pending or disputed.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current reconciliation status between the sending and receiving entities. Matched indicates both sides agree; unmatched for discrepancies; disputed for contested amounts; resolved for cleared disputes.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the source document that triggered the intercompany transaction, such as a purchase order, invoice, or service agreement number. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date when the intercompany transaction was settled through cash payment, netting, or other settlement mechanism between the legal entities. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to settle the intercompany transaction. Cash payment for direct fund transfer; netting for multilateral settlement; offset against other balances; loan conversion for capitalization; waiver for forgiveness.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applicable to the intercompany transaction, used for transfer pricing compliance and tax reporting. Critical for OECD BEPS documentation.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency. Represents the gross amount charged or transferred before any adjustments.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated and executed between the two legal entities.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date when the intercompany transaction occurred or was recognized. This is the accounting effective date used for financial period assignment and consolidation.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number for the intercompany transaction, typically following format IC followed by 10 digits. Used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the business activity between legal entities. Goods transfer represents finished goods or materials moved between entities; service charge for shared services; royalty and license fees for intellectual property usage; management fees for corporate overhead; loan and interest for financing arrangements; dividend for profit distribution; allocation for cost sharing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: goods_transfer|service_charge|royalty|license_fee|management_fee|loan|interest|dividend|allocation — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_price_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustment amount applied to the intercompany transaction to align with transfer pricing policy and arms-length principles. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-compliant transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arms-length price for this intercompany transaction. Comparable uncontrolled price uses market benchmarks; resale price based on resale margin; cost plus adds markup to cost; transactional net margin compares net margins; profit split allocates combined profits.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax applied to the intercompany transaction, particularly relevant for cross-border royalty, interest, and service fee payments. Recorded in transaction currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The withholding tax rate percentage applied to the intercompany transaction based on applicable tax treaties and local regulations. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

products.name: tax_item
products.description: Captures tax line items associated with financial transactions in SAP S/4HANA FI, including VAT, sales tax, import duty, withholding tax, and GST. Stores tax code, tax type, taxable base amount, tax amount, tax jurisdiction, reporting period, tax return reference, and filing status. Supports indirect tax compliance, statutory tax reporting, and customs duty reconciliation for apparel fashion global operations.
products.reference: SAP FI Tax Item / Indirect Tax

attributes.name: tax_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax line item record in the financial system.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Tax line items (output VAT, sales tax) are generated from AR invoice postings for customer billing. tax_item currently uses document_number as a generic STRING reference. Adding ar_invoice_id enables

attributes.name: company_code_id
